Peter,

We've been in the race for the United States Senate for six months, and all signs point to this being the race to watch in the November elections. Polling shows it's already a dead heat.

The race for the Senate seat here in Georgia - which will determine the balance of power in Washington - is no slam dunk for either party. That's why we're working on gathering the endorsements of conservatives all over America.

President Trump was my very first supporter in this race, and he offered an endorsement any candidate would be honored to receive. When I announced my intent to enter this race, President Trump wrote:

| _**"Herschel is tough on crime and borders, and he will always stand in support of law enforcement, military, and our vets. He will fight hard for our Second Amendment and voter integrity. Herschel will never let you down."**_
---

Since President Trump endorsed our campaign, we've been blessed to receive multiple endorsements from other Republican leaders including:

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=cbe3fc2824934c0c938903645f5d3c35&_e=qwKq5HzP83hT9v80kcd5yRKB937v_3xy0TUDJSo3UqJVsIVLCGQQ9pK0uhGWztofAk26uMTlvaCtALAq11DT5hZU9SiGxFUgHtHmGjeqDuq_Js04ZxwmLCVabGele956RVPHtyYWlucnb0e8CLxsutxhVqzKoAE-1e2nxel0n3saU9G-egfrZdUKYX3UGAVegB7LttvR9FS-HfRPqfdg-4ZxVvRAZdaN_bWnL21CYcUzE6g45Z8CLP6ua0kwZohvHtGq6PCR8tLWMI2v_owHcTpb5sgUTrKv9bgOoLZoCwhPAWcEKVaD6vVQKxV1uLpa2a_Ya03Ta5f5O3GhjxC1maQsijg4BNZ0q9QqlDJdfU6MWUczdLmMUN_hKdR2lpkQELWJbLlysl6yPngmzBuQ7fBtxRBAcpfX6EW84prK2fNvIUr4dr_iD6-3KEMQ_zgBeN6TOTOoetgzB26dBLaUpvjvPAY70cHfg7WkGAK8NpDFg35JF0lpDL7Lr9GzbbRjpC_wnN21lCl8JLNqho606Uv9FOOnSulr8zKpHV7Pdq0lugzQGH_OdgLYxLASUxIl)
We're thankful for the support from Republican public officials, but we won't get anywhere without CONSERVATIVE PATRIOTS like you on our side.

I'm a team player - always have been, and we need you on our team. **_[So, I'm asking you to join our team today by offering your personal endorsement of our Senate campaign.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=cbe3fc2824934c0c938903645f5d3c35&_e=qwKq5HzP83hT9v80kcd5yRKB937v_3xy0TUDJSo3UqJVsIVLCGQQ9pK0uhGWztofAk26uMTlvaCtALAq11DT5hZU9SiGxFUgHtHmGjeqDuq_Js04ZxwmLCVabGele956RVPHtyYWlucnb0e8CLxsutxhVqzKoAE-1e2nxel0n3saU9G-egfrZdUKYX3UGAVegB7LttvR9FS-HfRPqfdg-4ZxVvRAZdaN_bWnL21CYcUzE6g45Z8CLP6ua0kwZohvHtGq6PCR8tLWMI2v_owHcTpb5sgUTrKv9bgOoLZoCwhPAWcEKVaD6vVQKxV1uLpa2a_Ya03Ta5f5O3GhjxC1maQsijg4BNZ0q9QqlDJdfU7y-xaMXYKBfTgUJsr8Vy6bA39W_cnGPyuXdEZhbbJd0DA3zOfkJQWhEHAxEBAAs9gCdDgyNTRVsO75BqV8jk0YCvOqvfM5RygDwsnYDA8N27CQZ38lfFPIzBTK_9TOfg4-sVapEWsZdZgXoHdeDXyxiqMZvVAfafMxmlEBVuM1XGM8f5QuV_UE9V0biNo2jnPe6UAe0ycGTJGjTwo7rRXe)_**

I believe in strong conservative values. I believe in smaller government, personal responsibility, and making sure ALL AMERICANS - regardless of income level, race, or religion - can pursue their dreams.

While my opponent may have the support of Hollywood and national Democrats, we're building a grassroots army of PATRIOTS from around the country. Your endorsement will benefit our campaign as we work to flip Georgia's Senate seat RED and restore some sanity to Washington.

FROM: A Proud Democrat
DATE: February 24th, 2022

**_Dear Senator Manchin,_**

We need to have a serious talk.

For the last year, in state houses across the country, **Republicans have been doing their best to dismantle voting rights.**

**And now, Senate Republicans have BLOCKED the Freedom to Vote: John Lewis Act, which would protect voting rights at a national level!**

I’m enraged, Senator, so now, I’m personally demanding you step up, meet this moment, and ABOLISH the filibuster to finally SAVE voting rights!

[I’m dead serious – and to prove it, I’m giving a donation of $2 to the Voter Protection Project, an organization founded to protect the right to vote, right now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/6359?t=11&akid=1332%2E878179%2E2JlvPv) | [DONATE $2 TO SIGN THE LETTER!](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/6359?t=12&akid=1332%2E878179%2E2JlvPv)

The Republican war on our democracy isn’t over, Senator.

**In addition to trying to suppress voters, the GOP is trying to block every piece of legislation President Biden is trying to pass — putting the midterms at risk!**

The people of your state and our country deserve more. That’s why I’m imploring you to do the right thing and abolish the filibuster!

[So please, STAND UP, defend our right to vote and abolish the filibuster once and for all. I know I am, and I’ll show it with a $2 donation to VPP »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/6359?t=13&akid=1332%2E878179%2E2JlvPv)

Peter \-- The Minnesota Legislature has been in session for four weeks and most Republicans REFUSE to get you a vote on Stopping Vaccine Mandates. **Today, Rep Erik Mortensen[offered a Stop Vaccine Mandates Amendment](https://www.action4liberty.com/republican_legislators_refuse_vote_on_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=see_i_told_you_so&n=2) on the Frontline Workers Pay Bill.** And like I've told you many times, it was the Political Class on both sides of the aisle that killed it. That means your Republican Legislator likely did NOT stand for the issue you care so much about. All he needed was for 15 other Republicans to join him in raising their hand to provide a recorded roll call vote. Without those hands, voters have no idea how a legislator votes and that essentially kills the bill. This is the tactic that the Political Class uses to kill pro-liberty legislation. Only Reps Drazkowski, Munson, Bahr, Miller, Lucero and McDonald supported Mortensen for a public roll call vote on the Stop Vaccine Mandates Amendment. All the other Republicans sat by and did nothing.
# FRAUDS!
Here's the video of Rep Mortensen introducing the Stop Vaccine Mandates Resolution and most Republicans sitting down, refusing to give a recorded roll call vote. [](https://www.action4liberty.com/republican_legislators_refuse_vote_on_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=see_i_told_you_so&n=3) Win or lose, at least Rep Erik Mortensen is doing something about the infringement of our health freedoms! **Looks like we're going to have to go inform voters how their Republican Legislator REFUSED to stand up for their health freedom by Stopping Vaccine Mandates.** But I will need your help to make that happen. We need your financial support to buy the ads, pay for the phone callers and fund the door knocks to inform voters on this MASSIVE BETRAYAL. Politicians tell you one thing - but when they have the opportunity to stand up for your health freedom, they DON'T ACT. We are going to EXPOSE THEM! **Will you help me EXPOSE these frauds?!** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=see_i_told_you_so&n=4 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=see_i_told_you_so&n=4)
---
More importantly, why hasn't the Republican controlled Minnesota Senate voted on Stopping Vaccine Mandates yet? They've met for four weeks now in 2022.
You may remember Senators like Jim Abeler, Mark Johnson & Gene Dornink (to name a few) who told you they were against vaccine mandates.
## WHERE'S THE VOTE?!?!
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/republican_legislators_refuse_vote_on_stop_vaccine_mandates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=see_i_told_you_so&n=5)
By the way, Sen Gene Dornink is carpetbagging to a district he doesn't live in to run against Lisa Hanson.
According to Minnesota Senate rules, any Senator can force a vote on a bill. Why haven't they led? Republicans are in control of that chamber.
**All of us who care about health freedom and Stopping Vaccine Mandates, only have six legislators willing to stand up and force a vote on Stopping Vaccine Mandates.**
Well, this is why I told you to go to caucus on February 1st and become a delegate. Now it's time to confront your legislator who is seeking your vote for endorsement.
Tell your legislator that they have failed you and the people of Minnesota by not forcing a vote on the Stop Vaccine Mandates legislation.

name: Chris Deluzio
subject: Ukraine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Friends —

I’m sure we’ve all seen the news by now. Last night, Russia launched a full-scale attack on Ukraine, a horrendous violation of its people’s sovereignty that will lead to brutal suffering — and civilians will bear so much of the cost.

This afternoon, President Biden took quick, decisive economic and diplomatic action against Russia, including strong sanctions. We need to do whatever we can to rein in Putin’s attack on Ukraine’s sovereignty and democracy.

As an Iraq War veteran, my friends and I have seen the reality of war. Destruction, death, and so much human suffering. We have to work hard for peace in Ukraine and all over the world, the costs are far too grave to do anything else.

And as we look forward in Ukraine, I wanted to share a couple of additional thoughts:

First, NATO allies must put up a united front against Putin’s actions. For far too long, while we Americans and a few of our NATO allies met our obligations, too many allies failed to put up their required share of defense. It’s critical that every nation chip in their part under the treaty — Americans should not be shouldering so much of the cost of NATO.

Additionally, our European friends should not be so dependent on Russia’s gas and oil. We’ve seen countries like Germany walk away from their nuclear sector, complicating their goals of decarbonizing. As a result, so many European countries today find themselves held hostage to Russian energy. Russia’s oil and gas sales fuel their economy and militarism. That’s why we need a strong energy policy here at home and across the globe.

I applaud President Biden’s actions today. I encourage him to continue to support Ukraine’s sovereignty and unite world leaders behind ending Putin’s assault on democracy once and for all.

Thank you for standing with us.

— Chris

name: Shahid Buttar
subject: Before the Pentagon drags us into yet anotherwar….
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shahid Buttar for Congress Committee, 1390 Market St
body:
The Russian invasion of Ukraine has alarmed observers around the world. But the U.S. and NATO lost any legitimacy to intervene long ago. | | |
---
[](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yRkW_Sw2xr1MvIXEt6jooTbMnsVYqhUO8Xwt4ORz78OfUg7g0bT3KWj5PFlOrwylcmVHgVhvfe2ZPl5W7AdMas-inAHy76X3Wi8X9sRl23R2PZ25QYXbrV_Xy3t5_v88acMIsOqzdL8lZ_4P-TwOnhzGz6_OOLyIorFDTV0l0eI2pAf2LPOac1sI1DxeUcWQi151BznP25ZdgPPgb0zsxz992DSVhVpf7tlAAZjukt8iuLVGUCXIG6_ntrFC401Q-uDMzkc7bjHes8krmyE1wSy2fscERtqTweqqkDHaeUGBByRSXQy7RlMXUQ8XyyI6Jf5mmrE5iKRmMcNO0tXOAZDzXNZBQX2flWtrDsCmuGFw/3jv/bt-Bwh6pS06GsPwSr5-vMQ/h0/Rqy1c8e0yyLmY5D0H_voQ2kM1-Ubt-OOuBdaqTo-BsM)
| | Dear Peter, **Today’s invasion of Ukraine by Russia has sparked alarm around the world. Anytime civilians are forced to endure violence, outrage and concern are thoroughly appropriate.** While many voices have shared concern for human rights and democracy, however, we are compelled to observe that the U.S. has no credible claim to have stood for either of those values over the past half century. In times like these, it’s important to remember the past before repeating its path. Many foolishly clamor for U.S. military intervention, but we remember the recent history in both Ukraine, as well as the United States. Thinking that the Russian invasion of Ukraine justifies a military response erases the history of the region. In 2014, the U.S. supported a right-wing coup in Ukraine that created the conditions for the current conflict. It did not start this week, nor do countries that have long instigated international conflicts (like the United States) have any legitimate claim to later stand for peace. The continuing history of U.S. military industrial corruption is also crucial to consider. The United States is the only country to ever deploy weapons of mass destruction against civilian populations. We’re the only country that embraces extended solitary confinement (recognized across the world as a human rights violation) in our domestic prison system, which imprisons more people than any other country in the world—by far. We’ve intervened in dozens of countries over the past three generations, set up military bases around the world, “tortured some folks” with impunity, assassinated journalists before outrageously prosecuting the publisher who revealed those war crimes, continue to illegally detain thousands of migrants at our nation’s militarized borders, and created a global mass surveillance network. Each of those examples enjoyed widespread bipartisan support. **For better or worse, Washington can’t credibly claim to support human rights, leaving NATO with no legitimacy to intervene in Eastern Europe, or frankly anywhere else.** As I [explained recently in SF Gate](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDAq19NGl8C0OxpU1rLrBiltq-tVDU1u_HAJ56wYjv83sBD_LQ1VPWMsGx7hB7Ce3bwMGBs1OE-_icpyAcKf5KfDmjUPomhWukpKyPCUgQY86szh9dgaqXpPS72fE2k-UixD1bV6TfT3pW28QuNDVDDg5Js7dmWIF64okvCkEwdVwF49ybmlNYlo4kluItCmJqKoNt3vR0hG934PGyImQGs1XwRpUuvHdowDQGGgHjHu-TYJdcsQSye7wvnr848qiKE7ddp32KBjSoqIcoJ1Oftng0N3AAilRYGo2oevClMOrmkMGi_3txNSLzQfYbBydXbOLupOt4F5S2j659A1IUdhzgrBaTv7HEjtTmH5JGkoPk3KEyT2ySYE0ckTRr8N0ftfcbv7-PJjlTLuAxtZeM9U/3jv/bt-Bwh6pS06GsPwSr5-vMQ/h1/lDLv3VXzS1IqKz_CO9TGbq1nKu_pQNrDGony_PqL7hI), political considerations are generally unimportant to me. I didn’t help establish LGBTQ marriage equality and impose the first restrictions on the domestic surveillance state by following the crowd. **Doing the right thing often requires standing up against an uninformed consensus. I’ve done that before, and I’m happy to do it again.** **Before our country gets dragged into yet another war—this time, with a nuclear armed adversary—we implore everyone to take a breath.** Policymakers need to emphasize diplomacy, and restraints on executive power to prevent potential escalation. Journalists need to emphasize accountability, for acts including the 2014 coup that prompted the current conflict. Finally, voters need to remember which candidates chose to prioritize military industrial corruption over the still unmet social needs confronting communities across our country. Ultimately, that's the surest way for Americans to prevent conflicts in the future. **We’re grateful that Washington’s response has remained limited to sanctions up until this point, especially given the continuing risks of military escalation.** Sanctions, however, unfortunately impact civilian populations more than governments or military capacity, so they don’t really offer a meaningful solution. Nor does the route of sanctioning Russian oligarchs—for a particularly disturbing reason: their American counterparts who dominate Congress blocked money laundering laws from reaching the hedge funds and private equity instruments preferred by oligarchs around the world as money laundering vehicles. If you’re as disturbed by human rights abuses as I am, it’s understandable that you’d want to do something in response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine. **One reason so many of us took action against CIA torture and recurring wars-for-profit was so that our country might retain some shred of international legitimacy to challenge abuses of human rights by other countries.** **But Washington failed that invitation, reducing itself to casting stones from a glass house.** Before anyone pretends that the Russian invasion of Ukraine lacks any parallel precedent in U.S. history, we’d invite them to recall the staggering loss of life—and cultures—imposed through the ultimately imperial westward expansion under figures including Andrew Jackson, or the human rights violations that continue en masse at our nation’s borders today. Moments when we feel compelled to action are especially important moments to think about consequences. We remember what happened when war drums beat before, which is why I’m categorically skeptical of any claims that support the interests of the U.S. military industrial establishment. **Human rights and democracy are the values that most concern me. But while I’m concerned about how they’re being violated in Ukraine, I’m frankly more concerned with how they’ve been—and continue—getting violated in Washington.** Thanks for thinking independently! Yours,
Shahid |

clean_body: The Russian invasion of Ukraine has alarmed observers around the world. But the U.S. and NATO lost any legitimacy to intervene long ago. | | | | | Dear Peter, Today’s invasion of Ukraine by Russia has sparked alarm around the world. Anytime civilians are forced to endure violence, outrage and concern are thoroughly appropriate. While many voices have shared concern for human rights and democracy, however, we are compelled to observe that the U.S. has no credible claim to have stood for either of those values over the past half century. In times like these, it’s important to remember the past before repeating its path. Many foolishly clamor for U.S. military intervention, but we remember the recent history in both Ukraine, as well as the United States. Thinking that the Russian invasion of Ukraine justifies a military response erases the history of the region. In 2014, the U.S. supported a right-wing coup in Ukraine that created the conditions for the current conflict. It did not start this week, nor do countries that have long instigated international conflicts (like the United States) have any legitimate claim to later stand for peace. The continuing history of U.S. military industrial corruption is also crucial to consider. The United States is the only country to ever deploy weapons of mass destruction against civilian populations. We’re the only country that embraces extended solitary confinement (recognized across the world as a human rights violation) in our domestic prison system, which imprisons more people than any other country in the world—by far. We’ve intervened in dozens of countries over the past three generations, set up military bases around the world, “tortured some folks” with impunity, assassinated journalists before outrageously prosecuting the publisher who revealed those war crimes, continue to illegally detain thousands of migrants at our nation’s militarized borders, and created a global mass surveillance network. Each of those examples enjoyed widespread bipartisan support. For better or worse, Washington can’t credibly claim to support human rights, leaving NATO with no legitimacy to intervene in Eastern Europe, or frankly anywhere else. As I , political considerations are generally unimportant to me. I didn’t help establish LGBTQ marriage equality and impose the first restrictions on the domestic surveillance state by following the crowd. Doing the right thing often requires standing up against an uninformed consensus. I’ve done that before, and I’m happy to do it again. Before our country gets dragged into yet another war—this time, with a nuclear armed adversary—we implore everyone to take a breath. Policymakers need to emphasize diplomacy, and restraints on executive power to prevent potential escalation. Journalists need to emphasize accountability, for acts including the 2014 coup that prompted the current conflict. Finally, voters need to remember which candidates chose to prioritize military industrial corruption over the still unmet social needs confronting communities across our country. Ultimately, that's the surest way for Americans to prevent conflicts in the future. We’re grateful that Washington’s response has remained limited to sanctions up until this point, especially given the continuing risks of military escalation. Sanctions, however, unfortunately impact civilian populations more than governments or military capacity, so they don’t really offer a meaningful solution. Nor does the route of sanctioning Russian oligarchs—for a particularly disturbing reason: their American counterparts who dominate Congress blocked money laundering laws from reaching the hedge funds and private equity instruments preferred by oligarchs around the world as money laundering vehicles. If you’re as disturbed by human rights abuses as I am, it’s understandable that you’d want to do something in response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine. One reason so many of us took action against CIA torture and recurring wars-for-profit was so that our country might retain some shred of international legitimacy to challenge abuses of human rights by other countries. But Washington failed that invitation, reducing itself to casting stones from a glass house. Before anyone pretends that the Russian invasion of Ukraine lacks any parallel precedent in U.S. history, we’d invite them to recall the staggering loss of life—and cultures—imposed through the ultimately imperial westward expansion under figures including Andrew Jackson, or the human rights violations that continue en masse at our nation’s borders today. Moments when we feel compelled to action are especially important moments to think about consequences. We remember what happened when war drums beat before, which is why I’m categorically skeptical of any claims that support the interests of the U.S. military industrial establishment. Human rights and democracy are the values that most concern me. But while I’m concerned about how they’re being violated in Ukraine, I’m frankly more concerned with how they’ve been—and continue—getting violated in Washington. Thanks for thinking independently! body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW1MGuzH9N

Do any of these names sound familiar to you: Brutus, Publius,
Cato, Cicero, or Cincinnatus? While many Americans today wouldn't
recognize these names
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW1MGuzH9N

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

Do any of
these names sound familiar to you: Brutus, Publius, Cato, Cicero,
or Cincinnatus?

While
many Americans today wouldn't recognize these names, our Founding
Fathers admired and studied these heroes of the Roman Republic.

If you've
ever read The Federalist Papers or visited Cincinnati, Ohio, they
may ring a bell.

That's
because many of our Founders looked at the heroes of the Roman
Republic as models of civic virtue to emulate.

Likewise,
they viewed the descent of Rome into tyranny and discord as a
cautionary tale their new republican form of government was
designed to address.

These are
a few of the reasons we're releasing our newest free online
course, "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," next month.

Our
Founders knew that the Roman Republic provided an essential study
for every person interested in free government, military
strategy, political theory, and the perennial questions of human
nature.

Now you
can learn these same lessons with Hillsdale College...for free!

Remember,
courses like "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" are free
and supported entirely by the generosity of friends like you.

We rely
on the generous funding provided by so many. I want you to know
that a donation is NOT required to experience the full
course-it's truly free and open to all who wish to learn as part
of the College's mission.

So
please, pre-register today, even if you can't make a gift to
support the course or our other educational outreach.

You can
watch the trailer and pre-register now for "The Rise and Fall of
the Roman Republic" at this secure page »

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

Friend,

I’m writing to you with very exciting news. Just like our neighbors to the North in Canada, America’s truckers are fed up with the unscientific and unconstitutional government overreach we’ve endured over the past two years, _and we’re taking action._

**That’s right, a Freedom Convoy driving from California to Washington, D.C. is beginning on March 2nd!** **_[SUPPORT THE CONVOY](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69119%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7%2bbaBhNA0T1w08IJ%2fBwKVQ&sysid=1 "SUPPORT THE
CONVOY")_**
We’ve had enough. Vaccine mandates, mask mandates, lockdowns, and restrictions have all failed to stop the spread of the virus. **As we all know, it stopped being about the virus a long time ago, it’s just about control and power. **

When Justin Trudeau announced he was using terrorism laws to freeze the bank accounts of peaceful protestors in Ottawa without due process, **_HE DIDN’T MENTION COVID ONCE!!!_**

These same tyrannical, thuggish tactics will come to America if we don’t stand up and say ENOUGH IS ENOUGH, **_[which is why we’re asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69110%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dmkK852MOItE1vws8lWqZw&sysid=1 "which is why we’re asking
you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising
platform. ")_**

Your money will go directly to paying for fuel and food for the brave Truckers in the Freedom Convoy. With gas prices skyrocketing under Joe Biden, fuel for the cross country trip is $5,000 per Big Rig!
**_[$15 = 10 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69111%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XLTIoXKxqtVyzZe6W8aE9A&sysid=1 "$15 = 10 Miles")_**
**_[$30 = 20 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69112%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0BlNYRkaAWYUGPVFw502OQ&sysid=1 "$30 = 20 Miles")_**
**_[$150 = 100 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69113%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qwIKzP5klxpVHb4Bi7SFMg&sysid=1 "$150 = 100 Miles")_**
**_[$375 = 250 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69114%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=byabjj7tIplNd9ccZSw4uw&sysid=1 "$375 = 250 Miles")_**
**_[$750 = 500 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69125%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ds38f00h0Zss7PuXeSR7hQ&sysid=1 "$750 = 500 Miles")
[$1,500 = 1,000 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69126%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hRYzG%2bvmsJ06aeel7ejTug&sysid=1 "$1,500 = 1,000
Miles")_**
We the Truckers, and We the People, have had enough of the creeping tyranny, and we’re putting our lives on hold and our livelihoods on the line to get our Freedom back.

**_[So, I hope you’ll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69127%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pbULXmQ4T4anqaryNvAlaw&sysid=1 "So, I hope you’ll join us
as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.")_**

In Liberty,

Truckers for Freedom

**Seaside Park, NJ – America First conservative Mike Crispi today announced that he has signed The New Contract with America pledge and he called on Congressman Chris Smith, (RINO-VA), to do the same.
**
“’ _The New Contract with America’ is exactly what Republicans are clamoring for_ ,” Crispi said. “ _Republicans are looking for bold, conservative, courageous leadership and they’re ready to throw out RINOs who don’t believe in the America First agenda_.”
Rep. Madison Cawthorn’s, (R-NC), New Contract with America is built on ten policy pillars including government spending, education, and immigration; three issues on which Smith has cynically betrayed his Party and his constituents.

Also included among Cawthorn’s policy initiatives is health care... an issue Smith has a particularly troubling relationship with.
“ _Smith and so many of the RINO Swamp creatures love to cast conservative votes that are unlikely to become law but then flip when their votes could truly mean something_ ,” Crispi said. “ _The repeal of Obamacare is the best example. RINOs like Chris Smith and John McCain vowed to repeal Obamacare while Obama was President and was sure to veto their efforts. But as soon as President Trump was elected, they flip-flopped and voted to save Obamacare._ ”****

subject: Former Trump Ambassador to Switzerland Endorses Jake
body:

---
| | For immediate release February 25th, 2022 Contact: (470) 588-2028, news@jakeevans.org
Former Trump Ambassador to Switzerland Endorses Jake
President Trump's U.S. Ambassador to Switzerland Ed McMullen today endorsed Jake Evans for Congress. McMullen acted as chair of Trump's successful 2016 Republican primary campaign in South Carolina, helped plan the Republican National Convention that year and served as vice chair of his inaugural committee while also on the White House transition team. "As U.S. ambassador to Switzerland, I worked closely with members of Congress on issues foreign and domestic. Jake will deliver results for the people and put Americans first," McMullen said. "He's an America First warrior, and that's needed now as we see the consequences of America projecting weakness to the world." "I'm honored to have the support of Ambassador McMullen," Jake said. "He served our nation with distinction and represented the president's priorities well in Switzerland. I appreciate the continued work he's doing to further President Trump's political agenda throughout the country."
---

[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh9slhbjmi1mm64645vpec7rs1ae3t93v0fv2ri8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5ctieeor2cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sljcdr72p30c8qn1pb3e1h3cor56hgrcd3ks3ir4c5gmarjfctie9omcslkeoo6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup3aphheiqjadtie9j32c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj1mj1ptahae3pi0pgnbmfsp87g64b6f50f7sklo_rp22sh2s8i66ob5ctieeor2cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf3ljkdmrmgknvk0d7v16bntof37pt3fda41id48_rp22sh2s8i66ob5ctieeor2cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5bfjbb0qv3aa2jf434gnn3kpgii3spfta0648m8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5ctieeor2cdh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| ICYMI: Governor Eric Greitens Speaks to CPAC
---
| St. Louis, MO - Former Missouri Governor and Navy SEAL Eric Greitens slammed leftist tyranny, pulling no punches during his speech at the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) on Thursday.
As [reported by Big League Politics](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0017UyNwYhAS4uaqgWPi6r1WUAuiuDbaL7N8ZVTWxQcG13E60QQrUJNrYO-DVyK5uoRcrdSU0LTB98etfTGokXkp9f-7UVSWhRXWnEIdQODIjUCOYYnhFFhR1XZnux2kj4r6kcoLx22HSOogK-DaVOuWEcuR-SCyE_Rx5fkwcIK51v5H3QgluZHw0s73EKX9cBiVKHra5J-fXT5bYD4Dqvqy05lPUIz4_2swAWXcBy2ajSncm52vd6eTtlfWmHytB4_Z2MTDEAbnW4_2rMgMdx4wy_Z2WVOBAe8BsihY6N7co_tigND4362P3wnQt8mTGTD&c=AsM8eN9T1ofNfr3sOVnsZblS3ecAB3ak5289TRNEc9_NpFCHCfXnKA==&ch=4eCmB7RjUsbqvQVh4SwuLDm-vobxrV0JvszHwKk8Cui2BTqiO_CiQQ==), Greitens made it clear that the Leftist threat must be crushed, or America will perish, in his speech to CPAC that made it clear he is the America First champion the freedom movement needs in the Senate.
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0017UyNwYhAS4uaqgWPi6r1WUAuiuDbaL7N8ZVTWxQcG13E60QQrUJNrYO-DVyK5uoRSaoyVOLVaMynWvVWec_ki4Z81Acm-NTPP7fGAXvzxVd-EqtqXG0hHlHb5-6i4D61Ba6dMRCNYbr_5c6f0E3GEA==&c=AsM8eN9T1ofNfr3sOVnsZblS3ecAB3ak5289TRNEc9_NpFCHCfXnKA==&ch=4eCmB7RjUsbqvQVh4SwuLDm-vobxrV0JvszHwKk8Cui2BTqiO_CiQQ==)
---
| "We have a mission, and the mission is to take our country back, and we're here to do it!" Greitens said to massive applause, noting that he served as a Navy SEAL and took his oath to the Constitution very seriously.
"The brutal fact is clear: The Left is actively trying to destroy our country. We know the truth," he added. "We are going to stand for our country and we are ready to fight for it."
He noted that he traveled the border, looking at it from the U.S. side as well as the Mexican side, seeing how the waves of third-world invaders are destroying the country. He also mentioned COVID tyranny, critical race theory, defund the police, inflation, and military disasters as ways the Left are trying to destroy America. "A lot of folks in the mainstream media, some RINOs, they say that this is just Joe Biden being senile and Kamala Harris being incompetent, and that is true, they are, but it's more than that. Nobody is this stupid," Greitens said.
"We are in a fight for the soul of our country, and it is a battle against evil," he added, noting that the Left's policies "are rooted in cruelty."
"They spied on candidate Trump, and they spied on President Trump, and we know the truth. We see around the country, the George Soros-funded assault on the rule of law. That is the nature of the enemy we are facing," Greitens said.
Greitens compared the fight modern Americans are engaged in to the fight that the Founding Fathers undertook when they overthrew the British and established the Constitution. He spoke with the urgency that the current political moment deserves.
"You have to make a choice. We have to make a choice. Are we going to stop it? And I'm telling you right now, patriots around the country are rising up and saying we are going to stand for our country and take it back!" he said, adding that "America First patriots," not RINOs will be the heroes who achieve these historic goals.
"I am here to stand with you for the revival!" Greitens said to conclude his rousing speech.

Our February fundraising deadline is just a few days away, so we’ll get straight to the point:

This is serious, Peter. With your help, we’ve built a powerful grassroots movement that’s already put the establishment on notice. But, now that we have their attention, it’s critical that we continue to grow our movement and show our grassroots strength.

If we’re going to unseat a do-nothing incumbent and elect a proud progressive to fight for us in Congress, we need to make our February deadline count. And we only have four days left to do it.
Can you chip in $27 right now to help us meet our February goal and keep the pressure on Donald Payne Jr.? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-february2022?refcode=eom1]

Rep. Payne Jr. has made it clear that he’s only interested in doing the bare minimum. Until we challenged him on his record, he refused to fight against conversion therapy or support a Green New Deal for Schools. March 2nd we’re hitting the road.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3tbtekt2b0los094m1asuv08pdg981bqjofujdo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u2q74spgehr36t376lo78cb0cso67cpichpb9oj4m8q76c3i6li6ap5km2r31o37q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphlciqr8ptmc5j39o5lmgrr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or1clge0p32cdim49fg)

| | |
Friend,

I'm writing to you with very exciting news. Just like our neighbors to the North in Canada, America's truckers are fed up with the unscientific and unconstitutional government overreach we've endured over the past two years, _and we 're taking action._

**That 's right, a Freedom Convoy driving from California to Washington, D.C. is beginning on March 2nd!** **_[SUPPORT THE CONVOY](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z67at7rqm2eogn6c4egv1sibj1q77ipkv8uo1d9g_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "SUPPORT THE CONVOY")_**
We've had enough. Vaccine mandates, mask mandates, lockdowns, and restrictions have all failed to stop the spread of the virus. **As we all know, it stopped being about the virus a long time ago, it's just about control and power. **

When Justin Trudeau announced he was using terrorism laws to freeze the bank accounts of peaceful protestors in Ottawa without due process, **_HE DIDN 'T MENTION COVID ONCE!!!_**

These same tyrannical, thuggish tactics will come to America if we don't stand up and say ENOUGH IS ENOUGH, **_[which is why we're asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj46hkvshdm4orrp0ee5nrci4mjro4jb5pjqdi2o_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "which is why we’re asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.")_**

Your money will go directly to paying for fuel and food for the brave Truckers in the Freedom Convoy. With gas prices skyrocketing under Joe Biden, fuel for the cross country trip is $5,000 per Big Rig!
**_[$15 = 10 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjuenp4cb90bao6r6g1lthv6br2rqll09upe6hl8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$15 = 10 Miles")_**
**_[$30 = 20 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9of4l5g808jc7ljh274l9g2rin8jseblvmj1jfo_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$30 = 20 Miles")_**
**_[$150 = 100 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2za6oi6ij0tdpla81a84288scp1f5cr3p7vcgrgno_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$150 = 100 Miles")_**
**_[$375 = 250 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z11t56u94hcnc4iu8d16mttq6j7ckdut0keh77c8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$375 = 250 Miles")_**
**_[$750 = 500 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbre6glce30ev5kf9nsmp0j74bji14kboj6rlne0_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$750 = 500 Miles")
[$1,500 = 1,000 Miles](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zs8o4r9740mdrnivu4s3d2osjv1dkst8cf4d3qfg_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "$1,500 = 1,000 Miles")_**
We the Truckers, and We the People, have had enough of the creeping tyranny, and we're putting our lives on hold and our livelihoods on the line to get our Freedom back.

**_[So, I hope you'll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb7rtm8ri3ja0andtft5oha8i3dsed9qesoamuog_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3g68oj3clh2bs "So, I hope you’ll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.")_**

In Liberty,

Truckers for Freedom

subject: Who gets your vote for this month's worst Pennsylvanian?

body:
Dear Friend,

We are again asking you to choose this month's WORST Pennsylvanian . Help us pick the winner of March's Marjorie Taylor Greene Award!

And, my, do we have some solidly horrendous candidates for you today! Please choose which of these anti-democracy, corrupt fellas you'd like to honor with this most revolting of titles.

Congressman Mike Kelly: We recently emailed you about this seditious, fraudulent Rep. who is under investigation for his stock purchases. While in D.C., he talks trash about the infrastructure law that would clean up Lake Erie in his district, but then touts the benefits of the money he voted against when he's back home in PA. Hypocrite much?

U.S. Senate Republican candidate David McCormick: This too-rich man with Trump ties and a taste for power has blatantly lied in his television ads — interrupting our playoff football with his b.s! He's a big fan of China though, where his hedge fund has invested heavily. He was also a no-show at the recent gubernatorial debates. Little David was too scared of getting burned by the other candidates — and they brought the fire.

PA State Rep. Kerry Benninghoff: This guy will pull out all the stops when it comes to gerrymandering. He was the lone "no" vote on the new legislative redistricting maps created by the Pennsylvania Legislative Reapportionment Commission (LRC). He tried to “Kerrymander” the map by offering his own amendment rather than voting yes on the one the LRC came up with — the most fair map we’ve seen in decades! Now he's lodging a lawsuit in a feeble attempt to slow the approval process, hoping that the maps can’t be used this election cycle.

What a bunch of delightful humans, right? Do us and yourselves a favor and pick the most particularly foul candidate for this nastiest award.

VOTE: https://www.kpef.info/mtg-poll-feb-2022

Thank you!

Patrick Clark

Peter,

I know — you’re hearing a lot about the February fundraising deadline right now. So, with only four days left in the month, I thought I’d take a moment to tell you why it’s so important.

For the past year, Democrats have been delivering for us in Congress. They’ve passed historic investments in our infrastructure, implemented new supports for working families, and fought to protect our right to vote.

But, the GOP is DETERMINED to win back the majority this year. And they’re raising MILLIONS of dollars to do it. If they succeed, they’ll reverse every bit of progress we’ve made and elevate the terrible policies we’ve seen here in Florida to the national level.

And you know how we can stop them? By winning this race. Keeping FL-10 blue is critical to keeping our Congressional majority and making sure Democrats can continue to deliver results for our community.

That’s why I need your help today. To keep up our momentum and keep spreading the word about our campaign, we need to raise $8,217 more before midnight on Monday. Can you chip in $25 right now to help us do it? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bracy-email?refcode=febeom1]

Thank you for being on my team.

## [**Updates on Russia's Invasion Into Ukraine**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224495/332124996/-707670465?sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224496/332124997/-707670465?sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441) As of noon Thursday, the most recent update out of Ukraine is that Russian forces push into the area surrounding Chernobyl per Ukrainian officials. On early Thursday morning local time in Ukraine, Russian forces invaded the country by way of land, sea, and air. They began with attacks of airports and military buildings all over the country. By the time the sun was setting, Russian special forces had begun pushing into the area surrounding the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv. Although motives of Russian President Vladimir Putin were unclear, American officials believe the attacks to be an attempt to overthrow the Ukrainian government and replacement of Ukraine’s president Vlodymyr Zelensky with a russian puppet regime. Zelensky said on twitter at 9am CT on Feb 24th that Russian forces were attempting to seize Chernoybl, and that this was “a declaration of war against the whole of Europe.” Early Thursday, Putin confirmed that the Russian Military was invading Ukraine. More than 40 Ukrainian soldiers wre killed and dozens more wounded. 18 military officials were killed outside the city of Odessa which was invaded via sea by Russian forces. Explosions began around 10:30 am in Odessa but by noon there was no indication of Russian forces in Odessa. Ukrainian forces stated they shot down multiple Russian aircrafts and a helicopter as battles continue to ensue throughout the country. However, the Ukrainian Army is incredibly outgunned and outmanned by Russian forces, but is believed to be mounting a resistance with Russian carriers being seen damaged. A hundred men ranging in age from twenty to fifty have shown up at a military recruitment office in Kramatorsk heeding a call from Ukraine’s defense minister, Oleksiy Reznikov, to join the military. Reznikov stated “the enemy is attacking, but our army is indestructible. Ukraine is moving into all-out defense mode.” To follow the most recent news coming out of Ukraine, please follow this [link](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224497/332124998/-707670465?sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441).

## [**Texas Governor Attacks Transgender Children**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224498/332124999/-1905181001?fbclid=IwAR0OD0cSMLRrgC-wekBkDD9DgB9s-CIH11MJURhhXuUAQ7mz5fJxZEWAs8A&sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224499/332125000/-1905181001?fbclid=IwAR0OD0cSMLRrgC-wekBkDD9DgB9s-CIH11MJURhhXuUAQ7mz5fJxZEWAs8A&sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441) Texas Governor Greg Abbott said that “licensed professionals” as well as “members of the general public” need to report parents of transgender minors to authorities if it appears that they are receiving gender-affirming medical care. This statement was part of a letter Abbott sent Tuesday to the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services following an opinion from Texas AG Ken Paxton that transition care such as puberty blockers, hormone therapy, and surgery are child abuse under state law. The statement from Paxton came after Legislature failed to “pass a bill that would have made it a felony alongside physical and sexual abuse to provide such care to minors.” Professionals included in Abbotts termed “licensed professionals” include teachers, nurses, and doctors. He also added that these individuals could face criminal penalties for failure to report child abuse per state law. Adri Pérez, policy and advocacy strategist for LGBTQ ewuality at the American Civil Liberties Union of Texas said there is no court in texas or the entire country that has ecer found that gender-affirming care can constitute child abuse. It is currently unclear whether Abbott and Paxton can force the Department of Family and Protective Services and other agencies to investigate these “claims” of child abuse against the parents of trans kids without legislation that would change the law. Christian Menefee, an elected attourney who represents the Department of Family and Child Services said in a statement that Paxton and Abbott are “ignoring medical professionals and intentionally misrepresenting the law to the detriment of transgender chikdren and their families.” He followed this by stating that “(his) office will not participate in these bad faith political games” and that they will “continue to follow the laws on the books and not a politically motivated and and legally incorrect ‘opinion.’”
* * *
## [**A Huge Win Off the Field for the USWNT**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224500/332125001/-69706534?fbclid=IwAR3KbU1ZkM5_0qZFRMfO3cnPbsCFaEBuIZ26eNx-kiAaqgtFhezEPivFSIk&sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42224501/332125002/-69706534?fbclid=IwAR3KbU1ZkM5_0qZFRMfO3cnPbsCFaEBuIZ26eNx-kiAaqgtFhezEPivFSIk&sourceid=1025450&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDk3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDQ3YTgxNC01MDk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIMRBQBA_PlnsNw2oVODpWJxVfBU4q5jMfllVlenGsM=&emci=2d9b1fbc-b995-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e447a814-5096-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9315441) Tuesday marked a huge win for the United States Women’s National Team (USWNT) as they reached an agreement to end a dispute over equal pay with US Soccer. This agreement means that the USWNT will receive an equal rate of pay to the men’s national team for all friendlies and tournaments, which includes the World Cup. The joint statement from US Soccer and the USWNT said “contingent on the negotiation of a new collective bargaining agreement, we have resolved our long standing dispute over equal pay and proudly stand together in a shared commitment to advancing equality in soccer. This agreement means that US Soccer will pay $22 million to the players in the case, as well as $2 million into an account to benefit the USWNT athletes in their post-career goals and charitable efforts in support of women’s and girls soccer.

Here's your weekly roundup of important stories you may have missed both locally and nationally! As of noon Thursday, the most recent update out of Ukraine is that Russian forces push into the area surrounding Chernobyl per Ukrainian officials. On early Thursday morning local time in Ukraine, Russian forces invaded the country by way of land, sea, and air. They began with attacks of airports and military buildings all over the country. By the time the sun was setting, Russian special forces had begun pushing into the area surrounding the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv. Although motives of Russian President Vladimir Putin were unclear, American officials believe the attacks to be an attempt to overthrow the Ukrainian government and replacement of Ukraine’s president Vlodymyr Zelensky with a russian puppet regime. Zelensky said on twitter at 9am CT on Feb 24th that Russian forces were attempting to seize Chernoybl, and that this was “a declaration of war against the whole of Europe.” Early Thursday, Putin confirmed that the Russian Military was invading Ukraine. More than 40 Ukrainian soldiers wre killed and dozens more wounded. 18 military officials were killed outside the city of Odessa which was invaded via sea by Russian forces. Explosions began around 10:30 am in Odessa but by noon there was no indication of Russian forces in Odessa. Ukrainian forces stated they shot down multiple Russian aircrafts and a helicopter as battles continue to ensue throughout the country. However, the Ukrainian Army is incredibly outgunned and outmanned by Russian forces, but is believed to be mounting a resistance with Russian carriers being seen damaged. A hundred men ranging in age from twenty to fifty have shown up at a military recruitment office in Kramatorsk heeding a call from Ukraine’s defense minister, Oleksiy Reznikov, to join the military. Reznikov stated “the enemy is attacking, but our army is indestructible. Ukraine is moving into all-out defense mode.” To follow the most recent news coming out of Ukraine, please follow this . Texas Governor Greg Abbott said that “licensed professionals” as well as “members of the general public” need to report parents of transgender minors to authorities if it appears that they are receiving gender-affirming medical care. This statement was part of a letter Abbott sent Tuesday to the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services following an opinion from Texas AG Ken Paxton that transition care such as puberty blockers, hormone therapy, and surgery are child abuse under state law. The statement from Paxton came after Legislature failed to “pass a bill that would have made it a felony alongside physical and sexual abuse to provide such care to minors.” Professionals included in Abbotts termed “licensed professionals” include teachers, nurses, and doctors. He also added that these individuals could face criminal penalties for failure to report child abuse per state law. Adri Pérez, policy and advocacy strategist for LGBTQ ewuality at the American Civil Liberties Union of Texas said there is no court in texas or the entire country that has ecer found that gender-affirming care can constitute child abuse. It is currently unclear whether Abbott and Paxton can force the Department of Family and Protective Services and other agencies to investigate these “claims” of child abuse against the parents of trans kids without legislation that would change the law. Christian Menefee, an elected attourney who represents the Department of Family and Child Services said in a statement that Paxton and Abbott are “ignoring medical professionals and intentionally misrepresenting the law to the detriment of transgender chikdren and their families.” He followed this by stating that “(his) office will not participate in these bad faith political games” and that they will “continue to follow the laws on the books and not a politically motivated and and legally incorrect ‘opinion.’” Tuesday marked a huge win for the United States Women’s National Team (USWNT) as they reached an agreement to end a dispute over equal pay with US Soccer. This agreement means that the USWNT will receive an equal rate of pay to the men’s national team for all friendlies and tournaments, which includes the World Cup. The joint statement from US Soccer and the USWNT said “contingent on the negotiation of a new collective bargaining agreement, we have resolved our long standing dispute over equal pay and proudly stand together in a shared commitment to advancing equality in soccer. This agreement means that US Soccer will pay $22 million to the players in the case, as well as $2 million into an account to benefit the USWNT athletes in their post-career goals and charitable efforts in support of women’s and girls soccer. body:
Peter —

Yesterday, Ron DeSantis took the stage at CPAC — the GOP’s largest and loudest echo chamber. And you know what he said?

He said that Florida was “the freest state in these United States.”

Pretty ironic, coming from the guy who’s trying his best to turn Florida into an authoritarian dictatorship.

To give you some perspective on the matter, here are just a few of the authoritarian policies DeSantis and his GOP allies are forcing through the legislature right now:

❌ A bill allowing cameras in our classrooms to monitor teachers and students
❌ A bill banning discussion of sexual orientation and gender identity in schools
❌ A bill dictating what teachers can and cannot teach about our history
❌ A bill banning abortion after 15 weeks, without exception for rape, incest, or human trafficking
❌ ANOTHER bill attacking Floridians’ right to vote

Does that sound like freedom to you, Peter?

If we want real freedom, we need to try something new. Nikki is ready to restore our rights, stand against hatred, and bring back the freedom that Governor DeSantis has taken from us. And with our February deadline right around the corner, she needs your help. Can you chip in $20 before the end of the month to join our fight for freedom in Florida? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-feb-2022?refcode=eom1]

Under DeSantis’ watch, Floridians have had our rights stripped away, one by one. And now, he has the nerve to go in front of a national audience and talk about freedom.

No matter what lies he tells to his GOP mega-donors, the truth is that every day DeSantis is in office brings us one step closer to a full blown authoritarian dictatorship.

But together, we can win this race and elect a Governor who will support Florida workers, families, and small businesses, instead of taking away our rights. Click here to chip in $20 and help us do it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-feb-2022?refcode=eom1]

Thank you for helping us bring freedom back to Florida.

— Team Nikki

body:
Can I count on you?
#
Peter, I’m writing to you today because I have something extremely important to ask you. But first, let me explain a bit more about my campaign.
**I’ve spent my career advocating for people** – helping lead the fight for a $15 minimum wage in Illinois and advocating for workplace protections and a fair day’s pay for grocery store workers and meatpackers.
_And now, I want to take that fight to Congress._
Working families in Central and Southern Illinois don’t have a champion for them in Congress, and it’s time for a change. But the Republican holding this seat announced that he’s not running for re-election – so this open seat, one of the most competitive in the country, will be a TOP Republican target.
**[We’re up against far-right Republicans and I need your help if I’m going to withstand the upcoming attacks and win this race. Can I count on you to chip in before my next fundraising deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42227150/332138573/-1903870813?refcode=dd_em_220225_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2ZmZmU1Ni01Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw5SxPRuiaHR9N--ZAXQkw-22W7GHqNfeFvhv0UVBfw=)**
**Goal: $8,234**
**You see, Peter, our fundraising deadlines are crucial.** If we don’t hit our goals each month, we’re facing cuts to our voter outreach efforts and not hiring enough staff to win this race.
But if we hit our goals, we can run an effective campaign and WIN – then I can get to work for Illinois working families.
**So that’s why I need to reach out to you, Peter.** My campaign is funded by everyday folks like you, ready for a change.
**[Can I count on your $5 donation to help us hit our goal before our next deadline? Your generous donation is the fuel of this people-powered campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42227151/332138574/-1903870813?refcode=dd_em_220225_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2ZmZmU1Ni01Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sw5SxPRuiaHR9N--ZAXQkw-22W7GHqNfeFvhv0UVBfw=)**

Fellow Patriot,

A grassroots movement like we've never seen before is sweeping across our country as you read this email. Since we put out the call for the American Truckers Freedom Convoy, thousands of truckers have signed up on our website, and tens of thousands more are organizing with our state captains.
** _[FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK")_**
Why are we trucking across the country in protest? **_Simply put, we've had enough, and we're betting you have, too._**

Tyranny has been sweeping across our country for the past two years; lockdowns, forced masking, vaccine mandates, and many other restrictions.

**The same tyranny swept across Canada too...and our brave brothers and sisters in the Freedom Convoy _lit a spark that's going to ignite the light of liberty in the hearts of every freedom loving man, woman, and child on earth._**

We intend to carry that torch from across the country to Washington, D.C.
** _[FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK")_**
Since the lockdown politicians insisted we give up our liberties in exchange for safety, and one thing has become absolutely clear: **_no politician or government action can slow the spread of COVID-19, they can only accelerate the spread of authoritarianism_**.

That's why we're trucking across the country to Washington D.C., it's time the government gives up their "emergency powers" and returns them to where they belong: the people.
** _[FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "FILL A FREEDOM CONVOY GAS TANK")_**
**Free people don't have to protest for Freedom.**

If we don't act now, **_we'll see the exact same authoritarian takeover our brothers and sisters in Canada are experiencing right here in the USA..._** and half of the country will go along with it because they are afraid of having their bank accounts frozen, human rights suspended, or worse.

Right now, thanks to the overwhelming support from patriots across the country, our convoy is growing larger and larger everyday with Truckers from Fresno, to Bismark, to Cleveland, to Baton Rouge signing up to join.

But, the cost of this convoy grows with every Trucker who signs on, and that's why we're reaching out today to ask you to sponsor a Trucker in what could be the largest peaceful protest in history.
;**_[$15 = 10 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._PFLQNVyJwcDNY5Jw "$15 = 10 Miles")_**
** _[$30 = 20 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "$30 = 20 Miles")_**
** _[$75 = 50 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._bmuuQ "$75 = 50 Miles")_**
** _[$150 = 100 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "$150 = 100 Miles")_**
** _[$375 = 250 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._h9fvuQ "$375 = 250 Miles")_**
** _[$750 = 500 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-drKYp6N9bA "$750 = 500 Miles")_**
** _[$1,500 = 1,000 Miles](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._YW1vdW50PTE1MDAifQ/c35CCch_KUG8pE1NRK3ZCg "$1,500 = 1,000 Miles")_**
** _[$5,000 = FULL TRIP](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._YW1vdW50PTUwMDAifQ/6GHIBVCgsV21gLPuiL7TRA "$5,000 = FULL TRIP")_**
The Freedom Convoy must be the movement heard around the world, and we're asking for your most generous gift to make that a reality.

**[Can you cover the cost of fuel for 50 miles for one of our Freedom Truckers?](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._g13vu3WzigEIRaLMeQ "Can you cover the cost of fuel for 50 miles for one of our Freedom Truckers?")**

The time is now to take patriotic, beautiful, peaceful action, or we may never regain the freedoms we once had. **_We're not in the business of telling our children and their children what it was like when America was free,[but we can't do it alone.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-w "but we can't do it alone.")_**

**[Help fuel our convoy as we take direct action to regain our freedoms and ensure we never lose our liberty again.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "Help fuel our convoy as we take direct action to regain our freedoms and ensure we never lose our liberty again.")**

Honk Honk,

American Truckers Freedom Fund

| | Peter, When Laura was 27 years old, she visited Annapolis, Maryland, where she had the opportunity to go sailing on the Chesapeake Bay. It left such an impression on her, she moved there two weeks later. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42228760/332146330/902423312?refcode=EM_BS_NEU_220225_FR_EOM3Bay_A0_na_U1_X1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDkyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmVjZGM1Zi01Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e-h_AxorMSwNF27OwGq5bCvy5f0gMK-y_f4VbS15mSQ=) She and her family love paddle boarding on the bay, and many tourists visit the bay to do the same. Tourism on the Chesapeake Bay is a huge part of the region’s economy, but climate change poses a serious threat. Warming oceans and rising sea levels threaten the bay’s ecosystem – the migration patterns of some of the bay’s sealife has already shifted, and rising temperatures threaten the lives of much of the biodiversity in the bay. If the creatures that filter extra nutrients out of the bay find the bay uninhabitable, the clear waters may soon become murky and lead to a drop in tourism. Not to mention, the bay and its fisheries are hugely important to Maryland’s economy. If the water warms to inhabitable levels for the fish, this industry and the jobs it creates will all but be destroyed. As Governor, Laura will fight for environmental protections and policies that will protect the bay and the creatures that inhabit it. The effects of climate change are taking place before our eyes, and too many politicians are doing nothing to stop it. clean_body: | = | | Peter, When Laura was 27 years old, she visited Annapolis, Maryland, where she had the opportunity to go sailing on the Chesapeake Bay. It left such an impression on her, she moved there two weeks later. = She and her family love paddle boarding on the bay, and many tourists visit the bay to do the same. Tourism on the Chesapeake Bay is a huge part of the region’s economy, but climate change poses a serious threat. Warming oceans and rising sea levels threaten the bay’s ecosystem – the migration patterns of some of the bay’s sealife has already shifted, and rising temperatures threaten the lives of much of the biodiversity in the bay. If the creatures that filter extra nutrients out of the bay find the bay uninhabitable, the clear waters may soon become murky and lead to a drop in tourism. Not to mention, the bay and its fisheries are hugely important to Maryland’s economy. If the water warms to inhabitable levels for the fish, this industry and the jobs it creates will all but be destroyed. As Governor, Laura will fight for environmental protections and policies that will protect the bay and the creatures that inhabit it. body:
Peter,

Yesterday, President Biden addressed the nation about the current humanitarian crisis in the wake of Russia's attack on Ukraine. In response, President Biden announced the United States will impose new strong economic sanctions against Russia.

Russia's unprovoked aggression against Ukraine is illegal and a reckless breach of global peace and stability. We must work with our allies to hold Putin and the Russian government accountable.

I commend President Biden's actions for supporting our allies and doing everything we can to help Ukraine during this challenging time. I am continuing to pray for Ukraine and the Ukrainian people throughout this humanitarian crisis.

It's an honor to serve you,

Derek

| | CHERNOBYL, Ukraine — Without a moral foreign policy based on ethical grounds, the United States would not be a world leader. Our global actions must be founded on justice, courage, integrity, equality under the law, Democratic freedom, temperance, and unity. Without these principles, _all_ of our international policies will fall on deaf ears. This is the foundation of our decision-making in the Foreign Service as diplomats, and I urge world leaders to apply it to the Ukraine crisis.**** **— Important facts —** **From the perspective of International Law:** We need to honor our commitment as a signatory of the [**Budapest Memorandum**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42229187/332147557/1782772808?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTA3MDhiMC01Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h_ZiXyKIb3NwcZGOvVp1vrj5Z1wT9bGSzRDx6fHNpY0=&emci=987527d5-5996-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=8e0708b0-5c96-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) from 1994. This agreement guarantees security for Ukraine, conditional on nuclear non-proliferation. After the fall of the Soviet Union, the then-newly independent country surrendered leftover nuclear weapons in exchange for security assurances, political independence, and territorial integrity. **From a social and political viewpoint:** The social divisions that gripped our nation and others over the last 25 years — along with the growth of populist threats to our democracy — have facilitated Putin and the Russian government's aggression. **From an economic perspective:** In 2013, Russia's GDP was $2.4 trillion. After Crimea sanctions, it plummeted to $1.2 trillion in 2016 and hovers around $1.4 trillion today. Under Putin's leadership, Russia cannot grow without taking from others. He is seeking to repair his failed state by annexing other countries. Countries that make up the former Soviet Union could nearly double Russia's monetary and market value. **From a diplomatic stance:** Wednesday, the American Foreign Service Association stated, "[We] watched in horror as Russia shattered the post-WWII and post-Cold War settlements." The world order was stabilized after the fall of the Soviet Union with established rules:
* No forcible change of borders.
* Respect for every nation's sovereignty.
* Respect territorial integrity.
* Reject historical grievances as justification for aggression.

As Kenyan U.N. Ambassador Martin Kimani [**so eloquently stated**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42229188/332147559/66499828?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTA3MDhiMC01Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h_ZiXyKIb3NwcZGOvVp1vrj5Z1wT9bGSzRDx6fHNpY0=&emci=987527d5-5996-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=8e0708b0-5c96-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) at the Security Council, "Failure to uphold and respect all current borders is a recipe for bloody chaos and endless war."

The United States must act without military intervention or endangering U.S. troops. The blame for aggression lies solely with the Russian government and **_not_** its citizens. Therefore, the United States must target and punish Putin and his cronies. These sanctions need to be strong, durable and imposed immediately. Secondly, we cannot resist the Russian government alone, we work with all of our international allies in unity. **"There may be times when we are powerless to prevent injustice, but there must never be a time when we fail to protest... We must always take sides. Neutrality helps the oppressor, never the victim. Silence encourages the tormentor, never the tormented." ― Elie Wiesel, Holocaust Survivor, Nobel Laureate** With the exception of President Trump, every former living U.S. president — Democrat and Republican — supports [**censuring Vladimir Putin.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42229190/332147563/400648341?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTA3MDhiMC01Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h_ZiXyKIb3NwcZGOvVp1vrj5Z1wT9bGSzRDx6fHNpY0=&emci=987527d5-5996-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=8e0708b0-5c96-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) "People of conscience around the world need to loudly and clearly condemn Russia's actions and offer support for the Ukrainian people," [**said President Obama.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42229191/332147564/-1049719336?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTA3MDhiMC01Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h_ZiXyKIb3NwcZGOvVp1vrj5Z1wT9bGSzRDx6fHNpY0=&emci=987527d5-5996-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=8e0708b0-5c96-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) "And every American, regardless of party, should support President Biden's efforts, in coordination with our closest allies, to impose hard-hitting sanctions on Russia – sanctions that impose a real price on Russia's autocratic elites." Now is the time for the United States of America to lead. We must be united and steadfast in our resolve, confident in our morality, and determined to win the peace and prosperity that all people of conscience seek. — Dr. Bob Lorinser

Perhaps one thing Bryan and I agree on is the importance of gun laws in Wisconsin, but let's be clear here, we are _not_ on the same side of this issue.

Bryan Steil has refused to advocate for the common sense gun prevention laws that will keep us all safe, but rather he has repeatedly voted against gun control legislation. An overwhelming 80% of Wisconsin voters support expanding background checks on all firearm sales and stronger gun control laws, but Steil doesn't care what the people of Wisconsin want. So we have to ask, **who exactly is Bryan Steil working for in Congress?**

Gun laws are only one issue, and I think we have bigger priorities here in Wisconsin's 1st -- like making sure folks have enough to eat, are able to make rent payments, and have accessible and affordable healthcare.

[](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/TisS763uSirIZDl5xBD3sd5g/763qzyihAfLbA1XAC3763j5QYA) I’ve never done anything like this before.

I’m no politician, I can’t stand them . . . and that’s [**why I’m running against them in the Virginia senate**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/TisS763uSirIZDl5xBD3sd5g/763qzyihAfLbA1XAC3763j5QYA).

My name is Matt Strickland. I’m a former Army Combat Medic and served as a civilian contractor with Blackwater. I’ve seen a lot of combat, but never expected to have to go to combat against my own government. . . **but that’s what happened**.

I own a restaurant with my beautiful wife, Maria. And last year, Virginia’s Democrat Governor Ralph Northam ordered me to close my restaurant because I refused to mask my employees & customers.

No joke.

Now, my father raised me with certain values.

**One of those is to never back down when you’re in the right!**

I didn’t back down! Maria and I didn’t close the restaurant and we fought Northam and his cronies in court . . . **and we won!**

And now, I need your help to win a Senate seat so I can take the fight to them! [**Please donate to my campaign with as much as you can give.**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/TisS763uSirIZDl5xBD3sd5g/763qzyihAfLbA1XAC3763j5QYA)

I learned a lot from the battle against the Governor.

**First, politicians don’t give a crap about you if you can’t do anything for them.**

They won’t even return a call . . . and they didn’t return mine, until patriots around the state started rallying around me. Then all of those politicians wanted in!

They started scheduling events at my restaurant, posing for pictures with me and offering me flags and awards . . . which I declined.

We need leaders in government who get it. Leaders who understand that we DON’T need the government in our businesses, our homes or in the lives of our children.

We want them to stay the hell away from us!

And the only way that will happen is if men and women like you and me stand up and take the reigns.

Help me do that today by [**backing my campaign with any donation that you can provide**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/TisS763uSirIZDl5xBD3sd5g/763qzyihAfLbA1XAC3763j5QYA).

Thanks and stay tuned.

Respectfully,

Matt Strickland
Candidate
Virginia Senate

P.S. While I beat back Virginia’s governor, the bureaucrats are still going after me. They pulled my liquor license and tried to fine me. But if you’re ever thirsty for a drink, stop in and see me at Gourmeltz, near Fredericksburg, Virginia. We’re still serving and won’t be stopping anytime soon! [**Thanks again for your support and donate here.**](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/TisS763uSirIZDl5xBD3sd5g/763qzyihAfLbA1XAC3763j5QYA)
