#
Peter,
Since day one of the Biden Administration, Democrats have been working to lower costs for families, including delivering the biggest middle-class tax cuts in history through the American Rescue Plan. We've got plans in the works to make child care affordable, lower health care costs, protect our planet, and a whole lot more, because our goal is to build a bright future and an economy that works for all of us, not just those at the very top.
And for weeks, we've been asking Republicans: if you don't like our plans, where are yours?

And for weeks, we've been asking Republicans: if you don't like our plans, where are yours? This week, they gave us an answer: an ultraconservative agenda that includes a tax hike on over half of Americans, including retirees. And remember, this is after Republicans passed deficit-exploding tax breaks for big corporations under President Trump. It’s clearer than ever: if Democrats win in November, we’ll keep fighting to lower costs for families and make our economy work for all of us. body:

---
Friend, It's been another B.I.G. week for us, but before we share our updates I want to ask you to join us in prayer for the people of Ukraine, as well as for our military. Last night, we learned that around 3,800 troops stationed at Fort Stewart will be deploying overseas. May God bless them and their families.
---
---
# **_Anytime, Anyplace_**
---
|
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/ca700934d08e86bfc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
|
---
I'm ready to debate Herschel Walker anytime, anyplace. Georgia Republicans expect and deserve a real conversation about the issues BEFORE the primary on May 24th. [**If you agree that this is important, SHARE our video calling on Herschel to debate.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/d7358bd72e5175bcc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# **_Barnstorming Georgia_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/bf6cc041572d8550c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
B.I.G. crowds at our events across the state this week! Thank you to everyone who joined us — for your encouragement, your questions, and your support. And thank you to the local media who covered these events. We're reaching more voters every single day. Read some coverage of our events: [**Moultrie Observer: Gary Black brings Senate campaign to Colquitt County**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/58e84a30b75d1976c3d6b838967d376c/37793) [**WALB: U.S. Senate candidate Gary Black brings campaign trail to Sparks**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/d338835b50ed069cc3d6b838967d376c/37793) [**Thomasville Times-Enterprise: State ag chief touts his credentials for U.S. Senate run in Cairo stop**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/e75367893d5fcd34c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# ** _Ten X_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/cebef873a942f91ac3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
I want to thank the folks at Ten X in Sparks for a great tour of their facility, and for the opportunity to shoot a 1943 model Thompson submachine gun — one which literally was on the beach at Normandy. Amazing experience! [**Click above or here to watch a video from the tour.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/f7d422ce99ccb9d0c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# **_Qualifying Day!_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/1e6603c97522c9c1c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
On Monday, March 7th, I'll officially qualify to appear on the ballot as a candidate for the U.S. Senate. That evening, we're having a celebration at our campaign headquarters and I hope you'll join us! Join us for food, fun, and fellowship — and some special guests might be there too. **[Claim your spot here!](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/63b29d3321f3eb2dc3d6b838967d376c/37793) **
---
---
# **_Join Us On March 10th!_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/a3586e4b3695a9bec3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
[**Our 515 BBQ and Rally is also rapidly approaching and I hope you'll purchase your ticket here or at the door!**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/f16c532cfba52f0bc3d6b838967d376c/37793) They're going fast, and you don't want to miss this B.I.G. event.
---
---
# **_One More Thing_**
---
Please follow our campaign's [**Facebook**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/746695c2c5586eafc3d6b838967d376c/37793), **[Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/7ed9963be62d4846c3d6b838967d376c/37793)** , and [**Instagram**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/1784857ce4fbafc9c3d6b838967d376c/37793) pages if you aren't already, and make sure 10 of your friends are too! We're more than halfway into this fundraising quarter, and this will be our LAST quarterly fundraising deadline before the May primary. It's vital that we make a strong showing so we have the resources to reach voters down the stretch. [**Please donate whatever you can here.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/14b18d2b4929652dc3d6b838967d376c/37793) Thank you again for your friendship, prayers, and support!
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/80ae30b90dbdb388c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Gary Black
---
[**DONATE NOW »**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/d78a286077de8749c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/bf7795ec483bf10b/a4663502a1cb742bc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
I couldn’t be prouder to have you on our team, and your support is absolutely crucial to our efforts. Here’s why.
Raphael Warnock has already stockpiled $23 million to keep this seat, and with it the U.S. Senate, in Democrat hands. name: Derek Marshall
subject: Did you see? We need a better foreign policy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Derek Marshall for Congress
body:
Peter,
It’s with a heavy heart that I woke up yesterday morning to the news of Russia’s brutal invasion of Ukraine. **Words, thoughts, and prayers cannot help the people of Ukraine now, but our government does have the power to make a real difference in their lives.** What America does now matters.
We know that Russian imperialism never really ended, only took on new forms. We are seeing the consequences of fascism and authoritarianism play out in front of our eyes. **When political leaders isolate themselves from the rest of the world and shun our globalized society, it puts themselves and their people at risk. **
But as our leaders know, we are all interconnected. President Biden, alongside European nations, has instated severe economic sanctions in response to Russia’s violent invasion. **But these sanctions, like the ones leveled at Russia after the invasion of Crimea, are designed to cripple the entire Russian economy.** That means regular people, Russians who don’t want this war, will face the consequences of one man’s rash actions.
**Today, it is the everyday Ukrainians and Russians who I am thinking of, those whose lives have been turned upside down overnight.** Ukrainians who have to flee or face life and death situations, and Russians who never asked for war but will pay for it anyway.
The working class is not responsible for Russia’s invasion, Putin and his generals are. **Our sanctions should be carefully crafted to hit those with power in Russia the hardest: the oligarchs and members of Putin’s inner circle.** The clear path forward is to cut these wealthy Russians off from their resources, and deny them access to European and American banking. If they feel the impacts of our international pressure, so will Putin.
I’ve said before that I plan to sit on the Foreign Affairs Committee as a future Member of Congress.**I believe in a long-term approach to foreign policy, one that seeks peace and privileges diplomacy over military interventions.** No doubt, the Ukrainian people must defend themselves against this threat to their sovereignty. But we here in America must also prepare to support the Ukrainian people however we can.
We must welcome those who come to our shores to seek refuge. **As we saw with the withdrawal of our troops from Afghanistan, every military conflict, no matter the intention, creates circumstances where people must flee their homes.** And as with Afghanistan, the U.S. is not wholly prepared to accept those who need our help now. It’s time for us to create a new framework around immigration and asylum, one that prioritizes our humanity over our borders.
And as we look to the future, we must consider the crucial changes to our economy and society that will allow us to withstand the impacts of the kind of sanctions we have leveled against Russia. **There is a lot of talk of our reliance on imported “foreign” oil, and there are some who would respond to this crisis by increasing our domestic production of fossil fuels. **
The way forward is to invest heavily in the technology needed to create a society that runs on renewable energy, not dirty energy. **We can address the climate crisis and safeguard ourselves from global economic changes like the one we are currently experiencing. **
**We do not need to rely on the same old failed tactics that have brought us to where we are today, whether we’re talking about war or energy policy.** We can and must do better. Change is slow, but I do believe it is coming.

In solidarity,
**Derek Marshall**
Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23

And as we look to the future, we must consider the crucial changes to our economy and society that will allow us to withstand the impacts of the kind of sanctions we have leveled against Russia. There is a lot of talk of our reliance on imported “foreign” oil, and there are some who would respond to this crisis by increasing our domestic production of fossil fuels. The way forward is to invest heavily in the technology needed to create a society that runs on renewable energy, not dirty energy. We can address the climate crisis and safeguard ourselves from global economic changes like the one we are currently experiencing. We do not need to rely on the same old failed tactics that have brought us to where we are today, whether we’re talking about war or energy policy. We can and must do better. Change is slow, but I do believe it is coming. In solidarity, Derek Marshall Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23 * Paid for by Derek Marshall for Congress. P.O. Friend,

I'm writing to you with very exciting news. Just like our neighbors to the North in Canada, America's truckers are fed up with the unscientific and unconstitutional government overreach we've endured over the past two years, _and we 're taking action._

**That 's right, a Freedom Convoy driving from California to Washington, D.C. is beginning on March 2nd!**
**_[SUPPORT THE CONVOY](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm8d0h5pt4c4itvgn7p432ih0bjakb5jri5touvo_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "SUPPORT THE CONVOY")_**
We've had enough. Vaccine mandates, mask mandates, lockdowns, and restrictions have all failed to stop the spread of the virus. **As we all know, it stopped being about the virus a long time ago, it's just about control and power. **

When Justin Trudeau announced he was using terrorism laws to freeze the bank accounts of peaceful protestors in Ottawa without due process, **_HE DIDN 'T MENTION COVID ONCE!!!_**

These same tyrannical, thuggish tactics will come to America if we don't stand up and say ENOUGH IS ENOUGH, **_[which is why we're asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2d672o89rhhg8qj68git8m1vfo3d1jrhgucvro0_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "which is why we’re asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.")_**

Your money will go directly to paying for fuel and food for the brave Truckers in the Freedom Convoy. With gas prices skyrocketing under Joe Biden, fuel for the cross country trip is $5,000 per Big Rig!
**_[$15 = 10 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq84nu79s288pfk91lb6ea9bghs6iog1a01nh1rg_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$15 = 10 Miles")_**

**_[$30 = 20 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6g4lfbb4afhj5cfn2pmaq08vujd288ak7pebt8o_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$30 = 20 Miles")_**

**_[$150 = 100 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr15bsg0b7hei1hup18i0j1j4dfb5mhmpv7s5o78_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$150 = 100 Miles")_**

**_[$375 = 250 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zomt7r40pp1s919rv8ahng2doroqhdghiqikqkhg_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$375 = 250 Miles")_**

**_[$750 = 500 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5l650prjp544u863tlv0351co1dm475rgtddi0g_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$750 = 500 Miles")

[$1,500 = 1,000 Miles](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq66ln4d0b0ad1urvg60rojg5ek2c742tvek3ki8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "$1,500 = 1,000 Miles")_**
We the Truckers, and We the People, have had enough of the creeping tyranny, and we're putting our lives on hold and our livelihoods on the line to get our Freedom back.

**_[So, I hope you'll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl4gik4cksa56f5nd15q0b063f856qmgqtrdqh68_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i6aor2clh2bs "So, I hope you’ll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.")_**

In Liberty,

Truckers for Freedom

_Hi, Peter! The state legislative session just closed, and Gov. Lujan Grisham was able to make bold progress because of your grassroots support. Today, we wanted to highlight some of our biggest achievements._
|
---
**Free Higher Education **
The state legislature just passed Gov. Lujan Grisham's New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship Act, which will provide FREE higher education to every eligible New Mexican student.

Not only will this law remove financial barriers to accessing education, but it will also allow more New Mexicans to work in high-demand fields like teaching, medicine, and trades. It's a big win for both families and businesses across our state.
|
---
**Pay Raises for Educators **
Gov. Lujan Grisham believes that New Mexico's educators deserve better compensation. That's why she called on the state legislature to raise teacher base salaries by an average of 20% – and the state legislature just unanimously voted to pass her bill.

Raising pay for educators will attract the best teachers in the region, increase teacher retention, and keep students physically in school during our country's teacher shortage.
|
---
**Cutting Taxes **
In a bipartisan vote, the House and Senate passed legislation to cut taxes. The bill will eliminate the tax on Social Security benefits for most seniors, create a Child Tax Credit to support working families, and cut gross receipts taxes for the first time in 40 years.

Once this law is enacted, it will keep nearly $200 million in the pockets of New Mexicans statewide, which is a priority for Gov. Lujan Grisham as she continues to provide relief and support for New Mexico families.
|

name: Hendrell Remus
subject: Black History is our Present
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tndemocraticparty [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tndemocraticparty]

We're nearing the end of Black History Month, Peter, and I feel compelled to talk about the issues that are still relentlessly facing Black Tennesseans. Younger generations may not realize this, but North Nashville's historic Jefferson Street was once a lively center for the city's Black middle class, centered around critical institutions like TSU, Fisk University and Meharry College. It was also a hub for thriving entertainment, with legends such as Jimi Hendrix and Etta James performing in clubs along the street.

But all of this would change in the 1960s when the government decided to carve North Nashville up by routing I-40 right through the middle of it, leveling business hubs and displacing residents. White developers weaponized infrastructure funding to harm Black communities to create wealthy white suburbs. They didn't want the highway to disrupt property values in areas that would affect them, so instead, they decided to decimate a Black-majority community. According to the Nashville Scene [https://www.nashvillescene.com/news/coverstory/history-repeats-itself-in-north-nashville/article_bf8a4e00-a16a-5236-85ea-b16910acd996.html] , this led to the leveling of 650 homes, displacing 1,400 residents. Black residents lost generational and communal wealth because of the plummeting real estate values.

Today, North Nashville is an economically vulnerable community because of the racist decisions made in years past. The neighborhood around Jefferson Street has an incarceration rate of 14% [https://www.brookings.edu/blog/up-front/2018/03/14/5-facts-about-prisoners-and-work-before-and-after-incarceration/] , the highest in the nation. Child poverty is 42%. The obstacles facing North Nashvillians because of bigoted government decisions unfortunately aren't unique — compounding bad policies over the course of decades has caused disproportionate harm to Black Tennesseans.

Despite these barriers, North Nashville remains home to incredible community members and businesses who have shown tremendous resilience and self-determination. But we need people in government who will give Tennessee communities like North Nashville the resources and support they deserve.

Black Tennesseans have made our state what it is today. Through activism and centuries of struggle, Black people have helped to more fully realize what a true, multi-racial democracy should be — what it can be. We intend to work every day to help build a Tennessee and an America that reflects that vision, one where the color of your skin and the zip code you're born in doesn't determine your future. An America where we've achieved true equity and liberation for all.

Solidarity,

Hendrell Remus
he/him
Chair, Tennessee Democratic Party

| Dear Neighbor,
Thank you for the tremendous support you have shown the campaign during early voting. The number of positive emails, texts, and calls the campaign has received has been both overwhelming and humbling. However, we can't let up just yet. Today is the last day of early voting before Election Day on Tuesday. Take your friends, neighbors, anyone that has not yet voted, to the polls to continue our positive momentum. The headlines from this week have once again demonstrated that elections have grave consequences. We all watched with heavy hearts as Russia invaded Ukraine, catapulting Eastern Europe into war. These actions are a direct result of President Biden's poor decision making and his inability to lead through strength. Error after error, his administration has only emboldened our enemies, and pushed Russia and China into a dangerous alliance. When Biden presented China with information on Russia's troop build-up, hoping that China would intervene, China instead shared that intelligence with Russia. Over the past 48 hours, Xi Jinping has committed his support to Putin and the Russian side of the Ukrainian invasion and has also taken his first step to assist Russia by lifting all wheat-import restrictions on the country.
Biden and current D.C. leadership have also devastated our oil & gas industry, making us dependent upon foreign oil. Just yesterday, a Russian oil tanker sailed into the Port of Houston. You read that correctly. Thanks to current leadership and climate change zealots, the United States, a country that was a net exporter of oil & gas just a few short years ago, is now buying oil from Russia.
We are no longer a serious country, nor are we one that is currently in any kind of position to dictate - anything - to the world because we are so dependent upon them for oil.
---
As I have mentioned before, elections do matter. Make no mistake, we are in this current situation because our leaders have failed. It's vital to both our nation and to the stability of the world that we vote for those who will lead through strength and make decisions that are in the best interest of us and our country. Get out to the polls to make your voice heard. Take your family. Take your friends. The voting locations are open until 7:00pm.
Let's finish early voting strong!

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I’m very humbly asking you to help my husband, Mark Kelly, knock his February deadline fundraising goal out of the park. Will you pitch in anything you can before it ends?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Friends —
I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, Mark, with a contribution before his February fundraising deadline ends. He needs your help to hold Arizona’s Senate seat. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important.
I personally know just how hard these campaigns can be. National Republicans see people like Mark, who is independent and puts his constituents first, as a problem. That’s why we always knew that outside groups would come out in force, spending unprecedented amounts of money to try and take back this Senate seat in 2022.
And they’ve already started.
One of Mark’s opponents has the backing of a $10 million super PAC. Another has promised to personally spend $50 million in this race. National Republicans have already spent millions of dollars attacking Mark. And Donald Trump flew to Arizona to hold a rally and said, “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
So, it's clear Trump and National Republicans see beating Mark as one of their top priorities this year.
Mark needs our help to fight off these attacks, and the best way to do that is by lots and lots of people contributing what they can before this February fundraising deadline comes to an end.
Right now we’re short of where we need to be — and we cannot afford to end the month behind our goals. So, please:
[**If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to Mark’s people-powered campaign before this February fundraising deadline ends? We’re counting on you to help us reach our goals.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-feb22?refcode=em220225-1-subs&t=1&refcode2=2175_6688874_c2btTD&akid=2175%2E6688874%2Ec2btTD)

| Dear ,

Yesterday, I joined a group of protesters in Prince William County in opposing the development of a new data center that would corrupt the landscape of the Manassas National Battlefield Park.

For years on the Prince William County Board of Supervisors I have proudly stood for smart development, working with developers and interest groups to make decisions that are good for residents of Prince William County, while also protecting and conserving our rural areas and historic sites.

This particular project would be a blight on the landscape of the Manassas Battlefield and would devastate the landscape of one of our most historic sites. [You can watch NBC4 Washington's coverage of the protest here, including my interview at the event.](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=7f02bf1823&e=fc83fb200d)

---
| [ ](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=7506a4a0e2&e=fc83fb200d)
---
|
For months, I have been asking Representative Jennifer Wexton to weigh in on this issue and join us in our efforts to preserve history. Sadly, Representative Wexton has done nothing more than send a singular letter to the Board of Supervisors asking them to "consider carefully." Unfortunately, this kind of lack-luster language is far too common from the Democrats that represent us.

Now, I'm running against Jennifer Wexton to represent the constituents of Virginia's 10th Congressional District.

In Congress I will continue to defend our history and put an end to the destructive agenda of the radical left. Democrats would like to see our history buried under new construction and removed from our public education system. I think it is important that our history is preserved, and that our children have the opportunity to learn the history of our great country.

**[Will you join me today by contributing $100, $50, $25, or even just $10 to help me defeat Jennifer Wexton and stop the destructive agenda of the radical left? ](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=3f1a97a898&e=fc83fb200d)**

Weak American leadership comes with a heavy price. For over 75 years America has ensured the security of Western Europe and Asia. Tragically, that ended this week when Russia invaded and brutally attacked its neighbor, Ukraine.
Those who seek to supplant freedom and democracy, like Putin and China's Xi, were emboldened by weak Democratic leadership in Washington. Joe Biden, Raphael Warnock, Chuck Schumer and Nancy Pelosi are presiding over an America which invites the world's oppressors to do as they will. From the hasty and botched Afghanistan exit to abandoning the drive for American energy independence to forcing a new Woke religion on our citizens and our brave men and women in uniform, our Democratic leaders are surrendering our place in the world. body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8f19ks8abab7ejh4ngr4ab5bs46mudivp1g65t8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i69oj1c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfddjgearb0p3hc2rjbd71cdp71pji6dp3co70s5r67chlcpp37d3gmmpb4t74s3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coqm9ddkc1r62pjkssqr4ptgmlin49fg)

---
| | Greetings Friend, I have something a little unusual for you today. It’s about our upcoming online course, and I’d like to share with you some of the reasons why we produced it. We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire, powerful (and sometimes mad) emperors, and grand architecture. But obscured by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. In fact, Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic. The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian Peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a fascinating tale of political achievement, military genius, and the perils of success. In March, to help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we will release our newest free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** And I wanted you to be one of the first to know. Because you’ve helped make these free online courses possible, I’d like to share an exclusive video from the new course with you. You can watch the video we’ve prepared for you and pre-register for the new course right here:
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhvv2l76h84nfuh31gmubkg05ck32fnh9lfna7f8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i69oj1c5h2bs)
---
| | Friend, the history of the Roman Republic is full of moral exemplars and cautionary tales. In the course, Hillsdale College professors Ken Calvert and Carl Young also show how America’s Founding Fathers looked to the republican heroes of Rome to serve as models of statesmanship and virtue. Learning their history can show us the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way. That’s why we are releasing this new, free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** on the Ides of March—March 15. ** **You can watch your exclusive video at the secure link below.** [_**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/roman-republic-preregister/**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z08n3tvp0083sctidss1req2223g1npi4jjasbto_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i69oj1c5h2bs)__ After watching the video, I hope you will pre-register to take the full, free course. **And after you pre-register for this important, new course, will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift?** **Your generous gift will help us reach our $150,000 funding goal to promote this course and our other educational efforts nationwide.** And, for a gift of any size, we’ll send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course and will help you locate many of the places and events discussed in the lectures. _ __ Given the state of our republic, we must get this new course in front of as many Americans as possible. There’s another reason your support is vital... As you may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding—even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That means that these courses, along with everything else we do here, depend on the generous, private support of friends like YOU, Friend. Please help us enroll as many Americans as possible in **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** so we can learn from Rome’s history and find hope where they failed. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College P.S. On the Ides of March (March 15), we’re releasing our newest free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic.”** We’ve produced the course because the history of the Roman Republic provides one of the greatest stories of political and military achievement in human history—and reveals the difficulties and dangers presented by this kind of success.** You can watch a video preview for the course and pre-register using this secure link: [_**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/roman-republic-preregister/**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zco0jvc541vdtj4blhqagtn1q131en3c4qms1hv8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5c3i69oj1c5h2bs) Please help us enroll as many Americans as possible in **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** so we can discover the lessons of the greatest republic of the ancient world.
---

Sometimes it’s hard for me to believe we’ve been working for almost 10 years to make our communities safer from gun violence.
#

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-feb22?refcode=em220225-1-15&t=1&refcode2=1622_3935704_0CFuLW&akid=1622%2E3935704%2E0CFuLW)

Friends -
Sometimes it’s hard for me to believe we’ve been working for almost 10 years to make our communities safer from gun violence.
Along the way, we’ve won some great victories in states across the country. There is no doubt in my mind that in doing so, we have saved countless lives.
We’ve also suffered some difficult setbacks that force us to summon the courage to keep moving on. I know that feeling well.
We must continue to fight. The gun lobby is in financial and legal trouble, and it’s clear the American people are on our side. But there is so much work to be done.
However, I cannot take on this fight alone. I need you with me. So I am asking:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Giffords today to help us continue our lifesaving work to change our gun laws?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-feb22?refcode=em220225-1-15&t=2&refcode2=1622_3935704_0CFuLW&akid=1622%2E3935704%2E0CFuLW)

body:
Peter,
_**Sovereign****countries have borders.**_

We should be securing and controlling ours, but the radical Left wants to open our borders to criminals, drugs, and weapons.

President Trump’s plan to build a border wall was RIGHT, and we should be welcoming immigrants who want to follow the law and build the American dream, not criminals who are _already_ breaking our laws.

**I put together an 11-point plan to RESCUE AMERICA, and border security is at the top of my priority list.**

It’s time to **build the wall** , and I want to see if patriots like you support our mission.

body:
Changing Course

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42238618/332191001/237656307?refcode=EM_FR_220225Launch1_N_GB_90DO_4_NG_N_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTQzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjJjYjZiNS03OTk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tFT_GGc6vN2PfDZ311dh22SwAVQFEllTvyinnoN_gmY=) Team,

Yesterday, I suspended my Senate campaign. Although this was a difficult decision, I am excited to embark on a new journey, **and I hope you'll join me.**

Your support has allowed me to spend the past year traveling across the state and meeting with families from all walks of life. Families who have actual problems - limited or no broadband, lack of access to essential healthcare services like mental health and addiction care, and crippling financial insecurity.

I’ve been asked so many times how we planned to address these issues from a federal standpoint. And the answer is that, in order to do so, we need action at both the federal and state level.

Education, healthcare, and economic stability - particularly in our rural communities and non-wealthy metropolitan communities - are problems that can and must be addressed on the state level.

**That’s why I’m running to be the next State Treasurer of Wisconsin.** To answer the questions all Wisconsin families have. To work with Governor Evers’ administration to address the needs of ALL of our communities. And to be a partner and resource to our new Democratic U.S. Senator from Wisconsin.

Over the years as a physician, too many patients have told me they have put off medical care for fear of financial struggle. In my practice, that means not knowing if you have breast cancer. That’s dangerous and scary. We have to do better for our communities. As Treasurer, in partnership with other public servants, I know we can expand access to healthcare, help people with the cost of prescription drugs and improve education in our schools. These are policies that can change lives.

I know these are uncertain times, but I am so grateful for your support. I hope you’ll continue with me on this journey to fight for Wisconsin families.
[JOIN US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42238619/332191002/237656307?refcode=EM_FR_220225Launch1_N_GB_90DO_4_NG_N_biobox&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTQzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjJjYjZiNS03OTk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tFT_GGc6vN2PfDZ311dh22SwAVQFEllTvyinnoN_gmY=) Best,

**February 25, 2022

202.738.9089**

| |
# Bill McSwain Pledges Support for Education Freedom and School Choice

**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today announced that he has signed the Education Freedom Pledge. By signing the pledge, McSwain promises to support parental rights in education and educational freedom, including the right of parents to apply their child's taxpayer-funded education dollars to the school of their choosing, whether it be private, public, charter, or homeschool.

McSwain had this to say about his decision to sign the pledge:
---
|
> **_"Education is a gateway to a better life, and every family deserves the freedom to choose the education that is best for their children. As Governor, I will empower parents to have the final authority over their children’s education, and fight back against teachers union bosses in defense of students and good teachers. I am proud to sign the Education Freedom Pledge, which reflects my commitment to ensuring that every child, regardless of zip code, has access to an excellent education." _**
---
|
---
| The Education Freedom Pledge, a project of the American Federation for Children, states:

_“I pledge to support policies that promote parental rights in education and educational freedom. This includes the right of parents to voice their opinions at school board meetings and to take their children's taxpayer-funded education dollars to the education providers of their choosing - whether it be a public, private, charter, or home school.”_

These sentiments echo McSwain's Parents Bill of Rights and Pillars of Education, which reflect McSwain's commitment to putting parents and students first as Governor by promoting school choice, banning critical race theory, and never accepting a cent from teachers unions.

More information about McSwain's plan for education reform is [available here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=94a3cadb88&e=b1ec95759b).

More information on the Education Freedom Pledge is [available here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=d7fe42096b&e=b1ec95759b).
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=cfc0d7856f&e=b1ec95759b)

name: Gov. Steve Sisolak
subject: spreading Trump’s big lie
body:
Derek,
Throughout my term in office, Republicans have relentlessly tried to suppress the votes of hardworking Nevadans. And ever since Donald Trump lost Nevada and the presidential election in 2020, the GOP has doubled down on these efforts.
Using the Big Lie and election conspiracy theories as a twisted justification for their attacks on one of our most fundamental rights, the far-right wants to disenfranchise thousands of Nevada voters before the November elections .
But here’s the deal: I’m not going to let that happen on my watch .
Derek, I’m going to be honest with you. This race is going to be extremely close, and I need your help to make sure we can stand up against these attacks. Can I count on you to split a $30 donation between my campaign and CommonGood right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak]
As governor, I took an oath to protect the rights of all Nevadans. As long as I am governor, I will protect our voting rights with everything at my disposal.
Donald Trump and his far-right allies in Nevada can throw everything they have to try and get their way: I’ll keep facing them down.
That’s why I need your help today, Derek. With voting rights and all of the progress we've made at stake, I must have the resources to take on the MAGA lies and these right-wing attempts to undermine our democracy.
Will you take a moment to split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood and let me know you’re standing with me? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ss?refcode=20220224_CGVA_Sisolak]

Remember, Derek, for as long as I have the honor of serving as your governor, I will continue fighting to protect every eligible Nevadan's right to vote. No ifs or buts.

Thank you for standing with me.
Steve Sisolak
Governor of Nevada

Growing up, my mom worked as a special education teacher where she fought to make sure each student had a chance to succeed.

**[She instilled in me the value of public service and inspired me to fight for those who often struggle the most.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42239224/332193146/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDFjNmRjZS03Yjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FduKiV1nyPl-duJfLyxUdubAnX2-4dN0LX92xqq12AI=)**

I believe all children deserve access to quality education and the right opportunities to thrive.

**[Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for even more families and children.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42239226/332193149/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MDFjNmRjZS03Yjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FduKiV1nyPl-duJfLyxUdubAnX2-4dN0LX92xqq12AI=)**

body:
As a Senator, I'd proudly cast a vote on behalf of PA to confirm Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court.
#
Big, big news, Derek.
Joe Biden is set to nominate Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson, of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, to the Supreme Court of the United States. If confirmed, she will be the first Black woman to sit on the highest court in the nation in its 233 years of existence.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/scotus-confirmation-email/?source=em20220225-4729&t=1&akid=4729%2E434096%2Ek-xacs)
**As a U.S. Senator, I'd proudly cast a vote on behalf of PA to confirm President Biden's historic nominee, Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson, to the Supreme Court. 💯**
But with the decision coming down to the current 50-50 Senate, we need to do everything we can to make sure Judge Jackson is confirmed without delay.

Peter, this is truly an honor...

**I received the FreedomWorks Freedom Fighter Award in Congress for 2021.**

To be recognized in my first year working for you in Congress is not just a personal honor, but a testament to your commitment to me and our shared conservative values.

Together, we have persevered through countless challenges imposed by the Democrats.

* Our national debt ballooned to nearly $30 trillion
* Radical leftists threatened to undermine election integrity

As we gear up to get on the ballot next week, I’m reminded of why I decided to run for Congress.

Growing up, my mom worked as a special education teacher where she fought to make sure each student had a chance to succeed.

**[She instilled in me the value of public service and inspired me to fight for those who often struggle the most.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42240661/332198868/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_op_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4ZDBmYi03Zjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZTNK9hzVyt22mZkM_ohgyZodcz_6WasUh_nc58Qsh2k=)**

I became a public school teacher and continued my mother’s legacy.

I would later go on to lead a non-profit dedicated to helping children succeed.

There I helped pass the Preschool Promise, which provides two years of quality universal preschool for Cincinnati's children, making us one of the first cities in the country to do so.

I believe all children deserve access to quality education and the right opportunities to thrive.

**[Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for even more families and children.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42240662/332198870/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_op_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4ZDBmYi03Zjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZTNK9hzVyt22mZkM_ohgyZodcz_6WasUh_nc58Qsh2k=)**

I’m running to bring change to the people of this district that he’s left behind. But I need 1,000 supporters to rush $15 before our critical End of Month Deadline in 72 hours to build momentum for my campaign. _Greg announcing his campaign for Congress_

I’m up against Chabot -- quickly becoming one of the most radical Republicans in Congress.

**[But we’ve done hard things before.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42240665/332198874/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_op_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4ZDBmYi03Zjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZTNK9hzVyt22mZkM_ohgyZodcz_6WasUh_nc58Qsh2k=)**

I fought to keep thousands of children and families in their homes by passing comprehensive eviction prevention reform on Cincinnati City Council.

I fought to expand access to Medicaid as the Chair of Ohio’s Anti-Poverty Task Force.

I fought to improve infrastructure starting with Cincinnati's crumbling Western Hills Viaduct that serves as critical transit for 40,000 people every day.

And we’re not done yet.

**[I promise you this, I will fight for you every single day in Congress -- but right now, I need your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42240667/332198875/1092196856?refcode=20220225_em_fr_b1_greg_30_op_rs&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTI4ZDBmYi03Zjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZTNK9hzVyt22mZkM_ohgyZodcz_6WasUh_nc58Qsh2k=)**

Greg Landsman is a former public school teacher and community leader running for Congress to fight for American children and families. His Republican opponent voted to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election and against desperately needed pandemic relief. After 25 years in Washington, he's left our community behind.

body:
Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241234/332201220/-1030957994?ms=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=gxRBnMHw%2FHblLwdM2ANpbRboETVbEtzwSpyuqL9flUE30B722keiN4OyEFZk0s3oEFb%2BcrEU%2BRLp6smrDnZso4IefRa%2B35eQs7oPhydhvIjgJphHty7VBWGxljasT61Igz8YtUd0Aedz5HrkmCegyQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDE3OGRjNi04Mjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1_BnmJslr6xgy1CZI060KGdyBauDcaLqZnEt-xHMhNg=&emci=50b5b0a3-7396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=44178dc6-8296-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)
---
Team, I want to tell you the context behind this photo. But first, we should start at the beginning.

My story begins and ends with Los Angeles. I was raised with my three brothers in the Venice/Fairfax area of L.A. I grew up watching the Civil Rights Movement on television with my father, which sparked my lifelong commitment to fighting for social and economic justice.

Leadership and action have always defined my public service. When I see a crisis — I run toward it.

That's how I ended up working as a Physician's Assistant treating victims of violent crime in the trauma unit at LAC/USC County Emergency Room.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241235/332201221/-1030957994?ms=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=gxRBnMHw%2FHblLwdM2ANpbRboETVbEtzwSpyuqL9flUE30B722keiN4OyEFZk0s3oEFb%2BcrEU%2BRLp6smrDnZso4IefRa%2B35eQs7oPhydhvIjgJphHty7VBWGxljasT61Igz8YtUd0Aedz5HrkmCegyQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDE3OGRjNi04Mjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1_BnmJslr6xgy1CZI060KGdyBauDcaLqZnEt-xHMhNg=&emci=50b5b0a3-7396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=44178dc6-8296-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)
---
It was there that I saw the need for community action to combat the violence and overdoses we saw in the emergency room every day. I realized that applying pressure to a patient's wound might save one life, but it wouldn't stop this city from bleeding.

That has put me on a lifelong mission to save lives in our city. In 1990, I founded Community Coalition, an intergenerational African American and Latino South LA-based organization that brings together neighbors, students, faith leaders, law enforcement, educators, and non-profit organizations to prevent crime and violence by addressing poverty, substance abuse, and the gutting of supportive services.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241236/332201222/-1030957994?ms=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=gxRBnMHw%2FHblLwdM2ANpbRboETVbEtzwSpyuqL9flUE30B722keiN4OyEFZk0s3oEFb%2BcrEU%2BRLp6smrDnZso4IefRa%2B35eQs7oPhydhvIjgJphHty7VBWGxljasT61Igz8YtUd0Aedz5HrkmCegyQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDE3OGRjNi04Mjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1_BnmJslr6xgy1CZI060KGdyBauDcaLqZnEt-xHMhNg=&emci=50b5b0a3-7396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=44178dc6-8296-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)
---
That same commitment led me to serve as the first Black woman Speaker in the California State House during California's greatest economic crisis since the Great Depression. I knew my city — and the state — was home to families who were struggling, so I made painful decisions needed to save the state from sliding further into economic disaster — and it worked.

No matter where I went, I knew I wanted to be a part of the solution. That drive led me to serve as a U.S. Congresswoman, and now, I'm running to be Los Angeles' next mayor.

Today, I look at the city I love as it faces once-in-a-generation crises, and I ask myself: "How can I not do everything I can to help?" Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve.

Team, it doesn't matter where you live — you deserve a mayor who will show up and work for you every single day. Someone who will advocate for working people, address structural inequality, and tackle systemic racism. Someone who understands that investments in job creation must go hand-in-hand with safe working conditions, livable wages, and environmental justice as we recover from this pandemic.

There are no simple answers, but together, we can get the job done.

**[Please join EMILY's List, Dolores Huerta, former Mayor Antonio Villaraigosa, and grassroots supporters across the city by showing your support for our campaign as we work to create a pathway to progress for every single Angeleno.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241237/332201223/-1030957994?ms=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=gxRBnMHw%2FHblLwdM2ANpbRboETVbEtzwSpyuqL9flUE30B722keiN4OyEFZk0s3oEFb%2BcrEU%2BRLp6smrDnZso4IefRa%2B35eQs7oPhydhvIjgJphHty7VBWGxljasT61Igz8YtUd0Aedz5HrkmCegyQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDE3OGRjNi04Mjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1_BnmJslr6xgy1CZI060KGdyBauDcaLqZnEt-xHMhNg=&emci=50b5b0a3-7396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=44178dc6-8296-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)**

Thanks for reading, and thanks for all you do,

Karen

P.S. Before I go, I wanted to introduce you to my children, grandchildren, son-in-law, and goddaughter. They're another BIG reason I keep fighting for progress every single day.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241238/332201224/-1030957994?ms=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220225_bio_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=gxRBnMHw%2FHblLwdM2ANpbRboETVbEtzwSpyuqL9flUE30B722keiN4OyEFZk0s3oEFb%2BcrEU%2BRLp6smrDnZso4IefRa%2B35eQs7oPhydhvIjgJphHty7VBWGxljasT61Igz8YtUd0Aedz5HrkmCegyQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDE3OGRjNi04Mjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1_BnmJslr6xgy1CZI060KGdyBauDcaLqZnEt-xHMhNg=&emci=50b5b0a3-7396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=44178dc6-8296-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)

clean_body: Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve. Team, I want to tell you the context behind this photo. But first, we should start at the beginning. No matter where I went, I knew I wanted to be a part of the solution. That drive led me to serve as a U.S. Congresswoman, and now, I'm running to be Los Angeles' next mayor. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: The fight for democracy is everywhere
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friend --

We are in the midst of a multiyear, multifaceted, multi-front war over the future of democracy. And make no mistake, democracy will only prevail if we make defending it the most important issue of our time.

Russia’s invasion of Ukraine is a blatant attempt to destroy a democratic nation and put it under the thumb of an authoritarian regime. Like you, I’m praying for everyone in Ukraine and I stand with the pro-democracy movement holding Russia accountable for their actions.
But this war on democracy did not start in Ukraine and it will not end there.

Right here in Michigan, partisan extremists started waging war on our democracy in 2020, a war that continues today. While it may not involve tanks and missiles and invading armies, it’s very real and very dangerous.

There is no denying we are in the midst of a multiyear, multifaceted, multi-front war over the future of democracy. And make no mistake, democracy will only prevail if we make defending it the most important issue of our time.

The latest salvo being fired at our democracy targets the online absentee ballot application portal I launched in 2020 and the guidance we issued to local election officials that clarified state election law. Why is this so important? Partisan extremists are trying to make it harder for eligible voters to cast a ballot. That’s anti-democratic. Pure and simple.

Don’t forget, voters approved a constitutional guarantee to vote by absentee ballot and the portal was designed to help voters exercise their right.

The guidance we offered clerks was designed to help them know how to correctly and fairly evaluate absentee ballot signatures. More importantly, while the advice was similar to advice the state has given local clerks for years and years, we’re attempting to formalize it with legislative approval, on the order of a court.

But now extremists in the state legislature want to make it harder to vote by taking away the online absentee ballot application and make it more likely that legitimate voter signatures will be flagged as fraudulent. This is clearly an attempt to rehash the "Big Lie" since there was virtually no fraud in the 2020 election, be it absentee, online, in-person or otherwise.

I know we are asking you to help on many fronts. But you elected me to serve the citizens of Michigan and safeguard our electoral process from those who would take it away, in all its forms. It is what I have done since the day I was sworn-in and why I'm shining a spotlight on this blatant attack on voting now.

The people behind this effort -- and every bill like it -- are hoping you don't notice. Certainly, world events make it more likely that you may not notice their war on democracy that is happening here in Michigan. But I know that won’t happen.

This year you and every American voter has the power to reject candidates who run on a platform of party over country. You can hold accountable those seeking to erode confidence in our democracy and deny those willing to overturn elections the authority to do so.
We’re in a critical moment, both domestically and abroad, with authoritarians seeking to destroy democracy. And I thank you for being with me as we all continue this vital work.

- Jocelyn

name: Bridie Farrell
subject: Leaving the Race for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bridie Farrell for US
body:
Dear friend,

After closely reviewing the new district maps that emerged from the state legislature’s redistricting process, I’ve decided to end my race for the U.S. House of Representatives. New York’s 21st district now has a 23 point Republican advantage instead of the eight point margin it had when I launched my campaign. I no longer see a path to victory for a Democrat in this race.

I’m proud of our campaign. It was wholly driven by you and was made possible because of your support. That support enabled us to travel the rural North Country and hear the concerns of honest, hard-working people. The list of things we all need in upstate New York is long: jobs, childcare, education, healthcare, housing, broadband, and it goes on. Despite all that needs work, I consistently heard a united love and appreciation for the North Country.

My desire to give back to our community is not ending as I step out of this Congressional race. Over the past seven months I gained incredible insight into all aspects of what it means to serve and what it means to be ready to serve on day-one. I am going to continue to lead on the issues that matter to all of us. I will continue to speak out and speak up. I will continue to be here for all of you, my fellow New Yorkers and my fellow Americans.

I remain committed to helping the North Country and rural NY in down-ballot races this election cycle. Civic participation is one of the solutions to correct the trajectory of the country today. State, county, city, and all the way down, these representatives are ever so important to our daily lives and the fabric of our nation. We all need to be involved at the local level. As I said when I started my nonprofit years ago: Be Vocal, Go Local. We need to come out for folks who are willing to throw their hats in the ring to serve with financial support, door knocking, phone banking, and by having conversations with our neighbors.

Thank you for your support. Thank you for your involvement in the political process. We cannot give up on democracy nor can we give up on each other. Much is at stake. Life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness are too valuable.

Leaving this race does not signal the end of an effort, but rather, the beginning of the next chapter. I still truly believe there is more that unites us than divides us. I hope that you do as well, and that you will remain engaged in the beautiful and fragile process of American democracy.

Best,

Bridie

Peter, on Tuesday, Sen. Jon Ossoff announced that Rome will receive $15 million for public transportation as part of the Bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. He also broke down what else Georgia will receive through this Act:
* $8.9 billion to repair and rebuild roads and highways.
* $1.4 billion for public transit.
* $913 million for water projects.
* $619 million for airport improvements.
* $225 million to repair and replace bridges.
* $135 million to expand the state’s network of electric-vehicle charging stations.
* $100 million for broadband deployment.

Team Holly was thrilled to see promises made are being delivered, but there's still work to be done in Northwest Georgia. We need a representative who will fight to bring the appropriate funding up to our underserved areas, and **we’ll be honest – Marjorie Taylor Greene is not that representative. ** Many of our schools still use lead pipes, many of our neighbors don’t have access to broadband internet, our public transportation is non-existent, and our bridges and roads are depleted. Alongside the Infrastructure Act, Holly’s Rural Revival Plan works cohesively to solve these issues. When elected, Holly will work to secure the funding we need in order for our communities to succeed. Our community in GA-14 has lacked access to adequate infrastructure for decades. **Marjorie Taylor Greene promised to be a representative of the people, yet she is leaving our district in the dust once again.** While progress is being made, we still have a lot of work to do. Yesterday, I called out a Republican colleague for using a racist trope as an excuse to imprison Black children. Today, I’m asking if you’ll help take our fight for a fair and just society to Congress by chipping in towards our end-of-month goal. With just 123 days left until our election, anything you can give -- $5, $10, $25, or whatever you can -- will make a huge impact on our people-powered campaign to reach every last voter in our campaign for this critical open seat. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?amount=&refcode2=top_link]
DONATE NOW » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?amount=&refcode2=top_btn]
Folks, yesterday, a Republican colleague of mine used a well-known racist trope on the House of Delegates floor in her opposition to a bill to decriminalize behavior of troubled students. She claimed that Black fathers weren’t “prevalent” in their children’s lives and that our children needed “consequences.”
News flash from a Black father: We love our children and our community.
This is a prime example of why we need more voices like mine in the halls of power. The fact that I am a young Black father and husband matters. It informs the work I’m doing now and how I will represent the families of Maryland’s Fourth District in Congress. I’m fighting to make sure that we tackle the big challenges we face as a country so that we don’t pass them on to the next generation.
Together, we can win this critical open seat for progress so I can take our fight for change that can’t wait to the next level. In this solid blue district, our June 28 Democratic primary is our Election Day -- we can win this seat in just 123 days, but we have to meet every single one of our fundraising goals if we’re going to reach enough voters with our message. I’m asking, will you chip in $5, $10, $25, or whatever you can to help us reach our February end-of-month goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?amount=&refcode2=body_link2]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Give $5 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode2=abx5] Give $10 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode2=abx10]
Give $25 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode2=abx25] Give $50 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode2=abx50]
Give $100 » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode2=abx100] Give Other » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2022_lewis_february?amount=&refcode2=abx-other]

The tragic irony is this incident occurred during debate on a bill to end part of the school-to-prison pipeline. The people of Maryland demand more than tropes that deny the truth that Black kids are disproportionately pushed into the carceral state and that Black men are disproportionately targeted by an unjust and often predatory criminal justice system.
As a Black father and husband, I will always stand up to this kind of ignorance.
Thank you for standing with me,
Jazz

Jazz Lewis is an effective progressive leader running for the Democratic nomination in Maryland’s 4th Congressional District. A champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to health care access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. Jazz would be the youngest African-American ever elected to represent Maryland in Congress. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

I’m fighting to make sure that we tackle the big challenges we face as a country so that we don’t pass them on to the next generation. Together, we can win this critical open seat for progress so I can take our fight for change that can’t wait to the next level. In this solid blue district, our June 28 Democratic primary is our Election Day -- we can win this seat in just 123 days, but we have to meet every single one of our fundraising goals if we’re going to reach enough voters with our message. I’m asking, will you chip in $5, $10, $25, or whatever you can to help us reach our February end-of-month goal? [] If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Give $5 » [] Give $10 » [] Give $25 » [] Give $50 » [] Give $100 » [] Give Other » [] The tragic irony is this incident occurred during debate on a bill to end part of the school-to-prison pipeline. The people of Maryland demand more than tropes that deny the truth that Black kids are disproportionately pushed into the carceral state and that Black men are disproportionately targeted by an unjust and often predatory criminal justice system. As a Black father and husband, I will always stand up to this kind of ignorance. Thank you for standing with me, Jazz Jazz Lewis [] Jazz Lewis is an effective progressive leader running for the Democratic nomination in Maryland’s 4th Congressional District. A champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to health care access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. Jazz would be the youngest African-American ever elected to represent Maryland in Congress. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son. CONTRIBUTE » [] Paid for by Friends of Jazz Lewis Friends of Jazz Lewis P.O. subject: I Need You to Go to The State Convention!
body:
| Peter -- As local party conventions get into full swing, one unfortunate truth has revealed itself: **The Establishment will do everything in its power to stop our campaign to Save Minnesota.** [Admissions of election fraud from RINO Paul Gazelka's campaign were startling](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rBhB1H0Y-0KAXn8Uxy6DRlbeS_ey0R5yLd62eka5dH6Yxig9N17eM6Q2xbSkFei3MgMO200JSIihZPQydIz0uy0&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_22_state_convention_coming&n=1), and the Establishment's willingness to sweep it under the rug was even more so. We suddenly found ourselves in a position that necessitated a hard shift toward maintaining election integrity, something we never thought we'd have to do within our own party. Our call to action seems to be working. Lists are getting fixed. Morrison County's convention is one of several that were postponed, and is now being run independently to avoid a conflict of interest with the Gazelka Campaign. **For the candidates who have followed my lead, I’m grateful. But one has to wonder if they would have spoken up for this at all, had I not.** My plan to Save Minnesota involves securing our elections, restoring health and second amendment freedoms, re-securing our streets, and more. [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rPi4oAUq_ZRBeNS3BqV5iPiTY_pAlR_NA1vq62axn4GC&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_22_state_convention_coming&n=2) | [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rPi4oAUq_ZRBeNS3BqV5iPiTY_pAlR_NA1vq62axn4GC&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_22_state_convention_coming&n=3 "I SUPPORT THE SAVE SOTA PLAN") [I SUPPORT THE SAVE SOTA PLAN](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rPi4oAUq_ZRBeNS3BqV5iPiTY_pAlR_NA1vq62axn4GC&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_22_state_convention_coming&n=3)

**This incident is definitive proof that if left to the career politicians, important things like securing our elections will never get done.** We also have many years of bad votes to prove that they reliably fail.
My campaign is the only movement serious about important issues like passing the Never Again Bill, Giving Back The Surplus, and Saving Health Freedom.
We need your help to get us over the finish line! The GOP Endorsement for Governor will be decided at the State Convention in **Rochester May 13-14.**
**We need Grassroots conservatives like you to attend. You can ensure we choose a conservative outsider who can crush Tim Walz on the Debate Stage!!**
The Establishment doesn't want you there. They're doing everything they can to prop up their unpopular candidates, who are guaranteed to have _no shot_ at energizing folks in the middle and beating Tim Walz.
If we let them win, we all will lose.
All it takes to thwart their plan and elect a conservative is your willingness to commit just three days of your time over the next three months. One for your local party convention, and two for the state convention.
Just like on caucus night, you should attend your local party convention, sign up to be a delegate, and get voted through. We will help you!
**Let's not forget what Tim Walz and the radical left have done to us. Let's not forget about the career politicians failing to stop him.**
Let's take the fight to Tim Walz together, by going to the State Convention. I'll see you there.
Thank you!
Dr. Neil Shah
Conservative Candidate for Governor

From visiting with local vendors in Silver Spring and meeting with community members across the Baltimore region to testifying on behalf of important legislation in Annapolis and **[fighting for fair maps](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241795/332204450/1114341192?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)** in Baltimore County, Tom and Shannon have continued to travel across Maryland to share their vision for the future of our great state.
As we continue to grow our powerful grassroots movement, we are so grateful to have you on our team. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241799/332204454/-1948240435?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)

Thank you so much for your continued support, and we look forward to staying in touch.
Sincerely,
Team Tom
* * *
**On the Campaign Trail**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241800/332204456/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Tom and Shannon kicked off another action-packed weekend at the Silver Spring Farmers Market meeting Marylanders, supporting vendors, and stocking up on local produce and goods.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241801/332204457/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
They later headed to the CASA in Action headquarters in Langley Park to participate in a panel discussion with other immigrant activists. Access to healthcare and housing is a human right, no matter your situation. Special thank you to Gustavo Torres and the rest of the CASA family for giving Tom and Shannon an opportunity to discuss their thoughts and ideas on expanding access to our immigrant friends and neighbors here in Maryland.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241802/332204458/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Tom then headed to Howard County Saturday afternoon where he first took a tour of Sapwood Cellars with local activist Tom Coale. He had the opportunity to walk through Old Ellicott City with Delegate Courtney Watson and Delegate Pat Young, where they were able to stop in a variety of vibrant small businesses.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241803/332204460/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Sunday morning, Tom attended mass at St Ann’s Catholic Church in Baltimore, while Shannon joined New Antioch Baptist Church in Randallstown for their service. Thank you to Reverend Xavier Edet, Ralph Moore, and Pastor Barney for allowing Tom and Shannon to worship alongside you this weekend.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241804/332204461/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Thank you to the friends of Gwynns Falls as well as Baltimore City Councilman Kris Burnett for taking Tom on a hike through the beautiful Leakin Park Sunday afternoon in West Baltimore.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241805/332204462/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
The energy at our meet and greet at Union Brewing on Sunday was incredible as Tom and Shannon shared their vision for building a better Maryland. It was great to see so many of our supporters as we toasted to the powerful grassroots movement that we are continuing to build.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241806/332204463/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
No one should ever have to choose between the job they need and the ones they love. That's why we must pass the Time to Care Act. Shannon was honored to attend the Time to Care Maryland rally on Lawyers' Mall Monday night. Let's get this done for working families across our state.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241807/332204464/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
The CIAA basketball tournament came to Baltimore this week, and Tom and Shannon were able to attend a game! This tournament was a huge opportunity for Baltimore to show all that it has to offer: vibrant communities, great restaurants, historical landmarks, and more. Tom and Shannon were honored to be able to have a part in it.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241808/332204465/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0N2I5MWE0OS04Njk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBj1k-0JlsOx28ycP_C4rFvPE0CEqeVKDsVHmaDmMnc=&emci=add3b47c-e495-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=47b91a49-8696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
Tom and Shannon also joined strong leaders and activists from Baltimore County for a fundraiser in Ruxton this week where they discussed how we can work together to build a better Maryland.
* * *
