Team Tom Weekly Update | Friday, February 25th, 2022 Peter, From visiting with local vendors in Silver Spring and meeting with community members across the Baltimore region to testifying on behalf of important legislation in Annapolis and in Baltimore County, Tom and Shannon have continued to travel across Maryland to share their vision for the future of our great state. As we continue to grow our powerful grassroots movement, we are so grateful to have you on our team. This weekend we hope you can join us for our weekly , a with Shannon on Saturday or our next at Denizens Brewery in Silver Spring. As our campaign continues, Tom and Shannon, like each of you, have been closely monitoring the rapidly developing situation in Ukraine this week. During this incredibly uncertain and difficult time, we must continue to do all we can to support our neighbors. We hope you join us in praying for peace. Thank you so much for your continued support, and we look forward to staying in touch. Sincerely, Team Tom On the Campaign Trail Tom and Shannon kicked off another action-packed weekend at the Silver Spring Farmers Market meeting Marylanders, supporting vendors, and stocking up on local produce and goods. They later headed to the CASA in Action headquarters in Langley Park to participate in a panel discussion with other immigrant activists. Access to healthcare and housing is a human right, no matter your situation. Special thank you to Gustavo Torres and the rest of the CASA family for giving Tom and Shannon an opportunity to discuss their thoughts and ideas on expanding access to our immigrant friends and neighbors here in Maryland. Tom then headed to Howard County Saturday afternoon where he first took a tour of Sapwood Cellars with local activist Tom Coale. He had the opportunity to walk through Old Ellicott City with Delegate Courtney Watson and Delegate Pat Young, where they were able to stop in a variety of vibrant small businesses. Sunday morning, Tom attended mass at St Ann’s Catholic Church in Baltimore, while Shannon joined New Antioch Baptist Church in Randallstown for their service. Thank you to Reverend Xavier Edet, Ralph Moore, and Pastor Barney for allowing Tom and Shannon to worship alongside you this weekend. Thank you to the friends of Gwynns Falls as well as Baltimore City Councilman Kris Burnett for taking Tom on a hike through the beautiful Leakin Park Sunday afternoon in West Baltimore. The energy at our meet and greet at Union Brewing on Sunday was incredible as Tom and Shannon shared their vision for building a better Maryland. It was great to see so many of our supporters as we toasted to the powerful grassroots movement that we are continuing to build. No one should ever have to choose between the job they need and the ones they love. That's why we must pass the Time to Care Act. Shannon was honored to attend the Time to Care Maryland rally on Lawyers' Mall Monday night. Let's get this done for working families across our state. The CIAA basketball tournament came to Baltimore this week, and Tom and Shannon were able to attend a game! This tournament was a huge opportunity for Baltimore to show all that it has to offer: vibrant communities, great restaurants, historical landmarks, and more. Tom and Shannon were honored to be able to have a part in it. Tom and Shannon also joined strong leaders and activists from Baltimore County for a fundraiser in Ruxton this week where they discussed how we can work together to build a better Maryland. subject: ICYMI: We must remember to conserve
body:
To be the party of freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of conservatism | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/shawnhyland.com/abetteramericastartstoday-8852494?e=5167ed8367)
---
| | | | | | _Peter,_ I am a conservative. I believe that to defend the American way of life, the American dream, and the American spirit of freedom, we must _conserve_ the culture, traditions, and laws that gave rise to the American experiment in self-government.Historically, both major political parties believed in **the fundamental pillars of a free people - strong families, faith in God, personal responsibility, hard work, and a sincere patriotic love for one’s country**. The political debate was over the size and scope of government.The Democratic party believed government could be a force for good in society by confiscating people’s finances through higher taxes to fund a well-intended but never-ending list of government interests and interventions. The Republican party believed a smaller limited government allowed everyday ordinary people to enjoy their life more fully and more freely by taxing less money to allow people to pursue their personal interests. Those were the good old days. Today, the political contrast is much starker and the debate much more intense.Tragically, the fundamental pillars of a free people have now been labeled as oppressive by ideological left-wing activist organizations and even tax funded institutions. This new political reality has caused some to reasonably conclude that the Republican party on the right is the party of Freedom, while the Democrat party on the left is the party of Oppression. We are told America’s dualistic choice between the major political parties is one of Liberty or Lockdowns.Republican thought leaders believe the one word that sums up the Republican platform is – Freedom. Libertarians, populists, small businesses, and the working-class desire to be free from the mandates and dictates of big oversized ineffective government. Yes, but...We must remember to _**conserve**_**.** Freedom is not willed into existence by the people, nor can it be maintained by an idealistic protectionism. **Freedom is built on the longstanding Western values of individualism and equal rights.** One man could not rule over another without their consent. This political philosophy is rooted in the Judeo-Christian understanding of each person being made in the image of God. For this reason, the American founding fathers appealed to the Laws of Nature and of Nature’s God to support their claim of inalienable God-given rights.Therefore, to be the party of Freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of _**Conservatism**_. The nuclear family is not dispensable. Moral goodness is not repressive.The radical far left knows this more than many of us. Influential socialist organizations that become the breeding ground for the likes of Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, such as Liberation Road, Democratic Socialists of America, Communist Party USA, and more all insist in their online mission statements on dismantling the nuclear family and deconstructing moral values to fundamentally transform society to their Marxist end.We cannot allow them to advance their destructive agenda. Every principled republican must stand firm on _**conserving**_ the culture, traditions, and laws of our nation if we are to pass on freedom to the next generation.
---
| | | | | |
# Working for a Better America,
Shawn Hyland|

Influential socialist organizations that become the breeding ground for the likes of Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, such as Liberation Road, Democratic Socialists of America, Communist Party USA, and more all insist in their online mission statements on dismantling the nuclear family and deconstructing moral values to fundamentally transform society to their Marxist end.We cannot allow them to advance their destructive agenda. Education is a top priority for Marylanders and I am focused on delivering solutions to make sure that every single student can receive the classroom instruction they need to _succeed._
**My Parental Bill of Rights is about empowering parents and protecting students.**
I will fight to guarantee that parents have every opportunity to play an instrumental role in their child’s education.

While I might be running for governor, _I’m still a mom._

clean_body: | | | | Dear Friend, I wanted you to be the first to know that on Monday we will go live with our first television ad "Parental Rights". Our first ad discusses my Parental Bill of Rights and my commitment to ensuring that Maryland parents are empowered and that all children have the opportunity to receive a world-class education. That means providing real school choice, record funding, and accountability -- with education transparency. Education is a top priority for Marylanders and I am focused on delivering solutions to make sure that every single student can receive the classroom instruction they need to succeed. My Parental Bill of Rights is about empowering parents and protecting students. I will fight to guarantee that parents have every opportunity to play an instrumental role in their child’s education. While I might be running for governor, I’m still a mom. And there is nothing more important than our children. They deserve the best education and opportunity that Maryland can help to provide. It is time that Colorado has a leader, with the backing of labor and veterans groups, to fight for the Coloradans of the 8th Congressional District and the state. That’s why Nuestro PAC is endorsing Chaz Tedesco.
"Nuestro PAC is honored and excited to be joining organized labor and veterans groups to endorse Chaz Tedesco for Colorado's new 8th congressional district," said Eileen Garcia, Executive Director of Nuestro PAC. "Chaz is a working class Latino who has devoted his career to improving the lives of his community. He is the exact kind of candidate we need representing us in the U.S. Congress and to make this seat Blue."

Endorsements from [labor groups have been rolling in](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=c0a64da63d&e=b8f90417f9) for Chaz, with the most recent endorsements coming out this week from SMART, Pipefitters Local Union 208, the International Association of Firefighters and the Retired Members Council of the Communication Workers of America 777. To have the support of these groups is key in ensuring Coloradans of all backgrounds have the best representation from someone who is just like them.
[Will you join us and labor and veterans groups and make a contribution to help elect the first U.S. Representative for Colorado’s new congressional district?](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=8795ae5264&e=b8f90417f9)

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=115%2E61531%2EiiJOFc)
Hello,
Early yesterday morning, Russian President Vladimir Putin made the disastrous choice to order his military forces to invade Ukraine. This was an unprovoked and premeditated attack on a sovereign nation, which will result in the loss of many innocent lives and a humanitarian crisis. Putin’s war of choice will be felt all around the world, jeopardizing peace and security in the region and exasperating an economy recovering from the pandemic.
Led by President Biden, our government has led a response with our allies across the globe in delivering swift and punishing sanctions that will have a long-lasting impact on Putin and his government. And there will be more to come as Putin’s army marches on Kyiv. We must also ensure that Ukrainians and our allies in the region have the humanitarian support they need to deal with this painful crisis.
The senseless violence we have all seen unfold over the past day is the result of a dictator who is determined to expand his reach with total disregard for international law and norms. We must stay together and strong in the face of this authoritarian threat and continue to lend aid to our allies in Europe and mitigate the economic impact at home.
Thank you,
Peter Welch

name: Geoff Diehl
subject: Diehl Campaign Announces Desiree Awiszio to Assist with Signature Collection
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Diehl for Massachusetts
body:
Can Geoff count on YOU to help get his name on the ballot?
| | | |
---
| REPUBLICAN ACTIVIST DESIREE AWISZIO, TREASURER FOR DIEHL FOR GOVERNOR CAMPAIGN, ALSO NOW SERVING AS FIELD ADVISOR Well-known activist to Massachusetts Republicans, who has managed numerous campaigns and field operations, to now help organize signature gathering effort
---
| BOSTON, MA - The Geoff Diehl for Governor campaign announces that long-time Republican activist Desiree Awiszio, who has been serving as the campaign's Treasurer since its launch last July, will also be advising the campaign on its signature gathering efforts this spring.
Awiszio, a consulting engineer by trade, has extensive experience working with countless Republican candidates, managing their campaigns, and supporting their grassroots campaign strategies. Most recently, she served as Deputy Campaign Manager for Field Operation for Geoff Diehl's 2018 campaign for United States Senate.
---
|
---
| | [Volunteer Now to Collect Signatures for Geoff](mailto:Desiree_a@charter.net)
---
| She also was one of the original sponsors of a 2013 ballot initiative to repeal automatic gas tax increases. Awiszio served as the Statewide Campaign manager in 2014 and helped build a network of volunteers that collected over 146,000 signatures in support of the ballot question, which was passed by voters in 2014. In recognition of her efforts, she was unanimously elected Honorary State Committee Member in 2016 by the membership of the Massachusetts Republican State Committee. She also served as Treasurer for the Make Massachusetts Great Again SuperPAC in 2016.
"I am extremely pleased Desiree is serving as part of our campaign," Diehl said. "I've known Desiree for a long time, and I admire her tireless dedication to Republican causes. She is an important part of our team, and will provide us with invaluable assistance organizing our signature collection effort."
Candidates for Governor are required to collect 10,000 certified signatures from voters in order to qualify for the ballot. According to Diehl, his campaign is already busy working with a large network of volunteers statewide to collect signatures. "We're going to be very busy connecting with voters all across our state over the next few weeks, and we look forward to the opportunity to visit people in their home town to talk about our campaign," Diehl said.
For more information about the Diehl for Massachusetts campaign and to volunteer, please visit www.GeoffDiehl.com or contact Desiree Awiszio at [Desiree_a@charter.net](mailto:Desiree_a@charter.net) or (508) 579-7393.

| Dear Friends -

The war in Ukraine is a horrible tragedy, brought on by a viscous dictator hell-bent on resurrecting the USSR.

[_**I know which side of history I'm on: I stand for freedom, self-determination, democracy and for NATO.**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=a2209df10b&e=4712f71bea)

I stand with Ukraine and Ukrainians. My heart breaks for them.

What's more, I know where Donald Trump stands. He's called Vladimir Putin's invasion "genius" and "very savvy."

It's disgusting.

[_**My opponent Ronny Jackson has clearly chosen a side: Trump's**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=25e069797d&e=4712f71bea).

As Putin's army rumbles towards Kyiv, Jackson posted this on Twitter:
To be clear: Ronny Jackson sides with Donald Trump in his support of Vladimir Putin.

[_**How else do you explain this?**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=0c90402a45&e=4712f71bea)

I'm asking you to please support my campaign to beat Ronny Jackson.

It is unfortunately not hyperbole to say that our American values may depend on it.

Yours,
Kathleen Brown
Democrat
TX-13

| Dear friends,

Like so many of you, I have watched with horror over the last few days as families are once again separated and lives are lost over one man’s dangerous power grab.

I stand with President Biden and our allies to condemn Russia’s unprovoked war on Ukraine. While some influential figures in the GOP cheer on a Russian invasion of a US ally, I strongly condemn Russia’s reckless and unprovoked attack. The United States must present a unified, bipartisan message so the free world can stand up to this naked act of aggression and stand together for democracy.

The United States must continue to work with our NATO allies to ensure security for Europe to prevent this war from escalating further. Standing up to Russia and standing up for democracy is on the ballot in 2022.

Thank you for all you do.

Rev. Mark Holland

body:
Last month, I traveled to Texas to meet with Governor Greg Abbott and other Texas officials to see with my own eyes how bad the crisis at our southern Friend, Last month, I traveled to Texas to meet with Governor Greg Abbott and other Texas officials to see with my own eyes how bad the crisis at our southern border has become. During a two-day summit with other state attorneys general, we saw:
* **The unfinished border wall, riddled with incomplete segments shockingly easy to walk through and around.** Taxpayers have bought steel to build more, but it sits rusting in piles because the Biden administration will neither install it nor allow Texas to.

* **Front-line federal agents just trying to do their jobs.** Unfortunately, our interaction with federal agents was limited because the evening before our arrival, their superiors in Washington abruptly canceled our briefings without explanation.

* **Dedicated Texas officers enforcing state laws near the unsecured border.** They know the reality on the ground. They showed us which houses and other structures on the Mexican side are owned and used by the cartels and explained how cartels pay spotters — often children — to sit along the Rio Grande and report the location of patrol boats so smugglers know when the coast is clear.

Weak federal policy invites border chaos, and drug cartels and other criminal organizations use that chaos as cover to extend their operations in the United States, including Kansas. A bad situation has grown worse in the past year. **Texas state troopers alone seized enough fentanyl last year to kill over 200 million people.** They also arrested more than 10,000 illegal immigrants for committing state crimes including for child trafficking and drug smuggling, and seized more than five tons of methamphetamine and more than $17 million in cash. According to most recent data, **Kansas saw a 54 percent increase in drug overdoses in the first half of last year. ** Not long after my return home to Kansas, the local government in Kansas City adopted an ordinance designating Wyandotte County as a “sanctuary” jurisdiction for illegal immigrants and restricting the ability of local law enforcement to cooperate with federal immigration authorities. Sanctuary city policies are never a good idea, but it is especially dangerous for local governments to enact them at a time when the Biden administration continues to fail in its duty to secure our southern border. Despite these serious concerns, it is not entirely clear that current state law prohibits what is being done in Kansas City. Even after years of discussion and debate, the State of Kansas has not adopted a state statute specifically prohibiting local “sanctuary” jurisdictions for illegal immigration. **That’s why I’ve introduced a bill to prohibit sanctuary cities in Kansas and am calling on the Legislature to pass it as soon as possible this session. ** This is not merely a matter of local concern. Every Kansan who visits Kansas City for shopping, dining, health care, recreation, or any other purpose deserves to know that the local police department can fully participate in enforcement of applicable law and is not arbitrarily obliged to turn a blind eye to particular illegal activity merely because local politicians have demanded it. [**Click now to stand with me and show your support for this legislation.**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=450e74929eb442c8971399fe256377c5&_e=lZkJq2RuDLD9TNZhUceZ5-93A70JvKrv8A9PQ1LDgZyRkkeqd8ks-Km5-f_eSWpjdoqGKZgjDyMwK7cz_nBeZ4dJgPeYmu-9UZQC5ibhZD_47f-dRUvQoojChLpgTveyuVXUWEQkigpLlXM7AuIicDcICXLo038M79hXkcg9tjEYBvoP4AIxXuz-g5ExxPkgbEDmGJThEesguGNOC6-8Ah0D2jHA_evv2-YPpsV5MVFwQgDDC7IsoxJyyc5fHzprxgwQXbkZTcEVTnctYlqAX_Z6ILW3TPE17lMNRSZge5QmOj8y4XFJCFgfYMZxxj-OztdFXQ4PKTk9nliNbhfdd6z5oZvReyKrOJ8gi53cTlBnBpdHVVz6L5sz2QOfRyd3XcZzc0zMiUTAL2DJkbcS-WcMW3PWsF8xS3BgFTmTYtU7f4nRhGHtlfg1cuPqib76IVm1P5fBVO-0ZVZWLHa0yyjvX6YrJytF4NsIISzyKv-7c3dmKS0atfZDHMNrrCM5) My top priority has always been and will always be keeping Kansans safe. That’s exactly what this legislation that I’m proposing would do, and it’s why it’s so important that we get it passed. clean_body: Last month, I traveled to Texas to meet with Governor Greg Abbott and other Texas officials to see with my own eyes how bad the crisis at our southern Friend, Last month, I traveled to Texas to meet with Governor Greg Abbott and other Texas officials to see with my own eyes how bad the crisis at our southern border has become. During a two-day summit with other state attorneys general, we saw: The unfinished border wall, riddled with incomplete segments shockingly easy to walk through and around. Taxpayers have bought steel to build more, but it sits rusting in piles because the Biden administration will neither install it nor allow Texas to. Front-line federal agents just trying to do their jobs. Unfortunately, our interaction with federal agents was limited because the evening before our arrival, their superiors in Washington abruptly canceled our briefings without explanation. Dedicated Texas officers enforcing state laws near the unsecured border. They know the reality on the ground. They showed us which houses and other structures on the Mexican side are owned and used by the cartels and explained how cartels pay spotters — often children — to sit along the Rio Grande and report the location of patrol boats so smugglers know when the coast is clear. Weak federal policy invites border chaos, and drug cartels and other criminal organizations use that chaos as cover to extend their operations in the United States, including Kansas. A bad situation has grown worse in the past year. Texas state troopers alone seized enough fentanyl last year to kill over 200 million people. They also arrested more than 10,000 illegal immigrants for committing state crimes including for child trafficking and drug smuggling, and seized more than five tons of methamphetamine and more than $17 million in cash. According to most recent data, Kansas saw a 54 percent increase in drug overdoses in the first half of last year. Not long after my return home to Kansas, the local government in Kansas City adopted an ordinance designating Wyandotte County as a “sanctuary” jurisdiction for illegal immigrants and restricting the ability of local law enforcement to cooperate with federal immigration authorities. Sanctuary city policies are never a good idea, but it is especially dangerous for local governments to enact them at a time when the Biden administration continues to fail in its duty to secure our southern border. Despite these serious concerns, it is not entirely clear that current state law prohibits what is being done in Kansas City. Even after years of discussion and debate, the State of Kansas has not adopted a state statute specifically prohibiting local “sanctuary” jurisdictions for illegal immigration. That’s why I’ve introduced a bill to prohibit sanctuary cities in Kansas and am calling on the Legislature to pass it as soon as possible this session. ** This is not merely a matter of local concern. Every Kansan who visits Kansas City for shopping, dining, health care, recreation, or any other purpose deserves to know that the local police department can fully participate in enforcement of applicable law and is not arbitrarily obliged to turn a blind eye to particular illegal activity merely because local politicians have demanded it. My top priority has always been and will always be keeping Kansans safe. That’s exactly what this legislation that I’m proposing would do, and it’s why it’s so important that we get it passed. In our proud nation of immigrants, emotional immigration politics too often obscure this tragic truth: There are more crime victims in Kansas today because the federal government is failing on border security. It is possible to welcome immigrants without the federal government abdicating its duty at the southern border and without local politicians ordering the police to ignore the law. Thank you for your support, Derek Schmidt | | PAID FOR BY DEREK SCHMIDT FOR KANSAS, INC., KELLY ARNOLD, TREASURER. | | | ---|---|---

Instead of fighting for the issues that matter most to Kentuckians, Republicans in the Kentucky House are trying to pass legislation that would exempt private planes from state and local property taxes. Have you heard what Republican legislators have been up to, Peter?

Instead of fighting for the issues that matter most to Kentuckians, Republicans in the Kentucky House are trying to pass legislation that would exempt private planes from state and local property taxes.

To make matters worse, this bill would reduce local and school tax revenues by $2.5 million annually. Republicans are making it clear what their priorities are – and it's not our children and educators.

While the GOP tries to pass this harmful tax break, Andy is fighting for our students, educators, and public schools. He recently unveiled plans to add nearly $2 billion to the state's education budget which includes salary increases for educators.

He also signed an executive order freezing property tax on vehicles after a 40% increase from the previous year, and proposed a reduction in the sales tax to deal with the rising cost of goods.

clean_body: Friend, I’m thrilled that President Biden just announced Ketanji Brown Jackson as his Supreme Court nominee! Not only will Judge Jackson make history as the first Black woman to ever serve on the Supreme Court, but she is also an intellectual heavyweight and highly regarded jurist who has dedicated her life and career to the service of others. I applaud President Biden for making history with this nomination, and I look forward to the Senate’s speedy confirmation of Judge Jackson. As the far-right supermajority on the Court works to subvert our democracy and unravel fundamental freedoms like a woman’s right to choose, Judge Jackson will be a powerful champion for justice, equality, and the rule of law. A former public defender with a brilliant intellect and track record of public service, Judge Jackson is eminently qualified to serve on the Court and will bring a unique perspective and voice to the bench, one that has been missing for far too long. I also remain clear-eyed about the continued threat the far-right, 6-3 majority on the Court poses to our democracy and fundamental freedoms. While Judge Jackson will bring a much-needed voice to the bench, her nomination will not change the balance of power on the Court. The only way to restore integrity to the Supreme Court is to expand it. Congress must do exactly that, before it’s too late. ### **\- INDems Statement Commemorating National FFA Week, Democrats’ Delivering for Indiana’s Rural Communities -**
“The FFA is embroidered in American history, and on this day, we celebrate Indiana’s agriculture community, small towns, and young people. Members of the FFA are champions and future leaders of our nation who will advocate to conserve our natural resources, fight for agriculture sustainability, and learn life-changing leadership skills in the process. Democrats know Indiana cannot reach its full potential unless rural communities thrive, and it’s imperative that leaders in government always look after the folks who serve in an industry that sustains the lives and livelihoods of our state and nation. Hoosier Democrats applaud the FFA and its members and alumni for answering the call to serve. Democrats join them in this effort and we will keep working overtime to ensure there’s a better future for every family regardless of where they call home. It’s why Democrats were proud to provide transformational investments to every county and for utilities critical for maximized growth in the state’s agriculture industry. This includes investing $7 billion to make our roads and bridges compliant for our combines and tractors, using more than $350 million to expand broadband access in our small towns, and delivering economic assistance to all 92 counties during COVID-19. Democrats secured this better future for Indiana’s farmers in every corner of this state. Without a doubt the FFA will continue to inspire and cultivate some of our own future leaders in all 92 counties. They will transform and build a better tomorrow for Hoosier families, and Democrats celebrate their mission and success.” **\- Mike Schmuhl, Chairman of the Indiana Democratic Party**
### **\- Do Todd Young and Mike Braun Support Republicans’ 2022 Plan to Raise Taxes on Hoosier Families? -**
Indiana Democrats this week called on U.S. Senators Todd Young and Mike Braun to clarify their support for the U.S. Senate Republicans’ 11-point plan - "[Rescue America](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245908/332219905/1361308896?id=0000017f-1cf5-d281-a7ff-3ffd5f4a0000&refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)" - to raise taxes on Hoosiers and invoke divisive culture wars across the state. U.S. Senator Rick Scott proclaimed this agenda as the Republicans’ compass for the 2022 elections, and it’s time for Todd Young to declare whether they support the Republicans’ vision for the Hoosier State. Republicans in the Indiana General Assembly are already enacting this culture war agenda during the 2022 legislative session - including measures to politicize classrooms, attack innocent minors, and restrict voting rights. **The Indiana House of Representatives even approved a tax hike on Hoosiers via[House Bill 1002.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245909/332219906/1791413689?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)**
### **\- Indiana Economic Development Corporation Requests (More) Funding from American Rescue Plan -**
The American Rescue Plan is STILL creating a better future for the Hoosier State. This time, the Indiana Economic Development Corporation (IEDC) [formally applied](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245910/332219907/-213959169?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) to receive more funding through the American Rescue Plan’s [Good Jobs Challenge](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245911/332219908/-213959169?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535). If awarded, these investments will help workers attain in-demand skills that will help them land good-paying jobs. This opportunity is on top of the [$500 million already allotted by the Rescue Plan to fully-fund the state’s READI program](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245912/332219909/-1612065418?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535), a regional economic development initiative aimed to spur job growth in all corners of the state. _Full list of applicants can be found by clicking[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245913/332219910/1285463420?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)_ Indiana Democrats delivered this bright economic future for Hoosier families - no matter where they live. The same cannot be said for Indiana Republicans who flat out voted “NO” on these investments. In fact, Indiana GOP Chairman Kyle Hupfer called these infrastructure projects “[socialism](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245914/332219911/-1180238315?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)” and claimed their opposition to jobs was a “[great campaign to run on](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245915/332219912/178131055?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)”. Democrats will highlight the Republicans’ “NO” record throughout the statewide “The Jobs Tour”. Voters will learn that while Democrats delivered Indiana’s bright economic future, Republicans divided communities with their culture wars. Here is a look at the [U.S. Department of Commerce’s Good Jobs Challenge announcement](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245916/332219913/-213959169?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535).
### **\- Voice Your Opinion, INDems Platform Process Continues -**
It’s an election year across the state, and the Indiana Democratic Party is ready to travel to all 92 counties to help elect community leaders who will deliver on an economic agenda that includes creating jobs, supplying investments in broadband, improving roads/bridges, water, and other infrastructure needs, and securing a better future for the communities we call home. To do that, Indiana Democrats will also begin its biennial tradition of approving a party platform that includes all voices across the state. **_Hearing dates and locations are available below._** Please take a look at a draft of the Indiana Democratic Party’s 2022 Platform, [“The Hoosier Promise” ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42245917/332219914/-1920848487?refcode=idp-em-220225-fff&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTdhNmYzNi05Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EG9NAAcRMEewjxxKboJSCLS4gJyQDXgS-oHKZJjDry0=&emci=4ef99f5d-8796-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=517a6f36-9396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)and consider submitting your suggestions online. Your ideas are valued and important and we’d like to craft a strong platform – with your help – and spread the news across the state during this critical election year.
### **\- Indiana Democratic Party is Hiring -**
**War Room Director** The Indiana Democratic Party seeks a War Room Director to build an innovative program to hold the Indiana Republican Party accountable and inform and educate Hoosier voters year in and year out. A mix between rapid response and lead researcher, the director will work with the IDP team to push back against misinformation, disinformation, and conspiracy theories so all Hoosiers have the freedom to make better and informed decisions on the issues facing our state and country. **Voter File Administrator** The Indiana Democratic Party seeks a Voter File Administrator (VFA) to work on our data team to better serve candidates, committees, and local parties as we seek to build a stronger Democratic Party in the Hoosier State. The role is ideal for someone looking to be more involved in politics and party building and who wants to dedicate themselves to learning more about the inner workings of campaigns, strategy, technology, and voter targeting and contact. Over the last day, we watched as Russia launched a premeditated attack on Ukraine. Our hearts go out to the women, men, and children who have been displaced and separated from their loved ones. Team Victoria stands with the international community which has condemned this unprovoked invasion that has violated the territorial sovereignty of Ukraine.
We stand with those in Congress and the White House who are planning and providing assistance to our NATO allies. Sanctions and de-escalation of violence are essential, and we hope that actions and intentions to help Ukraine citizens evacuate and resettle are swift.
Lastly, we stand our NATO allies with the hope that no U.S. troops will be put in harm's way.
Victoria Virasingh

Friend, This week is Public Schools Week -- when we reflect on the incredible impact that free, widely-available education for all Americans has had on our country. I owe all of my success to public schools. I started at Bret Harte Elementary, then went to California Middle, and then C.K. McClatchy High. I then went to a community college - Sac City - before finishing my Bachelor's at U.C. Berkeley. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42234439/332169549/360059203?refcode=em-2.25.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWUwMDBiYi02Yjk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AcuEt-wqjZYZG-_zHDcloNBmYm-xyOl7y08geLTCHHY=) _Me and my sixth grade class. Yes, I am wearing a turtleneck. No, it was not "cool" at the time._ I believe all Americans deserve a quality education. I also know that quality education costs money, and that's money that we as Americans should spend. Compared to the rest of the developed world, our teachers are underpaid and overburdened. That's why I support more federal funds for education. But fixing education isn't just a question of funding. This year has also seen a worrying escalation in threats and rancor at school board meetings. **Schools cannot become battlegrounds in the “culture war” of the day, and we need leaders who will stand up for the students and school boards in their communities. BOLD PAC Chairman and Congressman Ruben Gallego said the PAC “stands with these candidates who understand the struggles of the Latino community, share our values, and will be leading voices in Congress.”
[**Join BOLD PAC in supporting Gabe: pitch in $10 or more ahead of our February 28 fundraising deadline →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42234481/332169927/-900430888?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220225eom2bold_tv_60da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzZkZGE2Yi02Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6RRrx1m3cc6vbeYwPbUUIsEmHYjARDr89nOzF-1F21Q=)
Here’s what BOLD PAC had to say about backing Gabe in this critical tossup race:
_“A proud first-generation American, Gabe Vasquez is a leader that New Mexico can count on. As a Las Cruces City Councilor, he fought for small businesses and working families. He knows New Mexico’s second district and he’ll fight for all of us in Congress. He will be a champion for our communities, helping secure investments in infrastructure, lowering the cost of living, expanding broadband access, and improving the cost and access to high-quality healthcare.”_
The news was picked up by _The Hill_ , who called NM-02 **“a solid pickup opportunity for Democrats.”**
Gabe is rapidly building a diverse coalition of supporters ahead of the June primary election, but we need to ensure we continue to hit our fundraising goals along the way.
[**Rush $10 or more before Monday’s deadline to help make Gabe the Democratic nominee to take on far-right Yvette Herrell in November and flip NM-02 blue!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42234482/332169928/-900430888?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220225eom2bold_tv_60da_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzZkZGE2Yi02Yzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6RRrx1m3cc6vbeYwPbUUIsEmHYjARDr89nOzF-1F21Q=)

| | |
# **Districts Are Finalized. Petitions are Underway.
Scheller STILL Won't Debate.**
Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Earlier this week, the PA Supreme Court issued a final ruling on the new congressional maps. PA-07 now includes all of Lehigh, Northampton, and Carbon counties, plus the southwestern part of Monroe ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=c5c971fc2a&e=1090c5c412)). If you live in those areas, you can vote for me for US Congress in the upcoming election.

The process for selecting these district boundaries was atrocious. Even though the PA legislature selected a map in accordance with the constitution, the PA Supreme Court overruled that process and picked its own version. This is why it's so important to elect judges who respect the rule of law.

For voters of the Lehigh Valley, the new PA-07 district is a big win. It keeps the Lehigh Valley intact and adds great communities throughout Carbon County. Suddenly, the district is more conservative. Democratic Representative Susan Wild is in real trouble.

Now that the districts are finalized, the nominating process can begin. Starting today through March 15, I need to get 1,000 registered Republicans from the new PA-07 to sign my petition to get on the ballot. I could use your help circulating petitions. If you would like to volunteer, please email Linda Swankoski ([swankoskil@hotmail.com](mailto:Linda Swankoski <swankoskil@hotmail.com>?subject=Petitions&body=I%20would%20like%20to%20circulate%20Kevin's%20nominating%20petitions.%20Please%20let%20me%20know%20how%20to%20get%20involved.)) to get the details.

Meanwhile, Lisa Scheller still refuses to debate.

That's why I'm having our first town hall without her, where I'll take questions directly from Lehigh Valley voters.

**Where: Villa Lentini Ristorante (2700 Balliet Street, Coplay PA 18037)
When: Wednesday, March 2nd. Doors open at 6:00 p.m. Program begins at 7:00 p.m. **

Seating is limited, so please RSVP to [kevin@dellickerforcongress.com](mailto:kevin@dellickerforcongress.com?subject=Town%20Hall%20RSVP&body=I%20will%20attend%20the%20town%20hall%20on%20March%202%20at%206%20p.m.%20at%20Villa%20Lentini%20in%20Coplay.%20%0A%0ANumber%20of%20people%3A%20%0ANames%3A). The forum is free and open to the public. The restaurant will be open if you'd like to buy dinner.

I hope you can attend. Together, we can KEEP AMERICA FREE!

Sincerely,

---
| **War in Ukraine**

I took this picture in 1991 when I was a college student in Moscow. Soviet tanks rolled down the streets in last ditch attempt to preserve the communist regime. That attack on freedom failed. This attack on freedom is just getting started.

I unequivocally condemn Vladimir Putin’s invasion and stand with the free people of Ukraine. This is no time for moral ambiguity, and we need to do more than just send a message. The United States and its allies must respond with strong countermeasures that degrade Russia’s ability to conduct ongoing military operations and punish the Russian government for its deadly decision. We have many tools of US power besides sending American troops to Ukraine. We must apply them swiftly and effectively to ensure that Putin and his allies pay an unacceptable price for their attack against a free and sovereign nation.

The world is a dangerous place. Please keep the people of Ukraine in your prayers, along with our leaders who must make terrible decisions about how to best respond to this latest and serious threat.

| Dear Neighbor,
It was my absolute honor to stand alongside like-minded parents and teachers at the HISD school board meeting to challenge the district's unconstitutional mask mandates.
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001WX3fuo5kW6m7BR-elJIbZNs9ejYVJQ5TzKt2o4ntDy7GYP2ldHwOuTHA3A5D1AXgFbkjFSiFy5Wb4niAJTLeq_M5xQpNbZVSYk_FGFBPoG5o8okJzhXliTs4d-6awV3e5PFbxiCnVv2zlIleFTuli28Fzx8VuYhr51TeT6NGPDsFe3zeXMsG6ktttCMcRVU7DCvDVgWhLe1fpR7aBZXek7i_CLsgZnf1IA4FAR3UUCb6s6MpySUuOA==&c=1uJ72Z4mg9NDdxaS9O9uSRG7JljEOvaw9Dj759NCl2Nyn3HeKtmWtQ==&ch=5gVonmIQ1nDxb_e3tEzyT4Gbdrtv1v3bci0b0OhHcLeZdaeLNwTc7Q==)
---
For over two years now, Houston students have been forced to wear a mask in school. As the COVID-19 survival rate for American children is 99.9%, masks are completely unnecessary. They are also disruptive to learning and communicating in classrooms and have a negative, psychological impact. They are dehumanizing and inhibit the ability to see and process non-verbal communication. This mandate is abusive, and I was more than happy to protest it with other Texans.
I'm also proud to be one of two TX38 congressional candidates on the Republican ballot who signed the Texans for Vaccine Choice Protection Pledge, promising the citizens of the State of Texas that I will "vigorously work to prohibit all vaccine mandates in Texas, including those imposed by both public and private businesses, and I support a special session to do so immediately."
---
---
The issue of forced vaccination is a personal one as it has affected those close to me. The coercive effort by both the Biden Administration and complicit corporations to increase vaccination numbers is immoral and repugnant. The lengths through which those close to me have had to go to state, prove, and defend their religious reasons for not complying with vaccine mandates should be considered unlawful. Vaccination is a decision to be made by the individual. I have and will always defend vaccine choice.
---
---
Finally, it gave me immense pleasure to join other congressional candidates such as Robby Starbuck, Christian Collins, Bo Hines, and Andrew McCarthy in signing the Michael Knowles Federal Public Health Protection Pledge. By signing it, I have given my total commitment to subpoena Anthony Fauci for an investigation into his corrupt activities and the lies he's told to both Congress and to the American people throughout the COVID-19 pandemic. I have also committed to sponsoring and voting for legislation that will reduce his salary to ZERO dollars. His actions towards Americans have been criminal. He will be held accountable.
---
My promise to you has been to always fight for your freedoms. Whether it is by doing so now, in TX38 and in our broader Houston community, or in the future as your congressman in Washington, I will stand by that promise.
It will be my honor to do so.
---
---

I lost my dad in an ICU in 2014. That was a life-changing, and career-changing, experience for me. Being on the other side allows you to know what empathy means. The right answer is not always clear. You have to try different things. **You have to listen to people. You have to put together a plan and a collaborative group.**
Those are skills that translate directly to government. I tell people: _Government is not a business. Government exists to solve big problems that we can’t solve on our own._ And that’s exactly what I do in the ICU every single day.
To be even more direct about it, I think we need a governor who is not actively working against us. What we were feeling during the height of the pandemic in my ICU was _never_ matched by our governor. School districts should have some local control — if you feel like masks are necessary in your schools to keep your students and your kids safe, the governor should not override that with an executive order, which is exactly what happened here. Threatening to defund the Department of Health for vaccine outreach to minors? That’s ludicrous. Getting people vaccinated is the way we reduce severe and life-threatening disease.
**I tell people all the time that freedom without responsibility is not liberty. It’s adolescence. That’s what we’re dealing with right now in state government, and that’s what this campaign is trying to fix.**

clean_body: Freedom without responsibility is not liberty. It’s adolescence. | | = Hey Peter. People ask me all the time: “How does being an ICU doctor make you qualified to lead our state? (If you already understand what I’d bring to the table, read no further and =) = I lost my dad in an ICU in 2014. That was a life-changing, and career-changing, experience for me. Being on the other side allows you to know what empathy means. The right answer is not always clear. You have to try different things. You have to listen to people. You have to put together a plan and a collaborative group. Those are skills that translate directly to government. I tell people: Government is not a business. Government exists to solve big problems that we can’t solve on our own. And that’s exactly what I do in the ICU every single day. To be even more direct about it, I think we need a governor who is not actively working against us. What we were feeling during the height of the pandemic in my ICU was never matched by our governor. School districts should have some local control — if you feel like masks are necessary in your schools to keep your students and your kids safe, the governor should not override that with an executive order, which is exactly what happened here. | | Fellow Patriot:

Are you ready for World War III?

I’m not. **And I know you’re not either.**

But my warmonger opponent, along with most of the corrupt Republican and Democrat Uniparty Establishment, is cheerleading for a war with Russia over the Ukraine.

Just this week, my opponent Deep State Steve clearly implied that he supports sending American soldiers to die in the Ukraine.

This is **__MADNESS.__**

Some of these America Last Neocons have even talked about a nuclear strike! Pure insanity.

_These same RINOs are willing to send your children—and your hard-earned money—to die for Ukraine’s borders,_while they totally ignore the invasion at our own Southern Border!__

For 20 years, our Middle Eastern wars bled our nation dry, killed tens of thousands of our best and brightest young Americans, and enriched nobody but the bankers and defense contractors who bribe our politicians.

These very same defense contractors—evil corporate special interests like Raytheon, fueled by American misery—are the ones bankrolling my opponent’s $2 million war chest.

The military-industrial complex, which serves every interest in the world except our own, makes up a large portion of my opponent’s donors.

This blood money keeps our fat cat politicians rich, and keeps those politicians sending our boys to die in wars that don’t serve American interests one bit.

They’ve never met a war they didn’t love. But I don’t see them volunteering themselves or their loved ones to go to the front lines.

**If elected, I vow that I will NEVER send one penny of American treasure or spill one drop of American blood on ANY foreign wars—unless they are in _direct defense _of our homeland.**

_No more wars._ The American people are tired of fighting pointless, endless wars.

Putting America First and supporting our troops means only deploying our military when _absolutely necessary_.

**__The U.S. Army should only be in ONE place: Our Southern Border!__**

With his unhinged rhetoric trying to start a pointless war with Russia, my opponent is putting Arkansas Last—and putting his defense industry donors first.

**[_RINO warmongers are a clear and present danger to everyone in this country. Every single one of them must be removed from office. Start by electing me._

_Send a Defense Industry shill packing and elect a real Fighter who will NEVER support another pointless foreign war_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=57f2a2ea21&e=eda539b26b). **

[**_Help me tell the Establishment that the people are tired of endless wars_ _ \-- Chip into my election campaign right away and show them the power of the America First movement_**](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=c1a3df33ed&e=eda539b26b) _._

_We need PATRIOTS who will**FIGHT** for the **AMERICAN** people, not the D.C Fat Cats._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=929726a082&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar
_Republican for U.S. Congress, AR-03_

**P.S. The Republican Party of Arkansas is pulling out all the stops to kill my authentic America First campaign. ** [_**I know you're ready to replace these worthless RINOs with America First conservatives like me, and that's why I'm counting on your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today**_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=e1ff9eebef&e=eda539b26b)** _._**

Hey,
We’re so excited – President Biden JUST announced that he’s nominating Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson to be the FIRST Black woman on the Supreme Court of the United States.
This is a huge milestone. But despite her qualifications, the GOP is already gearing up to fight her nomination and try to block Judge Jackson from the Court. **It’s just another reason why we need to protect and expand our Senate majority in 2022.**

subject: Will you help us make history on the Supreme Court?
body:
Learn more about Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson. | | | |
---
| | |
---
| Dear Friends,

After discussions with Senators across both political parties and input from legal experts, President Biden found Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson at the end of the process. Judge Jackson comes from a wealth of experience and has already been confirmed _**three times**_ by the Senate. It will be up to the Senate once again to ensure that our land’s highest court will reflect the richness of our nation.

Over the span of 232 years, the Supreme Court of the United States has seen 115 judges serve on the bench. In this time, there has not been a single Black woman nominated to the highest court in the land. Today, President Biden has announced that the Supreme Court will finally have the opportunity to look more like the people it serves.

We ask that you join us in supporting this historic nomination and Judge Jackson, as she stands before the Senate. You can do so by signing up at the link below. If you know others who would also like to support Judge Jackson, please do share the link and/or this newsletter!
---
| [Show Your Support](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=6b74a7bce2&e=d6c5c7d7ec "Show Your Support")
---
| In addition to this announcement, President Biden will be giving his State of the Union speech next week. The President will outline ways that his administration has built our country back better, as well as what he hopes to accomplish going forward. Please join us on Tuesday, March 1st to reflect and look forward as a nation.
Best,
Brencia Berry
Director of Coalitions and Community Engagement
Democratic National Committee
---
|
---
| **Meet the Honorable Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson**
---
|
---
|
* Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson was raised in Miami, and went on to study government at Harvard University. She then attended Harvard Law School, where she served as the supervising editor of the Harvard Law Review.
* Judge Jackson’s family exemplifies a true American success story thanks to hard work and determination. Her parents went to segregated schools and experienced the Jim Crow South as kids, but through hard work, they went to and graduated from college and became public school teachers. Eventually, her father went on to earn a law degree too. And now their daughter can become the first Black woman to serve on the Supreme Court.
* Judge Jackson comes from a family of police officers and worked as a public defender. She has also served on the bipartisan US Sentencing Commission and as judge on the District Court and D.C. Circuit Court of Appeal. She would be the first public defender to serve on the Supreme Court.
* Judge Jackson clerked for Justice Breyer, where she learned the great rigor through which Justice Breyer approached the work and his willingness to work with colleagues of different viewpoints. She will bring that experience and the same approach to bear on the Supreme Court.
* Judge Jackson has been confirmed by the Senate three times, twice unanimously.
* Former Speaker Paul Ryan praised her when she was nominated for District Court in 2012. “Our politics may differ, but my praise for Ketanji’s intellect, for her character, for her integrity is unequivocal,” he said. “She’s an amazing person, and I favorably recommend her consideration.”
* President Obama called her an “unwavering voice for justice and fairness” when he nominated her to the U.S. Sentencing Commission.
* DNC Chair Jaime Harrison stated that “Judge Jackson will bring a wealth of knowledge and experience to the Court. Her experience as a public defender will add a vital perspective. In short, Judge Jackson will live up to the legacy of Justice Breyer and the other qualified jurists that have served and continue to serve on the Supreme Court.”

---

That’s exactly what has happened. I’m proud my hometown has led the way, with Roseville Joint Union High School District passing a mask choice Resolution. [Dozens of districts](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvXjywgur4GeOjOHd8mH7XIVDSK0MRCQXzBKAjtiS-a4doKS0cDrEIHszc71g9laew&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb25_final&n=2) have now followed. Hello,
Wednesday night, as bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. **Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.**
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder. Today, they have accomplices.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. **My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.**
If I defeat Chuck Grassely and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.

| | De Gregorio Named To NRCC’s Young Gun “On the Radar” Program
---
| **FAIR LAWN** – Today, Nick De Gregorio, a Marine Veteran who served in both Iraq and Afghanistan, and Republican Candidate for Congress in New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District, was [named](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=acc7aed033&e=31104c58a7) by the National Republican Congressional Committee to its Young Gun “On the Radar” recruitment and support program. “I am grateful that national Republicans have met our incredible energy and resolve on the ground here with recognition of our ability to win. I hear from Fifth District families every day about the terrible consequences of Joe Biden and Josh Gottheimer’s inflationary spending spree. Today, we are one step closer to bringing common sense back to Congress.” – Nick De Gregorio De Gregorio previously reported having raised $403,000 on its end-of-year report for 2021 and released key endorsements from Fifth Congressional District leaders, including support from District 39 Assemblyman Robert Auth (R, Old Tappan) and Assemblywoman DeAnne DeFuccio (R, Upper Saddle River). According to the [NRCC](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=9cb57e32a5&e=31104c58a7): “On the Radar candidates are individuals running in competitive congressional seats. They have met the minimum threshold for campaign organization and show potential to achieve greater status in the program as the cycle progresses.” CLICK [HERE](https://nickfornj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d957ded20397fa5245442e969&id=f07c866fe7&e=31104c58a7) TO DOWNLOAD A HI-RES PHOTO OF NICK. **About Nick ** Nick De Gregorio is a lifelong resident of Bergen County, raised in both Glen Rock and Ridgewood. At the age of 16, Nick was sitting in a high school classroom in Oradell when terrorists struck the World Trade Center just 12 miles away. It was then that he made the first adult decision of his life: to serve his country. Nick answered his country’s call to serve in the wake of the 9/11 attacks, and he joined the United States Marine Corps. Over the course of nine years, he deployed four times, fighting in both Iraq and Afghanistan. It was the honor of his lifetime to serve his country. Nick lives in Fair Lawn with his wife Emily, who during the COVID-19 pandemic worked as a nurse on the front lines, along with their two children Siena Reagan and Luca Cordell. He received a Bachelor’sdegree from Bucknell University and MastersDegrees from Georgetown University’s McDonough School of Business and the Walsh School of Foreign Service, with distinction.

body:
After I left the UN, I took up running.
& nbsp; &nb; sp;
Not interested? [Unsubscribe Here](https://trk.cp20.com/form?3ktk0--fgxr-4qqlpo8&sl=2d&t=5&ac=gh7s)

| | Fellow Conservative,

After I left the UN, I took up running.

I played sports growing up, but I had never been an active runner. The idea of committing to something without knowing if I’d be any good at it was, to be honest, more than a little scary.

**But one of the most important things we can do in life is to push through the fear.** **[When I ran for the state legislature, when I ran for governor, when I came to the United Nations—I always made sure I never got too comfortable.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ktk0-209vd-4qqlpo7/ "When I ran for the state legislature, when I ran for governor, when I came to the United Nations—I always made sure I never got too comfortable. ") **

So I laced up my shoes, put my music on (Joan Jett, of course) and put one foot in front of the other. I worked hard and I pushed myself.

Last December, I finished my first half-marathon—something I never thought I could do two years ago.

---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ktk0-209ve-4qqlpo8/)
---

**Running a half-marathon was a huge challenge.** So was running for state legislature and for governor. But they were important races to run.

**[As we look at the next election, it can be daunting.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ktk0-209vf-4qqlpo9/ "As we look at the next election, it can be daunting.")** This year Republicans have a huge opportunity to take back the House, the Senate, and win statewide races across the country.

But just like running a half-marathon, it will take work. Some days will be difficult. The Democrats will launch attacks against Republicans to try and divide our party. Liberal billionaires will push millions of dollars into key battleground states to try and prevent us from winning in November.

This election year will not be easy. But it will be filled with races that we must win.

When it comes to running a race, it’s also important to remember that you can’t just wake up one day and magically expect to run 13.1 miles. You have to build up stamina and strength step by step and mile by mile. You have to put in work each day to make it to the finish line.

**That’s the same with this year’s election.** _**[We can’t just wake up on November 8 and expect to win. We have to put in the work each and every day to gear up for victory.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ktk0-209vg-4qqlpo0/ "We can’t just wake up on November 8 and expect to win. We have to put in the work each and every day to gear up for victory. ")**_

That’s why Stand For America PAC isn’t waiting until the fall to hit the ground running. My team started laying the groundwork for victory over a year ago. We’ve trained, endorsed, advised, and financially supported dozens of strong conservatives. We helped Glenn Youngkin and Jason Miyares cross the finish line in Virginia and helped Jack Ciattarelli pull off a near-upset in New Jersey.

But our work is far from done. We must keep up the momentum that we gained over the past year and continue to build our movement one person at a time.

**[ I hope you will be one of the people who steps up today to keep our movement strong and help conservative candidates cross the finish line.

If you would like to help us continue our momentum going into the 2022 election, I’m asking you to donate a special gift of $1, $35, $50, $100, $500, or more today.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ktk0-209vh-4qqlpo1/ "I hope you will be one of the people who steps up today to keep our movement strong and help conservative candidates cross the finish line.If you would like to help us continue our momentum going into the 2022 election, I’m asking you to donate a special gift of $1, $35, $50, $100, $500, or more today. ")**

Thank you in advance for your generous contribution.

My very best,

Nikki R. Haley

| The 2022 Congress of Counties is finally here!

With a crowd of over 400 Hoosier Republicans, we kicked off the event with welcoming remarks from Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch and State Auditor Tera Klutz!

But our day is just getting started! We've got one more breakout session yet today with presentations from top insiders on topics like campaign fundraising and grassroots tactics that are going to give us the edge up at _**all** _levels come this November.

Plus, we'll be ending the night with a reception featuring Sen. Todd Young and Gov. Eric Holcomb that will be sure to fire up the crowd and power us through to election day!

Be sure to follow the Indiana Republican Party on all social media platforms to stay up-to-date on everything that's happening this weekend.

Enjoy this week's newsletter and share it with a friend.

Best,

Chairman Kyle Hupfer

_**Gov. Holcomb** addresses the crowd at the statehouse during Indiana FFA Day._
| On Wednesday, **Gov. Holcomb** was joined by**Lt. Gov. Crouch** , Indiana State Department of Agriculture Director **Bruce Kettler** , and 115 Indiana Future Farmers of America members at the statehouse for Indiana FFA Day. Earlier this week, **Gov. Holcomb** signed a proclamation to name this week FFA Week in recognition of all the work the Indiana FFA Organization, agriculture educators, and FFA advisors do to cultivate the next generation of agriculturists for our state. You can read the proclamation [here](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=c745feb356&e=1acd9bb3d6).
_"I'm always thrilled to see the [Indiana FFA Association] at the Statehouse and it was an honor to speak to them today. It's safe to say that our future is in great hands." _
— **Gov. Eric Holcomb**
_**Indiana Agriculture Fast Facts:**_
* Agriculture contributes an estimated $31.2 **billion** to Indiana’s economy.
* Indiana is the eighth largest agricultural exporter in the nation, exporting just over $4.6 billion in 2017.
* There are just over 94,000 farmers in Indiana.

— **Gov. Eric Holcomb**

_**Sen. Todd Young** speaks on the impact of inflation._
| Last week, Sen. Todd Young joined fellow Republicans at a press conference on the impact bad Democratic policies have had on inflation, and consequently, Hoosier families.

"Forty years, a forty-year high in price inflation and $276 in additional expenditures for working families each month, that’s the average amount that Hoosier families are having to pay on account of policy decisions.

“I’ll continue to advocate for smart policies, as opposed to these ill-advised policies, because this is having a real impact on rank-and-file Americans, and it has to stop."

#
Peter,
Remember this? Last month, FBI agents raided Rep. Henry Cuellar’s house and campaign office, collecting and carrying out evidence.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/96003?refcode=em20220225-22150&t=1&akid=22150%2E1203867%2EDaxpv_)
NOW, reports say that Cuellar sent nearly $100,000 of campaign cash between 2004 and 2010 to a company HE registered. There’s a cloud of corruption investigations hanging over Cuellar, BUT he has a huge $2 million war chest and a chance to still win his race against Justice Democrat Jessica Cisneros.
We’ve been worried that we might get outspent badly in this race. But the FBI investigation blew the race open and Jessica can win this race if we continue to send support her way.
[Rush a $3 split contribution straight to Jessica Cisneros and Justice Democrats right now to help us defeat Cuellar. Justice Democrats

**Statement on Russia's ****Invasion**** of Ukraine**
---
| | | Over the last week, we’ve watched as Russia has invaded Ukraine. In a rare display of bipartisan support, Congress is largely backing Biden’s decision to confront Russia with potentially escalating sanctions.

Let’s be clear: While I fully support these sanctions, they are too little too late. The Biden administration has signaled weakness, and this weakness has invited Russian aggression.

Biden’s capitulation in Afghanistan, his weakness on Ukraine and with Iran are an unmistakable invitation to Communist China. Unless this administration can summon courage and strength, look for more Communist Chinese aggression against Taiwan on the horizon.

Stand with me and together we’ll re-establish America’s National Security and Sovereignty.

clean_body: I’ve learned a thing or two during my time overseas. Please see a note from one of our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe visit this Peter, The Biden Administration, with its absolutely disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan, sent the world a message that America is capricious, cowardly, and abandons its allies — and even its own citizens. We’ve seen what happens when career politicians without any skin in the game make foreign policy decisions that greatly impact our nation... and the world. This is why it is important for America to have strong, capable leaders in government who understand and take our national security seriously... And it’s why I’m reaching out to you, Peter. My name is Marjorie K. Eastman. I’m a veteran, military wife, mother, and businesswoman – and I’m running to represent North Carolina in the U.S. Senate. When I look at the direction our country is heading in, I’m worried. I’m concerned about career politicians’ inability to govern and protect our freedoms. And I’m worried my son won’t have the same freedoms and opportunities you and I did. When I joined the Army as an Intelligence Officer and Commander, I took an oath to protect and defend those freedoms. That’s what I’ve always done – and will continue to do in the U.S. Senate. I bring something unique to this race, Peter. I’m the only combat veteran and conservative outsider. I know what it means to go to war, to put your life on the line for your country. I’ve seen first-hand what freedom trulycosts – and that’s something that can’t be bought. In the days and weeks after 9/11, I was like so many other Americans. I felt compelled to serve my country, and I have – through 10 years of intelligence service and two deployments. When I returned home, I faced a personal battle: my son was diagnosed with cancer. I quickly transitioned back into mom mode. My husband and I prayed every day, and eventually, my son beat his diagnosis. I’ve stood by my husband and supported his military career while also working in the private and non-profit sector, all with their own unique challenges. All of these battles led me to this mission today. body:
You can't campaign in a democratic election and support the authoritarian in the war. | | | [ ](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953woiJTPNyd4kdozAt3MOqOkER6EhOxl7C27V4_Ptd8NsHpnwpuQv7oschKRnbby0ljjAf2iHZC1MkKOfh6pmXz8WbZUk6f4kEcQfga3DG3NUXD59_6UF7NS-y2LKW13VpIF9f6Aoyc2NJ6qcLuo4fH6_QgibRylTQXpYsH4F6f-d-XGbYmdkIQzuYAO01rzXPWMa0DdIBFZBvgBjhwMkNR0wsBYO8WG1w2ZD2OH5MvPtergflxw8y6_R0UPftkcOTQfWq2oXB8VmDuZRQYgFTjUS_6v7SpqxVAiD7tiN2qy1COCVfcoVeYXW4l0TppuS-oSVR086X0g0ykH3x5Qwo-6RvOj7yzCI1GgDymLVP7zFU1iVhykt_LlzKg56YmMebzKkipFP28VLGi_Z3TAQRoq/3jv/-KTeYIksQ1W6GP8vYqAphg/h0/layVZwYZylSF0nQKKv1ILaBJ4T5PJ3avrt9kib40jGk) Friend,

Team Winter strives to treat you, our community of supporters, with respect and transparency. With that in mind, the Kremlin’s illegal invasion of Ukraine — and our opponent’s unprecedented and longstanding support for the dictator responsible — makes this email different from the ones we usually send.

We write to you today with heavy hearts, in the spirit of sensitivity to the ongoing crisis and deep concern for what comes next.

**The Kremlin’s invasion of Ukraine is a blatant violation of international law that shocks every American dedicated to free people and to democracy.**

Vladimir Putin’s authoritarian regime is violently attacking the democratically elected government of Ukraine, breaking all international laws, norms, and values. Disturbingly, our opponent, Ryan Zinke, has a long documented history of expressing open admiration for this totalitarian dictator. We got into this race to fight for the dignity of Montanans, to bring health care to rural America, to fight climate change. Never in a million years did we think we would be fighting an opponent who sides with violent dictators. But there was Zinke _this week_ at Mar-a-Lago with Trump as the Kremlin bombed Ukrainian cities.

**Zinke also used his stature as a United States Representative to tell the world that Putin was a better leader than Barack Obama — and part of the evidence Zinke cited to support him was Putin’s success “spreading Russian influence in Ukraine.”**

Later, as a member of the Trump administration, Zinke never spoke out against the former president’s attempt to extort the Ukrainian government into damaging his domestic political opponent — not even when the extortion attempt got the president impeached.

His silence was not an accident. And despite what Trump says, Putin is no “genius”. He is a war criminal, a bigot, and a tyrant — qualities no American should admire.

**It’s incredible that this even has to be said in the world’s oldest democracy, but you cannot campaign in a democratic election and support the authoritarian in the war.** And without the open, vocal support of American elected officials such as Ryan Zinke, Donald Trump, and others, Putin would not feel so emboldened as he does now.

Like many of you, watching this crisis from afar, we are eager for some way to help support the people of Ukraine in this dark hour.

**We will personally be giving to the United Nations’ Ukraine Humanitarian Fund, which distributes donations to on-the-ground partner organizations for direct humanitarian relief.[You can join us by clicking here.](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/Mqag7sW8TIW-nixyBdulQmGi_SpZB4lYFrLFe3ls-jfzi_2VC_ZNE0uzoJLWaw7nGGNmEhMlbLVZ-NF3mKGEy8NRMgrPLifI_SZkqej2Iu8tzpn5gP6G6K9x8zBOGi-SqgNaIE71MT_tdU6igtEYB9hll57ADXWujCXZZUjTYaagiNb8YB5QIgSUlPbLwThWik8wjwQMievMu_o0avd1qnglJE0Mjzv-K7K-T6hW36lbO_Lb7FGPn_JRLne2Uh4-w9mN8Q4dQCWCd0wHOvr_M8t0Xpw-TcPPRJ-HhhHV_Re-F4R1sk3wDFXnik9V_lwR7Wz-xJ3GaiPplcyXvrjz2g/3jv/-KTeYIksQ1W6GP8vYqAphg/h1/g_GyNNhpaIgVjpIjDBdOwDc7L5hLKBXFx0crOep2tF8) **

Thank you for being a part of our community of supporters fighting for the dignity of our Montana community. **There is no dignity in supporting a violent, bigoted Russian demagogue over the free people of Ukraine.**

It’s up to all of us to ensure the United States continues to stand for democracy and humanity. We will be standing against Zinke and his terrible judgment on behalf of our home here in Montana, while supporting the people of Ukraine however we can.

In solidarity,
Team Winter | [DONATE >>](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x5NBheYHjUvzNKN38fqcgWOKnL2OUf71Xp_eQDIdzqYLAAnOqcWUe0_fsjrli2dfcLwqXqazE54rPA7fV4taEOip9q3FTGPAM9TasQCstRMX2k8MXdfHzTX4iscodGSw76EKm753T9dWDOGqBD-yxM7zSU9IntkAgVsRJsmDtvC26EA9xbpORl6qYzAszKMRNHkbbLiZMsf-oRg0Oyzm6o2sGPS6Vu5FlmkhyBsFirvKucClZYlGgm1l9HSPbHwvVs6o1p9W9904B9-G76xrdd8sM8aS-hRU6gxVHOgMPB4O0UGePoRAIiaFxY4d1GwjrOlht0s2ZG5Dg8g8Lp5N5-YAIo49RFolvwGD-2GLR3UBExCUcDrkFEaZCjtQ8H0AM/3jv/-KTeYIksQ1W6GP8vYqAphg/h2/K5Ygj55ps5VmJn3pHA9hhs0MYXI-5W8fNzU0QjypKu8)
