---
I bet you the Democrats know it.
But they don’t want Black Americans finding out.
_Why?_
**Because it _DESTROYS_ their lie that the Democrat Party is the party of Black America.**
But the truth is the Republican Party has been the home for Black Americans from the very beginning, starting with Sen. Revels.
Today we celebrate 152 since the first Black American - **a REPUBLICAN** \- officially took his seat in the United States Senate.
**And now we have great Black Republicans like _Herschel Walker_ who are following in Sen. Revel’s footsteps by running for the Senate in Georgia.**
[](https://www.bampac.org/herschelwalkerbaf?info=2022EU0301&recruiter_id=62264&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022eu0301&n=3)

Revels’ historic election and to help elect Black Conservatives take America back today!](https://www.bampac.org/herschelwalkerbaf?info=2022EU0301&recruiter_id=62264&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022eu0301&n=4)**

Fellow American,

body:
For more than two decades, Putin has been trending authoritarian. He destroyed Russia’s fledgling democracy.
#
Derek —
Last night Russia launched an invasion into Ukraine. Despite what people like Tucker Carlson and Donald Trump tell you, there are several reasons the U.S. faces the prospect of a major war in Europe, initiated by their idol, Vladimir Putin.
Here’s why:
For more than two decades, Putin has been trending authoritarian. He destroyed Russia’s fledgling democracy and has sown chaos in his neighborhood to reestablish Russian power. For Putin, this is a zero-sum game. Putin wins if his opponents lose. Russia views the U.S. as an enemy.
His increasing belligerence and efforts to upend the international order—an order that has enabled decades of US prosperity—have largely gone unchallenged. The West looked the other way in hopes of cooperation with Russia. This was misplaced because our interests and values never aligned.
We are at a crisis point because Russia understood the decades-long lack of consequences as a lack of resolve to protect our alliances, partnerships, and even democracy. The bill has come due. We failed to hold Putin accountable and failed to deter.
This is where people like Trump and Tucker Carlson come in. Putin has long wanted control over a rising Ukraine, and they offered him the opportunity. Trump, Tucker, and the like drive hyper-partisanship by attacking Americans and calling them the enemy.
They cheerlead for authoritarians. They pander to the most bellicose and belligerent authoritarian, Putin. Tucker Carlson and Trump are regularly played on Russian state-run media.
No one wants war. I have seen war and can envision the human toll and the subsequent geopolitical catastrophe that will ensue. The best way to prevent war is by defending U.S. interests and values. What Putin–and it seems Tucker, Trump, and others–don’t appreciate is that our country is wonderful. It is the greatest country in the world.
We need not be bullies, we just need to be confident and defend our interests. If we do that, Russia won’t dare challenge us directly.
Now that the attack is underway, we will be faced with a flood of lies and disinformation.
Lies and disinformation from Russia.
Lies and disinformation from Trump and Tucker Carlson.
Lies and disinformation from those who enable them.
VoteVets has a critical role in fighting back against that disinformation campaign, but we cannot do it alone. So I am asking:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to VoteVets today to help us fight back against the lies and disinformation of Trump, Tucker Carlson, and those who enable them? This is going to be an important part of how the country, and the world, responds to Russia’s attack on Ukraine.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vv-pac-disinfo-ukr?refcode=em220225-2-tb2-c2&t=1&refcode2=4380_3013755_lqKyj5&akid=4380%2E3013755%2ElqKyj5)

---

Alex Vindman

name: Delegate John McGuire III
subject: Big Announcement/ Session Update Jan 2022 Week 7
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Friends of John McGuire
body:
---
| | | | | | 2022 Session Update Week 7
---
| VA Delegate John McGuire (Navy SEAL - Father - Business Owner)
---
|
---
| The General Assembly convened on January 12, marking the beginning of the 402nd legislative session of the House of Delegates.
---
| We have much work ahead of us to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. It is an honor to be your voice and fight for you in Richmond
---
| John McGuire for Senate District 10
---
|
---
| In case you missed it, I announced my candidacy for the Senate of Virginia's 10th District for 2023. Redistricting has moved me away from almost everyone I've represented in the House of Delegates. Senate District 10 will allow me to continue to serve you and thousands of other friends and constituents who I've served over the last five years. I've included my statement, the new Virginia State Senate District 10 map, and a list of D10 counties. This is a plus 30 Republican district with no incumbent. The green area outlined on the map is over 50% of the district, and it shows areas which I have represented and/or campaigned in for years. I would love to meet with you, hear your concerns, earn your endorsement, and your vote. Email [john@mcguireforvirginia.com](mailto:john@mcguireforvirginia.com) Please share!
---
|
---
| List of VA Senate District 10 Counties:
Hanover Powatan Louisa Fluvanna Goochland Buckingham Appomattox Amelia Prince Edward Cumberland
---
| Please Pray for Ukraine
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Evil does exist. Russia invaded Ukraine Thursday morning, and many innocent people are suffering or dying as a result. There are 23,000 Americans still in Ukraine. Despite the odds, the people of Ukraine are fighting back. Perhaps Americans are waking up and realizing that Trump policies which Biden has rejected, such as strengthening our military, securing our southern border, holding our allies accountable, making America energy independent, etc., are incredibly good ideas that lead to a safer world after all. Stay vigilant, and please pray for Ukraine!
---
| Hanover County Veterans
---
|
---
|
---
| General Janice Igou introduced me to one her fellow Hanover Veterans Bobby Parrish who served in the Navy aboard the U.S.S. Isherwood Destroyer (DD-520). Thank you for your service!
---
| Future Farmers of America (FFA) Week
---
|
---
| This is National FFA week. We must encourage efforts to help young people get into agriculture. The average age of a farmer today is 60 years old. The National FFA Organization was actually started here in Virginia and they are celebrating their 97th year this year. FFA Promotes career success and personal growth through work-based learning in agricultural education. They currently have over 220 local chapters, 330 Agricultural teachers, close to 10,000 FFA Members, and serve over 32,000 students in Agricultural classes across the state. Our local chapters range from the most rural areas to urban centers and private schools. If you ask around in the House and Senate, you'll find a great number of former FFA Members who attribute much of their success to the Blue FFA jacket. Thank you for all that you do to support farmers, and for helping to prepare our young people for life!
---
| Winsome Earle-Sears Day!
---
|
---
| Governor Glenn Youngkin issued a proclamation, declaring February 23rd, 2022, as Winsome Earle-Sears Day! Congratulations, Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears! We are so proud and honored to have you representing the great state of Virginia!
---
| John Ortiz of Louisa County
---
|
---
| I met with John Ortiz of Louisa County to discuss early childhood legislation and his company, Little Leaf Village Academy, LLC. Thanks for stopping by to share your concerns!
---
| Military and Veterans' Caucus
---
|
---
| We received a brief at the Military and Veterans Caucus from the National Ground Intelligence Center and discussed Veteran related legislation.
---
| Mid-Atlantic Titan Reception
---
|
---
| We attended the Mid-Atlantic Titan Reception sponsored by Vectre , with the Secretary of Transportation Sheppard Miller III, fellow delegates, and business owners from around the Commonwealth. Thank you for sharing your concerns.
---
| Virginia Tech Center Isle Presentation
---
|
---
| This week my friend and seat mate, Delegate Jason Ballard also a veteran, delivered a center aisle presentation to celebrate 150 years of Hokie Nation! Congratulations, Virginia Tech, on this big anniversary!
---
| Virginia Law Enforcement Sheriff's Reception
---
|
---
| Glenn Youngkin, Winsome Sears, Jason Miyares, and many other fellow legislators attended the Virginia Law Enforcement Sheriff's Reception, with officers from all over Virginia. Thank you for keeping us safe.
---
| Invocation
---
|
---
| This week an invocation was given by Dr. Tracie A. Daniels, the senior pastor of Saint Mark Baptist Church in Maidens, Virginia. Dr. Daniels is a native of Louisa County and she is also a member of the Goochland Ministers Conference. Three of her four children are triplets. One of those triplets, John Daniels, is The Chief of Staff for Democrat Delegate Sullivan, both seen here in the photo. Thank you, Dr. Daniels, for praying for Virginia.
---
| Young Republican Federation of Virginia (YRFV)
---
|
---
| I enjoyed meeting with the Young Republican Federation of Virginia (YRFV). The Young Republican Federation of Virginia is the Commonwealth's premier Republican organization for young Republicans between the ages of 18 and 40. Established in 1936, YRFV is a political grassroots organization of individual YRs chapters that lead recruitment and volunteer efforts across the Commonwealth on behalf of Republican candidates.
---
| Bipartisan Breakfast
---
|
---
| Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears was the host of a bipartisan breakfast at the Oliver Hill Bldg this week. Thank you!
---
| VA Tech Celebrates 150 Years
---
|
---
|
---
| My wife Tracy McGuire is my favorite Hokie! We attended the Virginia Tech Reception in Richmond. It is an honor to serve on the higher education committee in the General Assembly.
---
| Conservative Caucus
---
|
---
| The Conservative Caucus meets each week to review legislation to help ensure we vote in accordance with our conservative values.
---
| Presidents Day
---
|
---
| On presidents day, we took this picture in front of George Washington with The Goochland Leadership Enterprise, an organization that informs and educates interested citizens about issues facing the County to foster citizen involvement in making Goochland a desirable place to live, work and enjoy life.
---
| HB 60
---
|
---
| Success! HB 60, a bill that I'm carrying for the town of Louisa, passed the Senate Local Government full committee this 14-0. This bill will give the town of Louisa flexibility with regard to the number of members required to do work on the Economic DevelopmentAuthority board.
---
| Goochland Leadership Development Team
---
|
---
| The Goochland Leadership Development team visited the Capitol and met with Delegate Lee Ware, Senator Mark Peake, and myself. Thank you for stopping by to tour the Capitol and to learn more about the legislature.
---
| House Budget
---
|
---
| On Thursday we voted on a budget that lowered taxes and funded initiatives that will help make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family!
---
| Henrico GOP Breakfast
---
|
---
|
---
| Delegate Buddy Fowler and I gave a legislative update at the Saturday Henrico GOP breakfast. It was a packed house!
---

Senate District 10 will allow me to continue to serve you and thousands of other friends and constituents who I've served over the last five years. FFA Promotes career success and personal growth through work-based learning in agricultural education. Authoritarian thug Vladimir Putin invaded Ukraine in his quest to return the Soviet Union to its former glory. Putin, the former KGB operative, must be stopped. We all stand with the freedom loving Ukrainian people. Campaign talk seems petty by comparison to the suffering of the Ukrainians, but I do want to give you an update We continue to gather support form all parts of the state. Our message of stopping the crime wave, getting politicians out of our kids’ lives, and rebuilding our devastated Illinois economy is resonating. I am the only candidate in the race who has created jobs. And I am the only Republican candidate who can win in all areas of the state. On the other side, JB Pritzker had another bad week. The court ruled against him for a second time on his unconstitutional mask mandate, a member of his cabinet resigned in controversy, a new analysis show again Illinois residents are the highest taxed in the country and the BGA reports today that JB invested his person funds with companies that have multi-million- dollar state contracts. Corruption continues to be standard operating procedure for Chicago machine democrats like JB. Best Regards, Gary Rabine **Will you join our growing movement to defeat JB Pritzker?****** Join Team Rabine to learn how you can be a part of the winning team to defeat JB Pritzker and help turn our state around! | [](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/volunteer?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_25_newsletter&n=3 "Join Team Rabine") [Join Team Rabine](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/volunteer?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_25_newsletter&n=3)

---
### **Appellate Court deals JB Pritzker another blow **
The Fourth District Appellate Court blasted the Governor’s efforts to keep the school mask mandates in place as a “moot” point setting up a potential showdown in the Illinois Supreme Court.
Here is the statement I sent out on the ruling:
“For the second time in as many weeks, a court has slapped down JB Pritzker’s efforts to make parents bystanders in their kids’ health care decisions. Clinging to the egomaniacal notion that he knows better than parents how to raise their kids and better than the courts on how to apply the law, JB will continue to assert that his Executive Order still stands. It’s a Democracy JB, not a dictatorship.”
### Illinois is the highest taxed state
A report from MoneyGeek shows Illinois has the highest tax burden of all 50 states.
The study looked at income taxes, property taxes and other state and local taxes and concluded Illinois has the highest overall tax burden. According to their analysis, Illinois residents pay a combined 16.8% of their income or $13,894 in taxes.
Despite the truth about Illinois’ high tax burden, JB Pritzker seems to think we are not paying enough. Another four years of JB Pritzker is another four years of tax hikes we cannot afford. Let’s make JB Pritzker a one-term Governor.
### Don’t be fooled by temporary tax relief proposals
What does a tax hiker do in an election year?
The standard tax hiker play is to offer “temporary” tax relief in the hopes voters will forget his record of tax increases and Governor JB Pritzker is following the playbook to a tee.
His temporary tax relief scheme will give homeowners up to $300 in onetime property tax relief.
While saving $300 is nice, the reality is the sum is a drop in the bucket when it comes to our overall property tax burden. Instead of onetime gimmicks during an election, we need real, long-term solutions to provide our citizens with the tax relief they need and deserve. But to achieve this would require actual leadership, which is something we know JB Pritzker is incapable of providing.

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

subject: We must face the gun violence epidemic head-on
body:
Candace and I are dedicated to making Maryland a more safe, just, and strong place to live. In order to do that, we must tackle the gun violence epidemic with concrete action and ensure these untraceable and deadly weapons are no longer easily accessible. | | [ ](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkGbWGqbpQqzXdbS1zSPCGk0By5DQ-VT44fbnf8Vb5ovsLfaTfKYcTqYcgr8aDMol7-n7XXzrZLAibWlzSHd8alO80WHl8QkBUKLJkMxNHKLNxvHUbfZvVniPCjS_c3Q3vLmBiK4uHveAluPGn1NXg4Fmul55vSVa1cWsxoBBlYTdj7mGXqfXVqTbjSL6E-e9fA2UB5-E3NUyAoA43nOOS8YpqXtEMwFgsk1wKm5EfkTQwHR-jN_jsdz3_tzE4ZH0UmE_Hs1_D8nP3jEKxzO9JORhUACrkBpSW6rMaefXuH4g/3jv/R5IEOA1YRlSJOC_f71Vmbw/h0/OcPZNA94-oTIf5_M8MdfbhCZra2JjGdtcay2PjfI-lo)

friends, **Maryland is facing a gun violence epidemic.** I promise to tackle this crisis head-on once when elected governor. Until then, we need our current elected officials to do the right thing NOW. That's why I'm calling on the Maryland General Assembly to pass HB425 and SB0387 to ban dangerous ghost guns in Maryland. **[Will you join me by sending a letter to your state legislators, encouraging them to pass this lifesaving legislation?](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkGbWGqbpQqzXdbS1zSPCGk0By5DQ-VT44fbnf8Vb5ovsLfaTfKYcTqYcgr8aDMol7-n7XXzrZLAibWlzSHd8alO80WHl8QkBUKLJkMxNHKLNjk-5gW-9js8Tts6_kMl9NkWmdh3BYcdprluw_UUSQa_OGw3p4qs9zhu84Ux_jl8lyKZnjam1yCx7WzsNEotYxWDjxQRlInaIAGntgHhR-FydXRKrefR4wxDQ2deU2QRTqnPl933ePIV5gb7suA3H04sEZk69kV2elyse554b6WFmPgpU1DXsyyKH5cDmYy3w/3jv/R5IEOA1YRlSJOC_f71Vmbw/h1/e7-XdEuU4s-9C0h7qCDHn0AmebvQUHRVfebHQHAuYC4)**

Ghost guns are bought online, piece-by-piece, and assembled at home. This makes them virtually untraceable, because they don't have serial numbers, and allows people to skirt around background checks since they are purchasing just parts, rather than a whole gun. These ghost guns are turning up in our children's schools, in our neighborhoods, and are leaving behind a trail of violence that is devastating our communities. _Enough is enough. _ Candace and I are dedicated to making Maryland a more safe, just, and strong place to live. In order to do that, we must tackle the gun violence epidemic with concrete action and ensure these untraceable and deadly weapons are no longer easily accessible in our state. Why do I know I can get it done? Because I've done it before. As a prosecutor, I personally put many gun-toting felons in jail. But today I need your help. **[Will you join me in demanding that the Maryland General Assembly pass HB425 and SB0387?](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnkGbWGqbpQqzXdbS1zSPCGk0By5DQ-VT44fbnf8Vb5ovsLfaTfKYcTqYcgr8aDMol7-n7XXzrZLAibWlzSHd8alO80WHl8QkBUKLJkMxNHKLGmXOH1KkEMHx0zaL7Ac90579-EQBdMMmK6zS1lrIIolhTl27qdWomdVuOs8QX54ccivsZASDCX5cVRy3cTfAE1imqdK7LODJ6tzLwT3vX4Iu_K6wdJV1ZhJ09sxccJwyTLfrcwQRp5x3Bz6dlvH0Gp44Nm0qSHqphiZTDntx2rkMSujYPXQJsBDAd80HIwdaw/3jv/R5IEOA1YRlSJOC_f71Vmbw/h3/OkVVddnbiiJCusCSoCZ-wDt8wftJiqgutyy_PfTCa8g)**

| Dear Friends,

We need your help getting 28,000 signatures!

We need everyone who has not signed a packet yet to **sign tomorrow** to ensure we meet the threshold to get a spot on the Republican primary ballot.

We have 29 locations across the state where you can sign for Becky**tomorrow**. Find the full list of our booths, times, and locations [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=cc40db4bbd&e=10c1db3257).

| We could also use your help collecting signatures.** Can you commit to collecting 10 signatures a week until the end of March? **How to get signatures:
* Talk to family and friends.
* Knock on doors in your neighborhood.
* Go to large public events, public universities, or other public property.

One of the best ways to collect lots of signatures is to go to a public location and talk to crowds. At a downtown location, we recently collected 40 signatures in an hour! Below, we have a running list of times and locations where we need your help gathering signatures. Find more information about collecting signatures at public events and request a packet [here](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=07fefa90f2&e=10c1db3257).

If you have volunteered to gather signatures, **please return your packet as soon as possible so we can count and verify your signatures**. Mail your packet to P.O. Box 1467, Bountiful, UT 84011, drop it off at an event, or contact our campaign for pickup.

Peter, did you see the historic news?

**President Biden just announced that he will be nominating Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson to serve on the Supreme Court. She is the first Black woman _EVER_ to be nominated to our nation’s highest court. **
| | [Sign my card to Judge Jackson](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241305/332201575/-636967587?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk381-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Nzg0ZDE3YS04Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ji9rIBxhI2y5BiJqdUd__62746u4s9aZlT-CRUL-oSA=&emci=d1e84138-6696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=4784d17a-8396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=25369504)
---
Judge Jackson is one of the most qualified and deserving candidates that President Biden and Vice President Harris could’ve chosen. As a graduate from Harvard University and Harvard Law School, Jackson landed a clerkship with Justice Breyer, who once described her as **_“great, brilliant, decent, with a mix of common sense and thoughtfulness.” _**

Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson has served as an assistant public defender in Washington, D.C., where she represented defendants who could not afford a lawyer; she spent years as a federal trial judge in Washington; and most recently, she served on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit. She even received votes and endorsements from politicians on both sides of the aisle.

So today, we take a moment to celebrate the historic moment that President Biden and Vice President Harris ushered in. We bask in the idea that a Black woman, qualified and deserving, may be sitting on the Supreme Court in mere months. **Not years, not decades or generations – _months_**** _._**

And tomorrow, we pick the age-old fight for Black women back up and get back to work – starting with the battle to confirm Judge Jackson’s nomination in the Senate.
**Black women like Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson are beyond qualified to serve on our nation’s highest court – and frankly, this invitation to the table is long overdue. [So please, will you join me in celebrating this historic moment and sign my card to congratulate Judge Jackson on becoming the FIRST Black woman to be nominated to the Supreme Court?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42241306/332201576/-636967587?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk381-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Nzg0ZDE3YS04Mzk2LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ji9rIBxhI2y5BiJqdUd__62746u4s9aZlT-CRUL-oSA=&emci=d1e84138-6696-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=4784d17a-8396-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=25369504)**

name: Michael Letts
subject: Why is Biden pulling the Bear’s Tail over Ukraine?
body:
Biden, whatever you’re thinking, don’t do it!
| | |
---
| | Friend,
They say if you repeat a lie often enough, **people believe it**.
Republicans, particularly Donald Trump, are routinely called warmongers. But I guess that depends on what your definition of war is.
Democrats represent the party of peace. Never mind that Lyndon Johnson got us in the Viet Nam ‘conflict.’ Obama’s drone wars in Pakistan, Somalia, Yemen, and Syria were largely ignored, and his involvement in the Libyan civil war, yet that Democrat President received the Nobel Peace Prize.
In contrast, President Trump got us in zero new wars, and he greatly pulled back in Afghanistan but ran out of time during his single term to do the final details. He left that to Joe Biden. Ouch.
Today the world is on the edge of their seats wanting to know what Biden is to do about Ukraine.
**My question is:** _Why do anything?_ The U.S. has no vital interests there. Ukraine is not a member of NATO. So, there is only one possible compelling reason Joe Biden has to pull The Russian Bear’s tail, putting the U.S. at risk of receiving anything as fundamental as cyber-attacks to full-scale thermonuclear World War III.
The reason is Ratings. Historically, being a wartime president is synonymous with high public approval ratings. George W. Bush was not doing that well until 9/11 when he shot up to a 90% approval rating. But are high poll numbers worth the risk? No.
Are high poll numbers even guaranteed to raise Biden’s numbers? **No.**
We live in a different world today than in September of 2001. Global news is virtually instant. There are no longer two sides to a story. There are 2 million—or more.
So, wouldn’t it be a tragedy of Shakespearean—no, make that Orwellian proportions to see Biden’s popularity junket fail? He’d not just be failing at boosting his polling numbers, but his failure could be to the tune of millions of lost lives.
Lest we forget, tensions from Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria’s assassination quickly escalated into World War I.
World War II began when Germany invaded Poland.
Does this European theater sound familiar?
My public message to Joe Biden is: **Whatever you’re thinking, don’t do it!**

| | Otherwise, the worst of what we saw with Covid-19 might look like a stroll through the park compared to the utter devastation we could soon see in a lightning-fast escalation of the most advanced technological weaponry ever unleashed on our blue planet—far more than enough to destroy the world 100 times over.
Yes, Russia has had 100 megaton bombs since 1961, but they might not even be used. That’s 60-year-old technology. How about particle weapons fired from satellites in space? Or seismic weapons?
And what about a few million swarming drones the size of mosquitos that use artificial intelligence to make their own battlefield decisions? What would happen if something went amuck with those mindless mini devils of death?
Or what if biological agents were unleashed that might ‘only’ initially kill 100 million people but soon mutate into strains that could send a few billion more human beings to premature deaths preceded by excruciating pain unseen heretofore in the history of the world that no mask or quarantine could stop? Do we want any of that?
No, Mr. Biden, we don’t want World War III. We don’t need World War III. So please don’t start World War III.

name: Rob Secaur
subject: Weekly Update from the Campaign Trail
body:
Jane Timken for Ohio Update [](https://) Dear Peter, We had another energizing week on the campaign trail as momentum continues to build behind Jane’s America First campaign for U.S. Senate. Jane is set to become the first female U.S. Senator from Ohio and three female U.S. Senators from across the country got behind Jane’s campaign this week. That and a busy schedule of events across Ohio made for an excellent week for the campaign. I hope you’ll take a few minutes to learn more. **Senators Joni Ernst, Shelley Moore Capito, and Deb Fisher Endorse Jane Timken for US Senate** The campaign was thrilled to garner the support of three conservative U.S. Senators this week. Sens. Joni Ernst, Shelley Moore Capito, and Deb Fisher are fighting against the Schumer-Democrat agenda that is hitting Americans with sky-high inflation, record border crossings, and weakened security. Jane is proud to have their endorsement and will join their fight in the U.S. Senate next year. "West Virginia and Ohio not only share a border, but face many of the same issues including combating the opioid epidemic, protecting our American energy jobs, and strengthening our workforce through education and skilled training. I've come to know Jane as a thoughtful and dedicated conservative leader who will tackle these issues head on and bring tenacious, positive leadership to Washington. I look forward to supporting Jane in this race and welcoming her to the Senate next year." – **Senator Shelley Moore Capito** “With our Senate majority at stake, it is critical we elect strong, capable candidates who will advance bold, conservative solutions to strengthen America. I believe Jane Timken’s conservative principles and tireless work ethic make her uniquely qualified to win and help us hold the line in the Senate against the Radical Left.” – **Senator Joni Ernst** "I am proud to support Jane Timken for this important race that could determine control of the Senate. Jane is a pro-Life, pro-agriculture, and pro-military candidate that understands our nation must always lead with strength, not weakness. Jane Timken will be a powerful voice in the Senate who will help protect our national security, advance policies to strengthen American agriculture, and promote strong American families." – **Senator Deb Fischer** **From the Trail** Last weekend Jane showed the depth of her support across various coalitions and issues by having a weekend of action across Ohio. She kicked it off with a farmers roundtable in Marion with a great group of farmers and agricultural stakeholders. They had an informative discussion on the issues the ag community is facing. Jane will be a champion for Ohio agriculture and reduce the headwinds our farmers face from the federal government. [](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=d0704108dbf944b8815786fc464c1d9e&_e=_-keS4Z7uPlRZUYDHjBsWuKLZL4qkHJkJZNZ4EG9qwMCBTWRgGSnMh4I3x2rfvEy7t8IOouq7Z8sHynATxzoktP51sY-U9XchUgONzwYHywqWHXXEq34ReDToZUE9NUkEUntmS3y242ip1kcSzssz7iMjKMk75sihF6jpDhI_xHvtyAD5i1qujKWCoSo6vLI7BB8V2nMZKFBkkfqMsse0SQ6k4bURnFOZY1MsG1rE-nZB6nGc5ILuC1K4B9np6dUxDPEPuc47GJSIKneHxkTcpssmwR8IWh_Nrg16cV6bb6W4IuVdu45SlzUtk_9YXtSaY4_qaZlD66dNSgBtP6aJg%3D%3D) On Saturday morning, Jane joined Ohio’s next generation of leaders at Junior State of America. Jane’s message to them: find something you are passionate about and get involved to make a difference. The future is bright with these young leaders! [](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=d0704108dbf944b8815786fc464c1d9e&_e=_-keS4Z7uPlRZUYDHjBsWjWq90y7U4gSL1JlwT5XrS-1YLNRt8JxbLGBRFNh27T2t_LQvLAj6rgA5VSkP9EVQr76spgQVZ8zssZesDIH2JEwRm4BvLZYHw0u0gN2sfaUMrkrv0jx497mUScTtxtPj20gY4M-B5BOUXfBHKxlUFBNR0iMz2oUA8dRfNZMM4V1ViuKY9TG5D5BaOMrTUp52zqVOgw5VKu_lHW1JYj_2BUYqw6uF9mfEVUnjLqIsG6xjmdP7_JHqDTsVWRcpWNbkQ%3D%3D) Our Parents for Jane Co-Chair Cathy Pultz hosted Jane and a group of involved and motivated parents on Saturday afternoon. Restoring power to parents is a priority for Jane. Students deserve education, not indoctrination. In Greene County, Commissioner Rick Perales hosted veterans, first responders, and police officers to talk about the major issues to keep Ohio and America safe. On Sunday morning, Jane joined Madison Township Trustee Michele Reynolds at The Destiny Center for a morning of worship, community, and inspiration. Pastor Reynolds and the entire congregation warmly welcomed Jane and we appreciate them having us! Later on Sunday, Jane joined Brad Koffel on 610 WTVN in Columbus. We were thrilled to have our Senior Strategist Kellyanne Conway join as well. Click the image below to listen to the full interview. [](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=d0704108dbf944b8815786fc464c1d9e&_e=_-keS4Z7uPlRZUYDHjBsWrsFEfvEuMXhLCqyIWnSCic9lV-Q2OHaUykj4Uzd5oUdV4Xu4pgOcJytcOJ1dqAUSsHP5EhDXb6wAuL7WUnXmCZp8NV6nRmWY0ASFmREKTAg9ZWe0xCG4z0jVNF9a7HePEUHGe3n-51XMXvZ7eLwPGNVmVFphFihp8YxM9zfNnbhrqx5p7JTcmPGd7pnHalV0R2T1J9Q8cWQNDNEEtLLYrgXetr1_0QBohMAXRKAZB40QD__p5jHIkkO40SAkK1SYAFwEOi4u8Gp_u4-ZRbjMAmtRCRS4sDjumka7Oe7Z04RcgesV_660WVk6f7AftGucECZikv-Oify7jAzfzhnAkf8l9lXl_ZVEs-hyG1qWu6_LRMqLUDSfQRUrVG2q1V4DQ%3D%3D) On Monday afternoon, Jane traveled to Morrow County to meet with Sheriff John Hinton to learn more about what his department faces and the funds they need. **Join Jane and Senator Rob Portman Next Week!** We were thrilled last week to earn the support of Ohio U.S. Senator Rob Portman and we are thrilled to announce that Jane and Senator Portman will be hitting the trail next Friday. Jane and Senator Portman will be traveling throughout Southwest and Central Ohio. With stops in Cincinnati, Dayton, and Columbus, we will have a great day. | | | Friends, I spoke with Fox News earlier this week about how social experimentation in our military is emboldening our enemies and making situations like Ukraine and Afghanistan more likely. Among many other issues, the U.S. Military needs to reverse its policy of letting transgender individuals into the military. You can read more on my thoughts below: [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/georgia-republican-marine-ukraine-war-military-transgender-policy](https://colonelswanforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0368302df230e4a82cd29bd86&id=5dc4f70d6f&e=85e5151e18) Our reputation as a professional, courageous, and ferocious fighting force was developed by more than two centuries of inherent American military culture, not American woke culture. To deter future conflicts, we must return to that culture. Thank you all very much for your support. I look forward to working on this and other important issues as the next Congressman from Georgia’s 10th District.
Semper Fidelis, Colonel Mitchell Swan

name: Alex Padilla
subject: Asking you to sign on as a citizen co-sponsor of the Housing for All Act
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

Hi, it's Alex.
Whenever my team sends out an issue survey or asks for your thoughts, we hear from Californians concerned about homelessness and the lack of affordable housing.
That's why I wanted to reach out today to tell you about a bill I’m introducing today in the U.S. Senate — the Housing for All Act of 2022 — [**and to ask you to add your name as a citizen co-sponsor to demonstrate our bill has broad support.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Housing-for-All-em-feb22/?source=em220225-1-60&refcode2=660.159979.b5x0fj&akid=660%2E159979%2Eb5x0fj)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Housing-for-All-em-feb22/?source=em220225-1-60&refcode2=660.159979.b5x0fj&akid=660%2E159979%2Eb5x0fj)**
Addressing homelessness and housing affordability are complex issues with no one cause — and no one solution.
That’s why this bill includes more than $500 billion in funding — for large federal investments in existing programs like the National Housing Trust Fund, as well as for innovative, locally developed approaches to these crises.
The truth is, a lot of housing policy is decided at the state or local level. And it’s going to take all levels of government to truly solve this crisis.
But the _most_ important thing the federal government can do right now is provide money and resources, and that’s what this bill does.
**So please, join me and add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of the Housing for All Act. You can use this link:**
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Housing-For-All-Act**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Housing-for-All-em-feb22/?source=em220225-1-60&refcode2=660.159979.b5x0fj&akid=660%2E159979%2Eb5x0fj)
Thank you!
Alex Padilla
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Housing-for-All-em-feb22/?source=em220225-1-60&refcode2=660.159979.b5x0fj&akid=660%2E159979%2Eb5x0fj)**

name: Rebecca Parson
subject: Statement on Ukraine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rebecca for Washington
body:
| | | Hi , Like so many, I’ve been glued to the news watching what’s happening in Ukraine. My thoughts are with the Ukrainian people, who don’t deserve this. It’s always the people who suffer the most during war, never the oligarchs or corporations that profit from war. Below is my press release from yesterday, which I issued jointly with fellow Washington State candidates Jason Call and Stephanie Gallardo. *** **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Keri Christersoncontact@rebeccaforwa.com(253) 218-3503February 24, 2022 **WA Congressional Candidates Condemn Russia’s Invasion of Ukraine, U.S. Escalation, and War Profiteering by U.S. Fracked Gas Companies** **Washington State** — U.S. Congressional candidates Jason Call (WA-02), Stephanie Gallardo (WA-09), and Rebecca Parson (WA-06) issued the following joint statement on Russia’s invasion of Ukraine: “For weeks, Ukrainian President Zelensky asked the U.S. to tone down its rhetoric of an imminent Russian invasion of Ukraine, which Zelensky said wasn’t coming. Now the worst has happened. We unequivocally condemn Putin’s invasion of Ukraine. We also condemn the U.S.’s reneging on its promise not to expand NATO eastward to Russia’s borders. NATO itself was formed to combat the USSR, a country that no longer exists. NATO was formed to protect the North Atlantic, yet it finds itself with landlocked member states over 1,000 miles from the Atlantic Ocean. We stand with the 74% of Americans who do not think the U.S. should have a major role in Ukraine. We call on President Biden and Congress not to drag our country into war with Russia. We have to ask: is it a coincidence that U.S. shipments of fracked gas — also known as LNG — to Europe have increased? Is it a coincidence that U.S. LNG stocks have skyrocketed in the past day? Is it a coincidence that the American Petroleum Institute wasted no time in releasing a four-point plan for profiting from this war?” Washington State is the epicenter of America’s nuclear enterprise — with Bangor Submarine Base being the largest storehouse of nuclear weapons in the U.S., if not the world. Two nuclear powers should not go to war with each other: for the safety of Washingtonians and all the world’s people. For interview requests, please contact Keri Christerson at (253) 218-3503. ###

subject: Remember February 12, 2019?

body:
I know $3 doesn’t seem like the kind of money that can win an election, but when everyone is chipping in together it all adds up. That’s how we win.
#

**February 12, 2019 - Do you remember it?**
That was the day I launched my first campaign for Senate. And the truth is, I had no idea what to expect.
Gabby and I had some friends we hoped would be willing to help, but I knew one of the biggest challenges would be raising the kind of money we needed to win.
But because of supporters like you, we ran one of the largest people-powered Senate campaigns ever. And that’s helped us fend off attacks from corporate special interests in both of my elections.
**February 28, 2022**
That’s the day of our next official fundraising deadline, and it is coming up FAST.
Right now we’re short of where we need to be before it ends. And that’s not great. Because these goals are not arbitrary.
The only way we’ll get there is with as many individual donations as we possibly can before it ends.
So, I have a big ask of you today. Can you make TODAY the day you make your first online contribution to my re-election campaign?
You’ll be doing more than most to help us win. Not only that, you’ll be taking an active role in shaping the future for America you want to see, and that’s something to be extraordinarily proud of.
What do you say?

name: Erica Smith
subject: This North Carolina town stands as a symbol of Black determination and endurance
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY Erica Smith for US Senate 2022
body:
[1]Erica Smith

Here’s something you may not know about me:

In the North Carolina State Senate, I represented Princeville, a town in
the heart of NC-01 — and the very first town incorporated by Black people
in U.S. history.

This Black History Month, I wanted to tell you more about Princeville,
North Carolina.

[ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/41306?refcode=em20220225-914&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=914%2E3698%2EidnWac ][IMG]

It was the honor of a lifetime to represent Princeville in the North
Carolina State Senate for three terms. Generation after generation, the
people of Princeville have developed a strong sense of pride in our
history and in our community. Today, Princeville stands as a symbol of
Black determination and endurance.

The town was incorporated in 1885, but its history as an independent Black
community predates that. At the close of the Civil War, many former slaves
settled in the swampy flood plain across the Tar River. The refugees
called their new community Freedom Hill. Eventually, the name was changed
to Princeville in honor of Turner Prince, an African-American man who
helped build many of the community’s homes.

During Reconstruction, the community exercised its political strength by
electing Black men to office. Princeville and Edgecombe County voters
elected eleven Black men to the state legislature to serve fifteen terms
from 1877 to 1890.

But with the emergence of the white supremacist movement in North
Carolina, Black voters and officeholders were gradually excluded from the
political process. Racist literacy tests and poll taxes excluded Black
people from voting. Black voters were attacked or threatened by opposing
whites, and their ballots were altered or discarded altogether.

More than 100 years later, I'm bringing the legacy of Princeville with me
as I run for Congress in North Carolina’s 1st District. And I *promise* I

This Black History Month, I wanted to tell you more about Princeville, North Carolina. [ ][IMG] It was the honor of a lifetime to represent Princeville in the North Carolina State Senate for three terms. Generation after generation, the people of Princeville have developed a strong sense of pride in our history and in our community. Today, Princeville stands as a symbol of Black determination and endurance. The town was incorporated in 1885, but its history as an independent Black community predates that. At the close of the Civil War, many former slaves settled in the swampy flood plain across the Tar River. The refugees called their new community Freedom Hill. Eventually, the name was changed to Princeville in honor of Turner Prince, an African-American man who helped build many of the community’s homes. During Reconstruction, the community exercised its political strength by electing Black men to office. Princeville and Edgecombe County voters elected eleven Black men to the state legislature to serve fifteen terms from 1877 to 1890. But with the emergence of the white supremacist movement in North Carolina, Black voters and officeholders were gradually excluded from the political process. Racist literacy tests and poll taxes excluded Black people from voting. Black voters were attacked or threatened by opposing whites, and their ballots were altered or discarded altogether. | | My heart is breaking for the Ukrainian people, Peter. Putin’s attacks are already killing and injuring civilians and already displacing families. The consequences to Urkaininans’ lives and livelihoods will continue to be dire. It is certainly time for the international community to leap into action — surging humanitarian relief and preparing safe corridors for refugees fleeing the conflict. And we must keep working with our allies to hold Putin accountable. That includes imposing crushing sanctions on the Russian government, Putin and his allies; targeting his cronies and their illicit wealth, cutting his banks off from the West and constraining his access to the international financial system. He has to see threats to the pillars supporting his grip on power. I applaud the most recent steps President Biden has taken, and I urge the administration to keep coordinating with allies on further steps. This is a dark time for all who yearn and strive for a peaceful world. But I am heartened by the bravery of the Ukrainian people, as well as by the resistance to Putin coming from within Russia, where acts of protest put people at grave personal risk. And I am invigorated by the Ukrainian Americans I’ve seen in Southeast Michigan who are speaking out for peace and raising money and collecting supplies to support refugees. All people of good will must hold together against such naked aggression. We must stay resolved to support Ukraine and its people until its sovereignty is restored and peace returns to Europe. In solidarity, Andy

## New post on **Theresa Coates Ellis for Congress**
|
---|---
| | [](https://theresacoatesellis.com/?author=1) |
## [On the Trail with Theresa](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/02/25/on-the-trail-with-theresa/)
by [theresacoatesellis](https://theresacoatesellis.com/?author=1)
---|---
Friends,
The support is growing for my campaign, and I want to earn your vote.
**Please mark your calendars for[Saturday, May 21](x-apple-data-detectors://0)[st](x-apple-data-detectors://0)[ from 9:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.](x-apple-data-detectors://0) and Vote for Theresa.**
If you cannot make it on that day, you can vote early [on May 12](x-apple-data-detectors://1)[th](x-apple-data-detectors://1)[ between 4:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m.](x-apple-data-detectors://1)
It is critical that you make your voice heard!
It has been an exciting week crisscrossing the district talking to citizens and business owners about their concerns and what I will do in Washington. The response has been overwhelming.
Please consider joining Team Theresa by [clicking here](https://TheresaEllisforCongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22f171928cb43725463145039&id=c21e399d85&e=1decb0b812).
Visited Clifton and spoke to Brian, busy in mortgage services. After talking, we realized he attended high school with my daughters.
As a Manassas City Councilwoman, I have been working with the Manassas Regional Airport as a commission member and now as their liaison for 7 years. They are one of the busiest general aviation airports in Virginia, with a huge economic impact to our region and are self-funded generating revenue to our general fund annually — recently reporting more than $800,000.
My husband George and I are beekeepers as a hobby when we are not working. I am also a trained master gardener. I initiated the Bee City USA designation for Manassas to be the first city in Northern Virginia. We continue to educate our families about the importance of planting native and saving our pollinators, important to our growing food source with best practices. The 2nd annual Manassas Bee Festival is [June 25](x-apple-data-detectors://3) at Liberia House and Grounds in Manassas.
I spoke at Chasing Freedom hosting our Veterans at the Electric Palm. As a Military Mom, I will fight for better support for our military, Vets, and their families. With the invasion in Ukraine, I am praying for the people, the victims, and for our brave men and women in uniform.
I had the pleasure to share the [5/21/2022](x-apple-data-detectors://4) Firehouse Primary news and new District maps with Clifton area folks as I continue my #TheresaDinerTour and more. My website has locations and more details.
My good friend Col. Ulysses White “Xerk” endorsed me this week. He is a barrier breaker. The first African American elected to Manassas its Council in the 90s. He also is retired from the Army after 30 years. We serve on Rotary together. We are People of Action!
As a woman business owner, I had a great morning supporting these women and their family in the restaurant industry. Anthony’s was my favorite lunch spot when they were located in the Manassas area. Now they are in Falls Church. They are very concerned about the supply chain disruption and the skyrocketing costs to operate. ## STATEMENT FROM DR. JOHN DI PAOLA REGARDING
RUSSIA'S INVASION OF UKRAINE
---
| "Joe Biden continues to outdo himself in proving that he is unable to successfully accomplish ANY aspect of the normal requirements of a leader. Russia’s invasion of Ukraine is just the latest example of a long line of foreign policy failures under this administration.

**"I stand with the people of Ukraine in condemning this unprovoked attack by Vladimir Putin and pray for their safety during these tumultuous times.**

"It's time for Joe Biden to stop financing Putin's regime with our dependence on Russian energy. I'm calling on the Administration to ramp up American production to assure the needs of our people and supply our NATO allies. The full force of America's economic power needs to be turned against Russia to defend the democracies which we have fought so hard to protect."
Dr. John Di Paola,
